CI re-runs at the merged head | 7618d49a CI; d0f6312b82 pending |

The 47 macOS skips are the file's Linux-only behavioral pins; the maintainer's Linux round executes them (142/142), so the macOS counts alone do not certify the changed behavior — the Linux verification does. The new inherited-state witness is cross-platform and ran on both systems. Prior Linux A/B and real-pool reports remain historical evidence at their recorded heads.

### Tested on

## Current closeout

Round of 2026-10-31 (local takeover after the AutoFix loop reached its round cap): merged main `812a8c7ccb`, resolving the write-back conflicts semantically — main's nine-coordinate prune list (from the #15871 Maven-module split) plus this PR's seven-name `! -name` exclusions, with the matching test pins moved along — and fixed R13-1 by dropping `-links +1` from all four seed prunes so inherited single-link resolver state is cleared again; the write-backs' `-links 1` delta filter is unchanged. Both design-doc languages are synchronized and `.size-baseline` is re-recorded to the exact byte count. Unlike the previous static-only closeout, this round ran the suites and the mutation locally (evidence table above). The merge-order decision R2-6 asked for is recorded: this PR is the chosen landing PR of the family; #15275, #15284 and #15233 are closed, #15254 merged, and #15286 remains the separately owned follow-up.

Later on 2026-10-31: the maintainer merged current main (`7618d49a`, PR files untouched) and published an independent Linux verification at that head — verdict **merge-ready**, 61/61 assertions, 18/18 mutations killed. One non-blocking Suggestion from that report is deferred and recorded here per the repository's post-five-round convergence rule: when the `managed-agent-server` checkout is missing, the deferred-failure annotation names the previous successful Maven stage instead of the checkout (both lanes). The report carries a measured minimal fix (set `mvn_stage` before the `cd`; the test pin counting `mvn_stage` occurrences must move with it). It is follow-up work, not a merge blocker; the deferral is recorded so nothing is silently dropped.

2026-11-01: merged main `91a6274075` (`d0f6312b82`) to clear the base conflict, keeping main's Hosted-admission change (#16010) alongside this PR's hardening; delta unchanged, baseline re-recorded (155529), required suites re-run green. At `7618d49a` CI was fully green (including the full SDK Java tier on the real pool) and the PR held two maintainer approvals (wenshao, yiliang114); CI re-runs at the merged head, and stale-approval dismissal rules may require the two approvals to be refreshed. No review thread is unresolved.

2026-11-02: the maintainer merged main once more (`702da7a21a`, merging `60f5c1ed95`); the PR delta is unchanged apart from main-side comment edits inside `sdk-java.yml`, which now measures 156105 bytes while `.size-baseline` still records 155529 — a 576-byte record nit the CI size check tolerates, to be re-recorded with the next content change. All checks at this head are green, including the re-run `review-pr` whose round-15 review posted zero findings. prs.title: fix(ci): keep sdk-java resolver bookkeeping and in-house jars out of the host cache (#15281)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The job-local Maven repository that the sdk-java suites resolve from no longer shares mutable inodes with the host cache:

- Every seed site drops `maven-metadata-local.xml` together with the other resolver bookkeeping names (`_remote.repositories`, `resolver-status.properties`, `*.lastUpdated`, `*.tmp`), so the unlocked Maven runs cannot rewrite a host-cache file through a seeded hardlink.
- The locked write-back removes every in-house fixed-release coordinate from the host cache (the `qwen-managed-agent-*` modules are purged by glob, tracking #15871's module split), prunes them at any depth rather than only at the repository root, publishes only job-produced files (the same five names stay job-local), and downgrades a failed cache-directory creation to a warning instead of reddening a green suite.
- The self-hosted Managed Agent Checkstyle leg resolves the SDK from the job-local repository the suite installed it into.
- The release builder's seed copies into the job-local repository instead of nesting a second `repository/` inside it, and drops the same bookkeeping names.
- The workflow meta-tests pin the five exclusions at every seed and both prunes, the write-back's children and their fd 9 closure, the host-side removal, the warning path, and the Checkstyle repository.

## Why it's needed

Moving Maven above the per-host lock is only safe while the job-local repository has no inode in common with the host cache. Maven's resolver rewrites its bookkeeping files in place, and the suites `install` fixed-release in-house artifacts: seeded as hardlinks, they let an unlocked run mutate state that every sibling job on the host reads.

Correction to the earlier description: the lock-scope change itself ("only the write-back takes the lock") landed through #15128 and #15254 and is already on main. #15274 remains open with overlapping cache and deferred-status changes. This PR is the cache-isolation half that makes that scope safe, and it is judged on that, not on the lock wait from #15281.

Reconciliation on 2026-10-31: merged main `812a8c7ccb` and reconciled with #15871's split of the Managed Agent server into nine Maven modules. The seed drops, the write-back prunes and the host-cache purge now cover the full in-house coordinate set; the purge globs `qwen-managed-agent-*` so a future module rename cannot leave a stale host copy behind. All four unique behaviors are retained: the host-cache purge, the seed nesting fix, the self-hosted Checkstyle repository, and the reference-release seed isolation. When #15274 lands, this branch reconciles against its delivered code again.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job of a PR that touches a managed-agent path. The self-hosted step should show the `cp -aln` seed and all three Maven invocations before any `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock` line; the lock wait should appear only at the cache write-back, and the write-back should remove the in-house coordinates before copying. Grep the job-local repository for `maven-metadata-local.xml` after the suite: it should hold only job-produced files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a seeded `maven-metadata-local.xml` and a seeded `qwencode-sdk` jar were the same inode as the host cache, so the unlocked `mvn install` changed the host file (same inode, SHA and mtime both moved). After: the host file is byte- and mtime-identical while the job-local copy is still written, the write-back publishes zero bookkeeping files and never the in-house coordinates, and the host cache loses the pre-PR in-house trees. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     |                       Status                        |
| :--------: | :-------------------------------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ meta-tests (367 passed, 11 Linux-only skipped), shell probes, Prettier |
| 🪟 Windows |                   ⚠️ not tested                    |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ CI is authoritative for the Linux-only behavioral legs; earlier heads ran the full meta-tests there |

### Environment (optional)

Meta-tests at head `28eedc0e1a` (macOS): `scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js`, `scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`, `scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js` — 367 passed, 11 skipped (the Linux-only behavioral legs run in CI). Local shell probes confirmed the nine-coordinate any-depth prune, the five-name exclusion and the glob host purge. No JDK 21 / Maven locally, so the real Java suite is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a cold host pays the seed cost once, and the write-back is best-effort and capped at 300 seconds, matching the MariaDB lane. The write-back also deletes pre-existing in-house copies from the host cache — intended, because they are the stale fixed-release jars the in-house prune exists to stop publishing.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real ECS pool and its ticketed lock queue; the full JDK 21 Maven suite; the MySQL / MariaDB integration lanes; the hosted legs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #15281 (the lock-scope change landed through #15128 and #15254; this PR closes the cache-isolation gap that the smaller lock scope depends on).

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：播种出的 `maven-metadata-local.xml` 与 `qwencode-sdk` jar 与宿主缓存是同一 inode，不持锁的 `mvn install` 会改写宿主文件（inode 相同，SHA 与 mtime 都变化）。After：宿主文件字节与 mtime 完全不变，同时 job 本地副本仍被写入；写回不发布任何记账文件、也从不发布内部坐标；宿主缓存中遗留的内部目录被删除。UI 不适用。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): mask digit-led passwords and refuse an empty Harness user info in the upgrade command
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follows up the review items that arrived on #16110 and #16175 after they were settled, in the upgrade command's `start`/`verify` phases and their tests and docs:

- **A refusal hides everything up to a URL's last `@`, also when the URL parses without user information.** A password that starts with digits and holds a `/`, `?` or `#` ends the authority early, and the URL parser and `java.net.URI` both read its first part as a port: `http://svc:2024#Secret@harness:4170` is host `svc`, port `2024`, fragment `Secret@harness:4170`. The refusal printed such a value whole, password included, for the Harness URL and for the new `--server-url` query/fragment refusal. Both now print `http://***@harness:4170`.
- **Without the server's verdict, `start` refuses an `@` before the Harness host.** `http://@127.0.0.1:4170` and `http://:@127.0.0.1:4170` have no user name or password to the URL parser, but `java.net.URI` reads user information `""` and `":"`, and the Harness connector refuses them. With the verdict, the refusal now names that reason instead of the generic one. Without it, as when the configuration does not resolve, `start` let them through: it restarted the Harness for a value that a pool would drop every member over.
- **A health status of `0`, `false` or `""` is shown.** The health row and `start`'s timeout showed only `HTTP 200`, because a truth test dropped the status before it was printed. They now show `HTTP 200, status 0`, `status false` and `status ""`. A `null` status, like a missing one, still names nothing.
- **The URLs the two phases print go through the control-byte neutralizer.** These are the health URL in the health row and in `start`'s three outcomes, and the API URL. The text comes from the configuration or the command line rather than the endpoint, but an ESC or newline in it would still drive the terminal or split the row.
- **A Session id with a lone surrogate fails its row by name.** Such an id has no UTF-8 to percent-encode, so the row read `FAIL URI malformed`. It now reads `FAIL the API answered a Session whose id "\ud800" names no route`.
- **Tests and docs.** The Flyway reader gets the module-versus-module duplicate case that #16175's review deferred. The user guide names the condition it left out of `verify --tenant`'s API read: with `--actor`, the server must name a trusted actor header. The design docs state the masking, status and id rules as the code now applies them.

## Why it's needed

These are the items deferred as non-blocking by the last review rounds and by a verification comment, none of which landed before the two PRs merged:

- #16110: the bot's round 7 left six probes.
- #16110: the round-3 verification comment's Finding 1.
- #16175: one probe from the bot's round 4.

Five of the six #16110 probes are fixed here. The sixth is whether to model the server's plaintext-transport rule in the Harness verdict. That is a design decision and stays open.

While triaging the masking probe, the digit-led password case turned out to be a real leak, not only a wording gap: the docs promised `***` "whether or not the URL parses", and a parsing value printed the password.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```bash
node --test scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs
npx eslint --max-warnings 0 packages/managed-agent-server/distribution/bin/qwen-managed-agent-upgrade.mjs scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs
```

Places to look:

- **Masking:** the `withoutCredentials` table and the `--server-url` battery cover the digit-led passwords.
- **The `@` before the Harness host:** both blocks cover it, the server.env fallback ("start and verify use server.env when the configuration does not resolve") and the verdict list.
- **Falsy statuses and printed URLs:** "health reports neutralize terminal control bytes from the endpoint" covers both.
- **Lone surrogates:** the id loop in "verify says why an API read failed".
- **Module-versus-module duplicates:** the Flyway reader test.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Suite.** 68/68 on Node 22.22.2 (x86_64) and on Node 24.14.0 (aarch64). Eslint and Prettier are clean.

**Mutation sweep.** Each mutant rewrites one guard in a scratch copy, runs the unmodified suite, and restores the file, checked by sha256.

**17/17 mutants killed**, one of them a known-killed control. Each guard this PR adds has at least one mutant:

| Guard | Mutants |
| --- | --- |
| Health status | a truth test in place of the `undefined` check; the empty status printed bare; `null` treated as a status |
| Session id | the lone-surrogate check dropped |
| `spellsUserInfo()` | always false; without the backslash rule; without the leading trim |
| Masking | the parser-only branch this PR replaces; the `--server-url` query refusal printed raw |
| Printed URLs | `printable()` dropped at each of the five URL print sites |
| Flyway duplicates | the first module not kept as the one named; the comparison limited to `BOOT-INF/classes` |

**Real systemd host.** The control plane, Hosted Harness and MySQL 8.4 are real; systemd is the real one; a scripted model serves the turn. Both arms run on the installed alpha.104 distribution, and only the upgrade script differs between them:

- `prev`: main's script, with #16110 and #16175 merged.
- `head`: this branch's script.

| Case | `prev` (main) | `head` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No verdict, Harness URL `http://@127.0.0.1:<port>` | `Starting qma-e2e-harness`, then `The preflight failed`; Harness left running | refused before the restart: `"http://***@127.0.0.1:<port>", which carries an @ before its host, which java.net.URI reads as user information` |
| No verdict, `http://:@127.0.0.1:<port>` | same as above | same refusal |
| No verdict, `http://svc:2024#s3cret@127.0.0.1:<port>` | refused, prints `"http://svc:2024#s3cret@…"` (password in output: 1) | refused, prints `"http://***@127.0.0.1:<port>"` (0) |
| `start --server-url http://admin:2024#s3cret@127.0.0.1:<port>/zero` | refused, prints the password (1) | `--server-url "http://***@127.0.0.1:<port>/zero" carries a query or a fragment…` (0) |
| health `{"status":0}` / `false` / `""` / `null` | `HTTP 200` for all four | `HTTP 200, status 0` / `status false` / `status ""` / `HTTP 200` |
| `--server-url` with ESC, CSI and OSC-52 in its path | the row carries the raw bytes (1 line with ESC) | each shown as `�` (0) |
| a Session id `"\ud800"` | `FAIL session URI malformed` | `FAIL session the API answered a Session whose id "\ud800" names no route` |
| happy path `start`, then `verify --tenant e2e --turn` | — | `PASS health`, `PASS session`, `PASS turn … ended with turn.completed` |

The rig's configuration was restored byte for byte, and both units were left inactive.

### Review round 1

The bot's two suggestions are fixed in `4d2fdf3cd7`. The four refusals that quote a URL, and the row that names a Session id no route can carry, printed their value through `JSON.stringify` alone. JSON escapes C0 controls but leaves DEL and C1 bytes, such as the 8-bit CSI introducer U+009B, so a value could reach the terminal with them, and the id had no length limit.

Each of those values now goes through `printable(JSON.stringify(value))`:
- C0 controls keep their escapes, so every existing output is byte-identical.
- DEL and C1 bytes show as `�`.
- The quoted text stops at 200 code points.

A new test drives each of the four refusal sites with `\u009b2K` in the value, and a Session id of 300 code points ending in a lone surrogate. All 6 mutants are killed: each site reverted to `JSON.stringify`, plus `quoted()` without `printable()`. The suite passes 69/69 on Node 22 and Node 24.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### Environment (optional)

- **Linux x86_64 (Debian 13), Node 22.22.2:** the suite.
- **Linux aarch64, Node 24.14.0:** the suite.
- **systemd rig:** the A/B above, on the reference distribution 0.1.0-alpha.104.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff.** A refused URL that holds an `@` anywhere, for example in its path, now prints with everything before that `@` as `***`. That hides more of a value that is refused anyway, in exchange for never printing the rest of a digit-led password. Values the command dials and does not refuse are printed as before, except that their control characters are replaced.
- **Not validated / out of scope.**
  - Whether the Harness verdict should model the server's plaintext-transport rule (`BrokerSecurity.checkHarnessTransport`) stays open for a maintainer decision.
  - macOS and Windows were not run; the command targets systemd hosts.
  - No Java changes: the server already refuses every value this PR adds to `start`'s own checks.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes.** None. Refusal texts change only in what they mask and in the new `@` reason.

Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-10-25-managed-agent-upgrade-command.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-25-managed-agent-upgrade-command.zh-CN.md). Both are updated in the same paragraph.

## Linked Issues

Follows up #16110 and #16175.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

#16110 和 #16175 收尾之后，又陆续到了几条评审意见。本 PR 在升级命令的 `start`/`verify` 阶段及其测试、文档中处理这些意见：

- **拒绝提示会遮掉 URL 最后一个 `@` 之前的全部内容，URL 能解析、解析器也没读出用户信息时同样如此。** 以数字开头、又含 `/`、`?` 或 `#` 的密码会让 authority 提前结束，URL 解析器和 `java.net.URI` 都会把密码的前半段读成端口：`http://svc:2024#Secret@harness:4170` 被读成主机 `svc`、端口 `2024`、fragment `Secret@harness:4170`。Harness URL 的拒绝提示和新增的 `--server-url` query/fragment 拒绝提示，都会把这样的值连同密码原样打印出来。现在两处都打印 `http://***@harness:4170`。
- **没有服务端判定时，`start` 会拒绝 Harness 主机前带 `@` 的取值。** 对 URL 解析器来说，`http://@127.0.0.1:4170` 和 `http://:@127.0.0.1:4170` 没有用户名和密码；但 `java.net.URI` 会读出用户信息 `""` 和 `":"`，Harness 连接器因此拒绝它们。有判定时，拒绝提示现在写明这个原因，不再给笼统的提示。没有判定时（例如无法解析配置），`start` 原来会放行，为一个会让 pool 丢弃全部成员的取值白白重启 Harness。
- **health 的 status 为 `0`、`false` 或 `""` 时也会显示。** 原来 health 行和 `start` 的超时提示只显示 `HTTP 200`，因为打印前的真值判断把 status 丢掉了。现在显示 `HTTP 200, status 0`、`status false` 和 `status ""`。`null` 与缺失一样，仍不显示。
- **两个阶段打印的 URL 都经过控制字节净化。** 包括 health 行和 `start` 三种结果中的健康端点 URL，以及 API URL。这些文本来自配置或命令行，而不是端点，但其中的 ESC 或换行符照样会操控终端或拆开一行。
- **Session id 含孤立代理项时，该行会写明原因再判失败。** 这样的 id 没有可做百分号编码的 UTF-8，原来该行只显示 `FAIL URI malformed`。现在显示 `FAIL the API answered a Session whose id "\ud800" names no route`。
- **测试和文档。** Flyway 读取器补上 #16175 评审延后的"两个模块含同一路径"用例。用户指南补上 `verify --tenant` 读取 API 时漏写的条件：给了 `--actor` 时，服务端必须配置可信 actor header。设计文档中关于脱敏、status 和 id 的规则，改为与当前代码一致。

## 为什么需要

这些都是最后几轮评审和一条验证评论里延后的非阻断项，两个 PR 合入前都没有落地：

- #16110：bot 第 7 轮留下的 6 条探针。
- #16110：第 3 轮验证评论的 Finding 1。
- #16175：bot 第 4 轮的 1 条探针。

#16110 的 6 条探针中，5 条在本 PR 修复。第 6 条是 Harness 判定要不要纳入服务端的明文传输规则，属于设计决策，仍待决定。

排查脱敏那条探针时发现，以数字开头的密码是真实的泄露，不只是措辞问题：文档承诺"无论能否解析"都显示为 `***`，而能解析的取值会把密码打印出来。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

```bash
node --test scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs
npx eslint --max-warnings 0 packages/managed-agent-server/distribution/bin/qwen-managed-agent-upgrade.mjs scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs
```

可以重点看这些地方：

- **脱敏：** `withoutCredentials` 用例表和 `--server-url` 拒绝用例覆盖了以数字开头的密码。
- **Harness 主机前的 `@`：** server.env 回退用例（"start and verify use server.env when the configuration does not resolve"）和判定列表两处都有覆盖。
- **status 假值和打印的 URL：** 都在 "health reports neutralize terminal control bytes from the endpoint" 里。
- **孤立代理项：** "verify says why an API read failed" 中的 id 循环。
- **两个模块的同路径脚本：** Flyway 读取器的测试。

### 证据（修改前后）

**测试套件。** Node 22.22.2（x86_64）和 Node 24.14.0（aarch64）上都是 68/68，eslint 和 Prettier 无报错。

**变异测试。** 每个变异在独立副本中改写一处守卫，然后运行未修改的测试套件，再还原文件并用 sha256 校验。

**变异 17/17 全部被杀**，其中 1 个是已知必杀的对照。本 PR 新增的每处守卫至少对应一个变异：

| 守卫 | 变异 |
| --- | --- |
| health status | 把 `undefined` 判断换回真值判断；空串直接打印；`null` 也当作 status |
| Session id | 去掉孤立代理项检查 |
| `spellsUserInfo()` | 恒返回 false；去掉反斜杠规则；去掉开头 trim |
| 脱敏 | 退回本 PR 替换掉的只按解析器遮挡的写法；`--server-url` 的 query 拒绝原样打印 |
| 打印的 URL | 在 5 处打印 URL 的地方分别去掉 `printable()` |
| Flyway 重复脚本 | 不再记住最先出现的模块；只在 `BOOT-INF/classes` 与模块之间比较 |

**真实 systemd 主机。** 控制面、Hosted Harness 和 MySQL 8.4 都是真实的，systemd 也是真实的，turn 由脚本模型应答。两组都在已安装的 alpha.104 发行包上运行，只有升级脚本不同：

- `prev`：main 上的脚本，#16110 和 #16175 均已合入。
- `head`：本分支的脚本。

| 场景 | `prev`（main） | `head` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 无判定，Harness URL `http://@127.0.0.1:<port>` | 先 `Starting qma-e2e-harness`，再 `The preflight failed`，Harness 保持运行 | 重启前即拒绝：`which carries an @ before its host, which java.net.URI reads as user information` |
| 无判定，`http://:@127.0.0.1:<port>` | 同上 | 同样拒绝 |
| 无判定，`http://svc:2024#s3cret@127.0.0.1:<port>` | 拒绝，但打印密码（输出中出现 1 次） | 拒绝，打印 `"http://***@127.0.0.1:<port>"`（0 次） |
| `start --server-url http://admin:2024#s3cret@…/zero` | 拒绝，但打印密码（1 次） | 拒绝，打印 `"http://***@127.0.0.1:<port>/zero"`（0 次） |
| health 的 status 为 `0` / `false` / `""` / `null` | 四种都只显示 `HTTP 200` | `status 0` / `status false` / `status ""` / `HTTP 200` |
| `--server-url` 路径中含 ESC、CSI、OSC-52 | health 行带着原始字节（1 行含 ESC） | 全部显示为 `�`（0 行） |
| Session id 为 `"\ud800"` | `FAIL session URI malformed` | `FAIL session the API answered a Session whose id "\ud800" names no route` |
| 正常路径：`start`，然后 `verify --tenant e2e --turn` | — | health、session、turn 三行均 PASS |

rig 的配置已逐字节还原，两个 unit 最后都处于停止状态。

### 第 1 轮评审

bot 的两条建议在 `4d2fdf3cd7` 中修复。四处引用 URL 的拒绝提示，以及点名无法放进路由的 Session id 的那一行，原来只经过 `JSON.stringify` 打印。JSON 会转义 C0 控制字符，但不转义 DEL 和 C1 字节（例如 8 位 CSI 引导符 U+009B），这些字节可能原样进入终端，而且 id 没有长度上限。

现在这些值统一经过 `printable(JSON.stringify(value))`：
- C0 控制字符保留原来的转义形式，所以现有输出逐字节不变。
- DEL 和 C1 字节显示为 `�`。
- 引用的文本在 200 个码点处截断。

新测试在四处拒绝提示的取值中各放入 `\u009b2K`，并用一个 300 个码点、以孤立代理项结尾的 Session id 覆盖 id 那一行。6 个变异全部被杀：五处分别改回 `JSON.stringify`，外加去掉 `quoted()` 中的 `printable()`。测试套件在 Node 22 和 Node 24 上都是 69/69。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### 环境（可选）

- **Linux x86_64（Debian 13），Node 22.22.2：** 测试套件。
- **Linux aarch64，Node 24.14.0：** 测试套件。
- **systemd rig：** 上面的 A/B，在 reference 发行包 0.1.0-alpha.104 上运行。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或权衡。** 被拒绝的 URL 只要在任何位置含 `@`（例如在路径里），这个 `@` 之前的内容都会显示为 `***`。这会多遮掉一些本来就被拒绝的值，换来的是以数字开头的密码不会再被打印出来。命令实际拨号、没有拒绝的 URL 照常打印，只是其中的控制字符会被替换。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内。**
  - Harness 判定是否纳入服务端的明文传输规则（`BrokerSecurity.checkHarnessTransport`），仍待 maintainer 决定。
  - 没有在 macOS 和 Windows 上运行；这个命令面向 systemd 主机。
  - 没有 Java 改动：本 PR 加进 `start` 自身检查的每一种取值，服务端本来就会拒绝。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明。** 无。拒绝提示的文本只在脱敏范围和新增的 `@` 原因上有变化。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-25-managed-agent-upgrade-command.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-25-managed-agent-upgrade-command.zh-CN.md)，两版改的是同一段。

## 关联 Issue

#16110 和 #16175 的后续。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): reject recycled PIDs in runtime session status
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The legacy `runtime.json` sidecar now records an opaque process-start token alongside the PID on Linux, and session-liveness reads require both the PID and that token to match when the token is available. Older sidecars remain readable; an unavailable token falls back to the existing PID-liveness behavior rather than declaring a live session dead. The bundled stuck-session diagnostic is updated to use the same identity check and to exclude zombie processes during discovery.

## Why it's needed

A sidecar is intentionally left behind when a session exits. If its PID is later recycled by an unrelated process, `kill(pid, 0)` succeeds and the stale session is reported as active. The first layer of #14288 already rejects zombies; this change closes the related PID-recycling false positive by carrying the same boot-id plus process-start identity already used by the session registry.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Exercise a runtime-status record whose `proc_start` differs from the current process token: the session should resolve to inactive even though the PID is alive. With a matching token it should remain active. A legacy record without `proc_start`, or an unreadable local token, should retain the previous liveness behavior. The added unit cases cover these branches and the new on-disk field.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal status classification, no user-visible output changed.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

No local tests, build, typecheck, lint, or formatting checks were run; only `git diff --check` was used. CI is the verification path for this change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an unreadable `/proc` token degrades to plain PID liveness, so protection is unavailable on those systems; readable mismatches are treated as stale.
- Not validated / out of scope: suspended-parent zombie reaping remains POSIX-inherent and unchanged. Doctor/status surfacing is a separate follow-up. Sidecars written before this change have no token and retain the old limitation.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the addition is backward-compatible; the schema version is unchanged and unknown fields were already ignored by older readers.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14288

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的作用

传统的 `runtime.json` sidecar 现在会在 Linux 上同时记录 PID 和一个不透明的进程启动标识；会话存活判定在标识可用时要求 PID 与标识同时匹配。旧 sidecar 仍然可以读取；标识不可用时回退到原有的 PID 存活检查，而不是把实际存活的会话误判为死亡。内置的卡住会话诊断流程也同步使用相同身份检查，并在枚举时排除僵尸进程。

## 为什么需要

会话退出后 sidecar 会按设计保留。如果它的 PID 后来被无关进程复用，`kill(pid, 0)` 仍会成功，旧的会话就会被报告为活跃。#14288 的第一层修复已经排除了僵尸进程；本变更通过携带 session registry 已有的“启动 ID + 进程启动时间”身份，关闭相关的 PID 复用误报。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

构造一个 `proc_start` 与当前进程标识不同的 runtime-status 记录：即使 PID 存活，会话也应判定为 inactive；标识匹配时应保持 active。缺少 `proc_start` 的旧记录，或本地标识不可读时，应保持原有存活判定行为。新增单元用例覆盖这些分支及新的磁盘字段。

### 证据（修改前后）

不适用——这是内部状态分类变更，没有用户可见输出变化。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

未在本地运行测试、构建、typecheck、lint 或格式检查；只执行了 `git diff --check`。本变更由 CI 验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：`/proc` 标识不可读时会降级为普通 PID 存活检查，因此这些系统无法获得额外保护；能够读到且不匹配时则判定为陈旧记录。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：暂停父进程导致的僵尸回收仍是 POSIX 固有行为，不做修改。doctor/status 的显式展示属于后续独立工作。本次变更前写入的 sidecar 没有标识，仍保留原有局限。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：新增字段向后兼容；schema 版本不变，旧读取方原本就会忽略未知字段。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14288

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): narrow sidebarless live-state polling to connected session (#16355)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Narrows `sidebarlessLiveStateWorkspaceCwds` in `App.tsx` so that when `sidebarOptions.enabled` is false, live-state polling targets only the workspace(s) associated with an active/connected session instead of every registered trusted workspace. On an idle welcome view (where `connection.sessionId` is absent), live-state polling is disabled completely.

## Why it's needed

Fixes #16355. When the Web Shell is embedded with `sidebar={false}` (such as in companion/embedded host modes), `App.tsx` previously selected all trusted workspaces unconditionally. This caused periodic 5-second `sessions/live-state` polling across all workspaces even while sitting on an idle welcome view with zero active sessions or turns, producing excessive background traffic (e.g., 54 requests / 30s across 9 idle workspaces).

By restricting `sidebarlessLiveStateWorkspaceCwds` to the connected session's workspace when active, the daemon prompt authority retain (#10989) is preserved for long-running tool calls while unneeded background polling across idle workspaces is eliminated.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the targeted unit test suite in `@qwen-code/web-shell`:
   ```bash
   pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell test client/App.test.tsx -t "polls prompt authority|avoids polling workspaces on an idle welcome view|polls the live workspace"
   ```
2. Confirm all 3 test cases pass:
   - When a normal session is connected with `sidebar={false}`, only its trusted workspace is polled.
   - On an idle welcome view (`sessionId: undefined`), `workspaceCwds` is empty and `enabled` is false.
   - When a live session is connected, only the live workspace is polled.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- **Before**: In `App.test.tsx`, rendering with `sidebar: false` passed `workspaceCwds: ['/tmp/project', '/tmp/live']` even when only `/tmp/project` was the connected session workspace. On an idle welcome view, all registered trusted workspaces were polled every 5s.
- **After**: With `sidebar: false` on an idle welcome view, `useWorkspaceSessionLiveState` receives `workspaceCwds: []` and `enabled: false`. When a session is active, only `['/tmp/project']` is queried.

### Tested on

| OS | Status | Notes |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | N/A | |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ | Windows 11, Node.js v22.18.0, pnpm 10.15.1 |
| 🐧 Linux | N/A | |

### Environment (optional)

- Unit tests via `vitest`

## Risk & Scope

- **Risk & Tradeoffs**: Low. The connected session's prompt authority retain introduced in #10989 remains fully active while a session is connected or running.
- **Not validated / out of scope**: Standalone Web Shell sidebar interactions (when `sidebarOptions.enabled` is true) are unchanged and remain governed by `WebShellSidebar`.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16355

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这次 PR 做了什么

收窄了 `App.tsx` 中的 `sidebarlessLiveStateWorkspaceCwds`：当 `sidebarOptions.enabled` 为 false 时，live-state 轮询仅针对当前存在已连接/展示会话的工作区，而不再无条件轮询所有已注册的受信任工作区。在没有会话的空闲欢迎视图（`connection.sessionId` 不存在）下，完全不启动工作区轮询。

## 为什么需要此改动

修复 #16355。当嵌入式 Web Shell 设置 `sidebar={false}`（如在伴生宿主环境中）时，`App.tsx` 原先会无条件选择所有受信任工作区，导致即使在空闲欢迎界面、没有任何会话运行的情况下，也会每 5 秒向所有工作区发起轮询请求（例如在 9 个空闲工作区下 30 秒产生 54 次请求）。

通过将轮询范围限定在当前活跃会话所在的工作区，既保留了 #10989 所需的 daemon prompt 权威状态守护，又彻底消除了空闲欢迎页及不相关工作区上的背景开销。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 `@qwen-code/web-shell` 对应单测：
```bash
pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell test client/App.test.tsx -t "polls prompt authority|avoids polling workspaces on an idle welcome view|polls the live workspace"
```

### 验证证据（改动前 vs 改动后）

- **改动前**：在 `sidebar: false` 且只连接单一会话时，仍会同时轮询 `['/tmp/project', '/tmp/live']`；在空闲欢迎页下同样每 5 秒发起全量轮询。
- **改动后**：空闲欢迎页下传递 `workspaceCwds: []` 且 `enabled: false`，不进行任何轮询；连接会话后仅精准轮询会话所在的工作区。

## 风险与范围

- **风险与权衡**：极低。#10989 在会话连接期间的指示器守护能力完全保留。
- **不在范围内**：当 `sidebarOptions.enabled` 为 true 时的侧边栏自有轮询逻辑保持不变。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #16355

</details>

prs.title: feat(channels): edit bound-session action templates on demand
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Redesigns the action-template editing experience in the Web Shell channel editor. Template-style (record) config fields now show only the entries the operator has actually configured, and new keys are added through a grouped picker in which every key carries a one-line explanation. Template values are edited in multi-line text areas with an explicit remove button per entry; clearing a value keeps the row in place while editing, and the existing save serializer still filters empty values so nothing invalid reaches the channel validators.

For the GitHub channel specifically, the picker is organized by binding role (Any role / review / verify / fix), the action-templates field moves into the bound-sessions panel next to its delivery switch, and adding templates is gated on that switch with a hint — the same pattern watch events already use. Stored rows stay editable and removable while the gate is closed. The editor dialog also gains a fullscreen toggle that resets when the dialog is reopened.

The key explanations and role groups are declared by the channel plugin itself through two new optional metadata fields on descriptor options, mirrored between the channel contract and the daemon SDK types (the existing type-mirror test guards them). Chinese translations cover every key — role-qualified spellings are generated from the base event texts — plus the group headers and new picker chrome; English reuses the plugin's own descriptions as the single source of truth. A new visuals scenario captures the editor against the production descriptor so the screenshots and future visual regressions use the real 80-key vocabulary.

## Why it's needed

The GitHub channel's bound-session action templates enumerate a closed vocabulary of 80 keys (20 event classes, each also spelled with three binding-role prefixes). The editor used to render every key as its own single-line input — a wall of 80 rows inside a dialog whose body is capped at roughly 650px — even though operators typically configure one or two keys. The only guidance was one dense paragraph mixing key syntax, role routing, and seven template variables; individual keys had no explanation, single-line inputs could not comfortably hold instruction templates of up to 2,000 code points, and the dialog offered no way to enlarge itself.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Web Shell → Channels → Configure GitHub on a daemon-managed channel. In the bound-sessions panel, the action-templates field should show an empty state and an "Add template…" picker, not 80 rows. With "Deliver To PR-Bound Sessions" off, the picker is disabled and a hint names the switch; turning it on unlocks adding.
2. Open the picker: keys are grouped under Any role / review / verify / fix, each with a one-line description. Add `review:watch:ci_failure` and `fix:comment`, type multi-line templates, save, and reopen — values round-trip exactly.
3. Clear one template's text and save: that key is absent from the stored config while the sibling survives. The trash button removes an entry outright. A stored key outside the descriptor vocabulary stays visible, editable, and removable.
4. Toggle the header fullscreen button: the dialog fills the viewport minus a small gutter, the body loses its height cap, and toggling back restores the compact size. Reopening the dialog starts compact again.
5. Switch the UI language to 中文: the field description, group headers, and per-key descriptions are all translated.
6. GitLab's action templates (the other record field) keep their required validation and descriptive labels under the new renderer; the shared message-routes field keeps its stored entries visible.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before — every vocabulary key rendered as its own single-line input (80 rows), one dense paragraph as the only help:

![Before: wall of 80 template inputs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-template-editor/01-before-dark.png)

After — empty state with the add picker in the bound-sessions panel; grouped picker with per-key descriptions; configured multi-line rows with remove buttons; fullscreen:

| Empty state | Grouped picker |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![After: empty state](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-template-editor/02-empty-dark.png) | ![After: grouped picker with descriptions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-template-editor/03-picker-dark.png) |

| Configured rows | Fullscreen |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![After: configured multi-line rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-template-editor/04-configured-dark.png) | ![After: fullscreen dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-template-editor/05-fullscreen-dark.png) |

Light theme (configured rows):

![After: light theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-template-editor/06-configured-light.png)

Screenshots are real Chromium renders from the repo's visuals harness (mock daemon HTTP, production GitHub descriptor), not a live-daemon session.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Local unit suites (vitest): 316/316 channel component tests including rewritten record interactions and new delete/gating/fullscreen/zh-CN cases; descriptor contract suites (SDK mirror, registry, GitHub plugin) green. Playwright E2E against the vite dev server with the mock daemon: the channels spec passes 4/4 including a new on-demand/fullscreen case (baseline run before the change failed as expected). Full `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` exit 0; prettier and ESLint clean.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the record renderer is generic and shared with GitLab's action templates and the message-routes field. Both are covered by the existing suites plus new cases (all green); stored keys the descriptor does not enumerate remain visible and removable rather than being silently dropped.
- Not validated / out of scope: live-daemon click-through (E2E uses the repo's mock-daemon harness); macOS/Windows; a searchable picker and per-template character counters are possible follow-ups, not included.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new option metadata is optional, existing plugins compile unchanged, and the draft/save contract is untouched — empty values are filtered by the existing serializer exactly as before.

Design docs: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/channel-action-template-editor-usability/docs/design/2026-11-05-channel-action-template-editor.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/channel-action-template-editor-usability/docs/design/2026-11-05-channel-action-template-editor.zh-CN.md)

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

重新设计了 Web Shell 渠道编辑器里动作模板的编辑体验。模板类（record）配置字段现在只显示 operator 实际配置了的条目，新键通过一个分组选择器添加，每个键都带一句话解释。模板值用多行文本框编辑，每条都有显式删除按钮；编辑期清空值会保留行，既有的保存序列化器仍会过滤空值，非法内容到不了渠道校验器。

具体到 GitHub 渠道：选择器按绑定角色分组（任意角色 / review / verify / fix）；动作模板字段移入绑定会话面板、紧挨投递开关；添加模板以该开关为前置条件并给出 hint——与监视事件已有的模式一致。门控关闭时已存行仍可编辑、可删除。编辑器对话框还新增了全屏切换，重新打开对话框时复位。

## 为什么需要

GitHub 渠道的绑定会话动作模板枚举了一个封闭词汇：80 个键（20 个事件类别，每个再带 3 个绑定角色前缀）。编辑器过去把每个键都渲染成独立的单行输入框——在一个内容区上限约 650px 的对话框里堆出 80 行——而 operator 通常只配置一两个键。唯一的说明是一段把键语法、角色路由、7 个模板变量混在一起的密集文字；每个键本身没有解释，单行输入框装不下最长 2,000 码点的指令模板，对话框也无法放大。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 打开 Web Shell → Channels → Configure GitHub（daemon 管理的渠道）。绑定会话面板里的动作模板字段应显示空态和「添加模板…」选择器，而不是 80 行。「投递到 PR 绑定会话」关闭时选择器禁用并有 hint 指明开关；打开后解锁添加。
2. 打开选择器：键按 任意角色 / review / verify / fix 分组，各带一句话描述。添加 `review:watch:ci_failure` 与 `fix:comment`，输入多行模板，保存后重新打开——值原样往返。
3. 清空某个模板文本后保存：该键从存储配置中消失，兄弟键保留。垃圾桶按钮直接删除条目。描述符词汇之外的已存键保持可见、可编辑、可删除。
4. 切换标题栏全屏按钮：对话框占满视口减去小边距，内容区解除高度上限，切回恢复紧凑尺寸。重新打开对话框从紧凑态开始。
5. 界面语言切到中文：字段描述、分组标题、逐键描述全部翻译。
6. GitLab 的动作模板（另一个 record 字段）在新渲染器下保持必填校验与自带说明的 label；共享的消息路由字段保持已存条目可见。

| :---: | :---: |
| ![改动后：已配置多行行](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-template-editor/04-configured-dark.png) | ![改动后：全屏对话框](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/channel-template-editor/05-fullscreen-dark.png) |

亮色主题（已配置行）：

prs.title: fix(web-shell): align welcome models and make UI language sessionless
prs.body:
## What this PR does

UI language changes from Settings and `/language ui` now persist through sessionless APIs. User and workspace scopes remain distinct, and workspace changes only synchronize the selected runtime's already-live channels. Welcome screens resolve a missing saved model through the existing authentication fallback so the displayed selection agrees with the first conversation.

## Why it's needed

A saved `qwen3.8-max` selection can outlive its catalog entry while the configured Token Plan catalog only contains `qwen3.8-max-preview`. The welcome screen previously displayed the stale model. Switching UI language sent a prompt, created a conversation, and attempted to reapply that stale selection, causing unknown-model errors. Without any configured credentials, the same action failed authentication and rolled back the language choice.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Start with a saved model absent from the selected provider's catalog and a valid preview entry. Confirm welcome and a new conversation select the same fallback model while the saved `model.name` stays unchanged. Registered models and explicit manual connections should retain their selection and endpoint.
- From a welcome screen with no configured credentials, change UI language through Settings and `/language ui`. Confirm the change persists without creating a conversation, selecting a model, sending a prompt, or changing output language.
- Check user and workspace scopes, including a secondary workspace. Only the requested settings scope should change. Unknown, untrusted, removed or draining workspaces and stale generations must not mutate primary or user settings.
- Confirm the project language route passes the SSH boundary and retains the existing local workspace-anchor settings ownership. Verify failed writes roll back the UI and explicit host language remains authoritative.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: real Web Shell with saved `max` and a preview-only catalog displayed `max`; changing UI language created a session, attempted to select `max`, and displayed two unknown-model errors. With no credentials, changing language attempted session creation and failed authentication.

After: Chromium against the final bundled daemon shows the preview model on welcome. A separately created real session reports `qwen3.8-max-preview(openai)` as well, while saved `model.name` remains `qwen3.8-max`. With no credentials, Settings and user/project `/language ui` changes succeed without session/model/prompt requests; the session catalog stays empty. Existing-session command descriptions switch locale, while output language settings and files stay unchanged. Secondary-workspace ownership and trust/generation failure paths are covered by route regression tests.

Local checks passed: repository build, final affected-package rebuild and bundle, repository typecheck, affected CLI/bridge/SDK/Web Shell/SSH/telemetry tests, changed-source lint and formatting, and independent source review. E2E details are posted separately.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js 23.11.0, isolated settings/runtime directories and local Chromium against the real daemon-served Web Shell. Fixtures use fake credentials and make no live model requests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: UI language persistence and live locale synchronization have separate outcomes; cold channels remain stopped and read settings at startup. Existing best-effort live refresh semantics are preserved.
- Not validated / out of scope: native Desktop/VS Code installation, real SSH hosts, real Token Plan authentication and model calls. Subscription feature changes and the origin of the stale saved model are outside this fix.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive workspace UI-language API; no configuration migration and no automatic rewrite of a fallback model to `model.name`. Existing Core fallback policy remains unchanged.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/welcome-model-and-language/docs/design/sessionless-welcome-settings.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/welcome-model-and-language/docs/design/sessionless-welcome-settings.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

User-reported desktop welcome model and UI-language errors; no public issue filed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

设置页和 `/language ui` 通过无会话接口保存 UI 语言。保留用户与工作区作用域，项目级变更只同步选定运行时已经运行的通道。欢迎页在已保存模型不在目录中时复用现有认证回退，使显示的模型与首次对话一致。

## 为什么需要

配置可能仍保存 `qwen3.8-max`，而 Token Plan 目录只有 `qwen3.8-max-preview`。欢迎页之前显示失效模型；切换 UI 语言会发送提示词、创建对话并重新应用失效选择，导致找不到模型的错误。没有配置凭据时，同样的操作会认证失败并回滚语言选择。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

- 保存一个在当前 provider 目录中不存在的模型，并保留有效 preview 条目。确认欢迎页与新对话选择相同的回退模型，且保存的 `model.name` 不变。已注册模型和显式手动连接应保留原有选择及端点。
- 在未配置凭据的欢迎页，通过设置和 `/language ui` 切 UI 语言。确认保存成功，不创建对话、选择模型、发送提示词或改变输出语言。
- 检查用户和工作区作用域，包括次工作区。只改变指定作用域配置；未知、不受信任、已移除、正在排空的工作区及旧 generation 不能修改主工作区或用户配置。
- 确认项目语言接口可以通过 SSH 边界，并沿用本地工作区锚点配置归属。保存失败时 UI 应回滚，显式宿主语言仍有控制权。

### 修改前后证据

修改前：真实 Web Shell 在保存 `max`、目录只有 preview 时显示 `max`；切 UI 语言会创建会话、尝试选择 `max`，并显示两条找不到模型的错误。没有凭据时则尝试创建会话并认证失败。

修改后：Chromium 访问最终 bundle，欢迎页显示 preview；另行创建的真实会话也报告 `qwen3.8-max-preview(openai)`，保存的 `model.name` 仍为 `qwen3.8-max`。没有凭据时，设置页和用户/项目级 `/language ui` 均成功，不请求会话、模型或提示词接口，会话目录保持为空。已有会话的命令描述可切换语言，输出语言配置和文件不变。次工作区归属及信任/generation 失败路径由路由回归测试覆盖。

本地检查已通过：仓库构建、最终受影响包重建与打包、仓库类型检查；涉及的 CLI/桥接/SDK/Web Shell/SSH/遥测测试；改动源码的 lint 与格式检查；独立源码审查。E2E 详情另发评论。

### 测试系统

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境

macOS、Node.js 23.11.0；隔离配置和运行时目录，以本地 Chromium 访问真实 daemon 提供的 Web Shell。fixture 使用假凭据，不请求真实模型。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：UI 语言保存与运行时语言同步有独立结果；冷通道保持停止，启动时再读配置。保留已有的尽力刷新语义。
- 未验证或范围外：原生 Desktop/VS Code 安装、真实 SSH 主机、真实 Token Plan 认证与模型请求。订阅功能和失效模型最初如何写入配置不在本次修复范围内。
- 兼容性与迁移：新增项目级 UI 语言接口；无需迁移，不会自动将回退模型写入 `model.name`，现有 Core 回退策略不变。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/welcome-model-and-language/docs/design/sessionless-welcome-settings.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/welcome-model-and-language/docs/design/sessionless-welcome-settings.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联问题

用户反馈的桌面欢迎页模型和 UI 语言错误，尚未创建公开 issue。

</details>

prs.title: perf(memory): move the main session's auto-memory guidance into a bundled skill
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The main session no longer carries the full auto-memory guidance in its system prompt. It now carries a short resident policy that is enough to save and use memory correctly on its own: the memory directories, handling of remember and forget requests, one line per memory type with the directory it belongs in, what not to save, the two save steps with the unchanged frontmatter template and the category names, deduplication, and when to read and verify memory. It ends with a pointer that tells the model to load a new bundled `auto-memory` skill once it decides to save or reorganize a memory.

The bundled `auto-memory` skill holds the full text of the guidance that was moved: each memory type with all examples, the category guide, what not to save, the keyword, usage-scenario and body rules with their bounds, team memory, when to access memory, trusting recall, and memory versus plans and tasks. The source constants stay the single source of truth: the extraction, Dream, User Dream, `/remember` and import agents still build their prompts from them, `buildManagedAutoMemoryPrompt` output is byte-identical for every argument shape, and a test asserts every line of every constant appears in the skill.

Which policy the main session gets is decided by the same bundled-reference resolver the Workflow and Agent tools use:

| Route | Main-session policy |
| --- | --- |
| `skill` | resident policy + pointer |
| `skill-via-tool-search` | resident policy + pointer + tool_search bridge sentence |
| `inline` (no way to load the skill) | full policy, as before |
| `withheld` (`skills.disabled` lists `auto-memory`, or the bundled layer is off) | resident policy only |

A refresh stores the policy inputs, and `Config.getAutoMemoryPrompt()` resolves the route each time it is read, against the Config it is read through (built once per route). That covers the session-start refresh, which runs before the tool registry exists, and a subagent whose tool policy leaves out `skill`: its derived Config has no skill manager (#12424), so it gets the full policy. The skill is listed only when managed auto-memory is enabled and recall is in legacy mode, hidden the same way as `generated-ui` otherwise; the daemon's skills catalog applies the same gate from the workspace settings.

Design doc: [English](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/auto-memory-skill/docs/design/2026-11-04-auto-memory-reference.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/auto-memory-skill/docs/design/2026-11-04-auto-memory-reference.zh-CN.md)

## Why it's needed

With the default `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory: true`, every request from every surface (Ink, OpenTUI, headless and SDK, ACP, and subagents that inherit it) carried a ~16k-character `# auto memory` section, about 45% of the main system prompt. The main model writes memory itself only in the few turns where the user explicitly asks to remember or forget something; the background extraction agent writes the rest with its own prompt. The detailed type guidance and examples were paid for on every request but used only in those few turns.

Measured policy size in characters (paths `/home/alice/.qwen/memories` and `/home/alice/.qwen/projects/-home-alice-work-app/memory`):

| Shape | Team off | Team on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Before (full policy) | 15,868 | 17,243 |
| Pointer route (default) | 4,686 | 5,470 |
| Pointer via tool_search | 4,804 | 5,588 |
| Withheld | 4,451 | 5,235 |
| Inline (no way to load the skill) | 15,868 | 17,243 |

The default session saves 11,182 characters (about 2.8k tokens) on every request. The cost is a 233-character entry in `<available_skills>` (`BUNDLED_LISTING_BUDGET` 6,800 → 7,050, rationale recorded in the test), and sessions that do save memory carry the ~14.6k-character skill body in history after loading it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Unit tests: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/skills src/memory/prompt.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts`. The new tests cover: the skill contains every line of each moved constant; moved anchors are absent from the resident policy and kept anchors present; the four routes and the size budget; the main-session policy per route and the listing gate in Config.
2. Wire check: run `qwen -p "hi"` before and after against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with `--openai-logging`, and diff the request. Expected: only the `# auto memory` section of the system prompt differs, ending with the pointer to the `auto-memory` skill; tools and other parameters are identical; the first user message gains the `auto-memory` listing entry.
3. Behavior: in a session, ask "Remember that I always use pnpm, never npm." Expected: the model loads the `auto-memory` skill, writes a `feedback` memory to the user memory directory with valid frontmatter, and adds a pointer to `MEMORY.md`. Ask an unrelated question in a fresh session: the skill is not loaded.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Wire capture of a default `qwen -p` request: system prompt 35,820 → 24,529 characters (measured on the first commit; the follow-up adds 114 resident characters). With HOME normalized, the only system-prompt difference is the memory section; tool declarations and request parameters are identical. The first user message grows by 257 characters (the listing entry).

Behavior eval with real models (Token Plan `qwen3.8-max` and `qwen3.8-flash`, headless `-p --yolo`, isolated HOME and project per run, 9 scenarios × 2 models × 3 runs × 2 arms = 108 runs). Each run was graded from the memory files on disk and the tool calls:

| Scenario | Before | After | After: skill loaded |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| s1 remember a personal preference (USER tier, `feedback`) | 6/6 | 6/6 | 6/6 |
| s2 remember a project freeze (PROJECT tier, absolute date) | 6/6 | 6/6 | 6/6 |
| s3 remember where bugs are tracked (`reference`) | 6/6 | 6/6 | 6/6 |
| s4 asked to remember something derivable from the code (should not save) | 6/6 | 6/6 | 0/6 |
| s5 update an existing memory (no duplicate) | 6/6 | 6/6 | 4/6 |
| s6 forget a memory (file and index entry removed) | 6/6 | 6/6 | 0/6 |
| s7 stale memory (check the code before answering) | 6/6 | 6/6 | 0/6 |
| s8 "don't use any memory" (no memory reads, answer ignores it) | 6/6 | 6/6 | 0/6 |
| s9 unrelated task (no skill load, no memory write) | 6/6 | 6/6 | 0/6 |

Save checks for s1–s3: right tier, valid frontmatter, correct `type`, a listed `category`, 2–6 keywords, 1–3 usage scenarios, and an index pointer. Both arms passed all of them. The skill was loaded on every explicit save and on none of the 30 runs where no save was needed.

Average input tokens per run:

| Runs | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No save needed (s4, s6–s9) | 63.7k (18.5k uncached) | 53.5k (16.2k uncached) |
| Save needed (s1–s3, s5) | 69.4k (17.7k uncached) | 88.7k (18.7k uncached) |

Save runs take one extra round to load the skill, and later requests in that run carry the skill body. Most of the increase is cache reads; uncached input grows by about 1k. Saves are rare turns; every other turn saves.

Local checks: core `tsc --noEmit` clean; `src/skills`, `src/memory/prompt.test.ts` and `src/config/config.test.ts` pass (2,014 tests) after rebasing on main; prettier and eslint clean on the changed files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 24, bundled `dist/cli.js` built from this branch and from its merge base for the before/after eval.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: when the model saves without loading the skill, keywords and body structure may be somewhat weaker. The resident policy keeps the frontmatter template, category names and body rules; write validation messages still cite the metadata bounds; background extraction and Dream still use the full rules. In the eval the skill was loaded on 22 of 24 save or update runs and all of them passed.
- Not validated / out of scope: structured recall (#12947) is unaffected, and the skill is not listed under it; this change only touches the default legacy path. The extraction, Dream, `/remember` and import prompts are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No setting changes. A user can list `auto-memory` in `skills.disabled` to keep only the resident policy.

Design doc: [English](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/auto-memory-skill/docs/design/2026-11-04-auto-memory-reference.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/auto-memory-skill/docs/design/2026-11-04-auto-memory-reference.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Closes #16291

Part of #12028 and #12781.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

主会话的 system prompt 不再携带完整的 auto-memory 指南，改为一段简短的常驻策略。仅凭这段策略就能正确保存和使用 memory，内容包括：memory 目录；如何处理“记住”和“忘掉”的请求；每种 memory 类型一行，并说明它应放在哪个目录；哪些内容不保存；保存的两个步骤，附上原样的 frontmatter 模板和 category 名称；去重；以及何时读取和核实 memory。策略末尾有一个指针，告诉模型在决定保存或整理 memory 时加载新的内置 skill `auto-memory`。

内置 `auto-memory` skill 收录被移走的指南全文：每种 memory 类型及全部示例、category 指南、哪些内容不保存、keyword / usage-scenario / 正文规则及其上下限、team memory、何时读取 memory、如何对待召回结果，以及 memory 与计划、任务的区别。源常量仍是唯一来源：抽取、Dream、User Dream、`/remember` 和导入 agent 依旧由它们构建 prompt；`buildManagedAutoMemoryPrompt` 在所有参数组合下的输出逐字节不变；测试断言每个常量的每一行都出现在 skill 中。

主会话拿到哪种策略，由 Workflow 和 Agent 工具使用的同一个内置参考解析器决定：

| 路由 | 主会话策略 |
| --- | --- |
| `skill` | 常驻策略 + 指针 |
| `skill-via-tool-search` | 常驻策略 + 指针 + tool_search 桥接句 |
| `inline`（没有任何途径加载 skill） | 完整策略，与改动前相同 |
| `withheld`（`skills.disabled` 列出 `auto-memory`，或关闭了 bundled 层） | 只有常驻策略 |

刷新时只保存策略的输入，`Config.getAutoMemoryPrompt()` 每次被读取时按读取它的那个 Config 解析路由（每种路由只构建一次）。这覆盖了两种情况：会话启动时的刷新早于工具注册表的创建；工具策略里没有 `skill` 的子 agent，它的派生 Config 没有 skill manager（#12424），因此拿到完整策略。只有开启 managed auto-memory 且召回处于 legacy 模式时才列出这个 skill，否则用与 `generated-ui` 相同的方式隐藏；daemon 的 skills 目录按工作区设置使用同一个开关。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/auto-memory-skill/docs/design/2026-11-04-auto-memory-reference.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/auto-memory-skill/docs/design/2026-11-04-auto-memory-reference.zh-CN.md)

## 为什么需要

默认 `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory: true` 时，每个界面（Ink、OpenTUI、headless 与 SDK、ACP，以及继承它的子 agent）的每次请求都带着约 16k 字符的 `# auto memory` 段，约占主 system prompt 的 45%。主模型自己写 memory 的轮次很少，大多是用户明确要求记住或忘掉某件事的时候；其余 memory 由后台抽取 agent 用它自己的 prompt 写入。详细的类型说明和示例每次请求都要付费，却只在这少数几轮用得上。

策略长度实测（单位为字符，路径为 `/home/alice/.qwen/memories` 与 `/home/alice/.qwen/projects/-home-alice-work-app/memory`）：

| 形态 | 未开 team | 开启 team |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 改动前（完整策略） | 15,868 | 17,243 |
| 指针路由（默认） | 4,686 | 5,470 |
| 经 tool_search 的指针 | 4,804 | 5,588 |
| withheld | 4,451 | 5,235 |
| inline（没有途径加载 skill） | 15,868 | 17,243 |

默认会话每次请求减少 11,182 字符（约 2.8k tokens）。代价是 `<available_skills>` 中多一个 233 字符的条目（`BUNDLED_LISTING_BUDGET` 从 6,800 调到 7,050，原因记录在测试中）；保存 memory 的会话在加载 skill 后，历史里会带着约 14.6k 字符的 skill 正文。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 单元测试：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/skills src/memory/prompt.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts`。新测试覆盖：skill 包含每个被移走常量的每一行；被移走的锚点不出现在常驻策略中，保留的锚点出现在常驻策略中；四种路由与体积预算；Config 中各路由下的主会话策略和列表开关。
2. 请求对比：分别用改动前后的版本，对任一 OpenAI 兼容端点运行 `qwen -p "hi"` 并加上 `--openai-logging`，对比请求。预期：system prompt 只有 `# auto memory` 段不同，且以指向 `auto-memory` skill 的指针结尾；工具和其他参数完全一致；第一条 user 消息多出 `auto-memory` 的列表条目。
3. 行为：在会话中说“Remember that I always use pnpm, never npm.”。预期：模型加载 `auto-memory` skill，把一条 `feedback` memory 写入用户 memory 目录，frontmatter 合法，并在 `MEMORY.md` 中加一条指针。在新会话中问一个无关问题：不加载这个 skill。

### 证据（改动前后）

默认 `qwen -p` 请求的抓包：system prompt 从 35,820 降到 24,529 字符（在第一个 commit 上测得；后续 commit 给常驻策略加了 114 字符）。把 HOME 统一后，system prompt 只有 memory 段不同；工具声明和请求参数完全一致。第一条 user 消息多 257 字符（列表条目）。

真实模型的行为评测（Token Plan 的 `qwen3.8-max` 和 `qwen3.8-flash`，headless `-p --yolo`，每次运行使用独立的 HOME 和项目目录，9 个场景 × 2 个模型 × 3 次 × 2 组 = 108 次）。每次运行依据磁盘上的 memory 文件和工具调用判定：

| 场景 | 改动前 | 改动后 | 改动后加载 skill |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| s1 记住个人偏好（USER 层级，`feedback`） | 6/6 | 6/6 | 6/6 |
| s2 记住项目冻结安排（PROJECT 层级，绝对日期） | 6/6 | 6/6 | 6/6 |
| s3 记住 bug 跟踪位置（`reference`） | 6/6 | 6/6 | 6/6 |
| s4 要求记住能从代码推出的内容（不应保存） | 6/6 | 6/6 | 0/6 |
| s5 更新已有 memory（不重复新建） | 6/6 | 6/6 | 4/6 |
| s6 忘掉某条 memory（文件和索引条目都删除） | 6/6 | 6/6 | 0/6 |
| s7 memory 已过时（先查代码再回答） | 6/6 | 6/6 | 0/6 |
| s8 “不要用任何 memory”（不读 memory，回答不受其影响） | 6/6 | 6/6 | 0/6 |
| s9 无关任务（不加载 skill，不写 memory） | 6/6 | 6/6 | 0/6 |

s1–s3 的保存检查：层级正确、frontmatter 合法、`type` 正确、`category` 在列表内、2–6 个 keyword、1–3 个 usage scenario，并且索引中有指针。两组全部通过。每次明确要求保存时都加载了 skill；不需要保存的 30 次运行中一次都没有加载。

每次运行的平均输入 token：

| 运行 | 改动前 | 改动后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 不需要保存（s4、s6–s9） | 63.7k（未缓存 18.5k） | 53.5k（未缓存 16.2k） |
| 需要保存（s1–s3、s5） | 69.4k（未缓存 17.7k） | 88.7k（未缓存 18.7k） |

需要保存的运行多一轮加载 skill，之后的请求还要带上 skill 正文。增加的部分大多是缓存读取，未缓存输入只多约 1k。保存是少数回合，其他回合都在节省。

本地检查：core `tsc --noEmit` 通过；rebase 到 main 之后，`src/skills`、`src/memory/prompt.test.ts` 和 `src/config/config.test.ts` 全部通过（2,014 个测试）；改动文件的 prettier 和 eslint 检查通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Linux，Node 24；改动前后评测分别使用本分支及其 merge base 构建的 `dist/cli.js`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：模型不加载 skill 就保存时，keyword 和正文结构可能弱一些。常驻策略保留了 frontmatter 模板、category 名称和正文规则；写入校验的提示仍引用元数据上下限；后台抽取和 Dream 仍按完整规则工作。评测中 24 次保存或更新运行里有 22 次加载了 skill，全部通过。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：结构化召回（#12947）不受影响，也不会在其下列出这个 skill；本改动只涉及默认的 legacy 路径。抽取、Dream、`/remember` 和导入的 prompt 均未改变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无，没有改动任何设置。用户可以在 `skills.disabled` 中列出 `auto-memory`，只保留常驻策略。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/auto-memory-skill/docs/design/2026-11-04-auto-memory-reference.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/feat/auto-memory-skill/docs/design/2026-11-04-auto-memory-reference.zh-CN.md)，两个版本内容完整且同步。

Closes #16291

属于 #12028 和 #12781。

auto_merge.commit_title: perf(memory): move the main session's auto-memory guidance into a bundled skill (#16303)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* perf(memory): move the main session's auto-memory guidance into a bundled skill

The main session's `# auto memory` system-prompt section was 16,140 of
35,792 characters on every request, while the main model writes memories
on only a few turns. The session now gets a resident policy (directories
and routing, one line per type, what not to save, the two save steps with
the frontmatter template and category names, deduplication, reading and
verifying memories) plus a pointer to a new bundled `auto-memory` skill
that carries the full type guidance with examples, the metadata rules,
team memory and the persistence section.

The route reuses resolveBundledReferenceRoute: pointer, pointer via
tool_search, the full policy where no skill can be loaded, and the
resident policy alone when the user disabled the skill. The policy is
rebuilt once the tool registry exists, since the session-start memory
refresh runs before it. The skill is listed only with managed
auto-memory on.

The extraction, Dream, /remember and import agents keep the full
constants; buildManagedAutoMemoryPrompt output is unchanged. A two-way
anchor test pins every constant line into SKILL.md and keeps the moved
text out of the resident policy.

Default sessions send 4,572 instead of 15,868 characters for this
section (about 2.8k fewer tokens per request). The bundled listing grows
by 233 characters; its budget moves from 6,800 to 7,050.

Refs #16291

* fix(memory): resolve the auto-memory route per reader and keep the daemon catalog working

The daemon's skills catalog builds its SkillManager on a Config shim
without isSkillEnabled. The bundled auto-memory skill is in core's bundled
directory, so the conditional-skill check called it, threw, and returned
an uninitialized catalog. The shim now answers it from the workspace's
managed auto-memory setting.

The main-session policy was built once on the session Config, so every
derived Config inherited its pointer: a subagent without the Skill tool
(no skill manager, #12424) was told to load a skill it cannot reach. The
policy now keeps its inputs and resolves the route in getAutoMemoryPrompt
for the Config that reads it, built once per route. That also replaces
the post-registry rebuild and follows Skill tool reachability between
refreshes.

- List auto-memory only under legacy recall; by-name lookup uses the same
  conditional set as the listing.
- Put back two index rules the resident policy had lost: MEMORY.md has no
  frontmatter, and lines past the index limit are truncated.
- Remove MemoryManager.buildAutoMemoryPrompt, which had no callers.
- Fix the getAutoMemoryPrompt docblock, read SKILL.md once in its test,
  and update the design doc and measured lengths.

Refs #16291

* fix(memory): load the auto-memory reference without an approval prompt

Private memory writes are auto-allowed, but the Skill tool asks by default,
so in the default approval mode every memory save began with a confirmation
to load the reference. The Skill tool now allows the call when the name
resolves to the bundled `auto-memory` (read-only text, no allowedTools, no
hooks); a same-named project, user or extension skill still asks.

Also share the memory tier lines between the full and resident policies,
and name the skill through one constant in `skills/types.ts`, used by the
skill manager, the Skill tool and the daemon's skills catalog.

prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node.js v24.18.0；本地源码构建和 package 级 Vitest 测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：混合模式会在每个普通工具描述中增加一段简短的嵌套调用声明，使 prompt 略微增大；完整 schema 不会在 `exec` 描述中重复。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未进行真实 provider 的交互式运行，也未在 Windows/Linux 本地执行；支持平台由 CI 覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：`tools.codeModeOnly` 已移除。请将 `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` 替换为 `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #10377。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): stop forcing tool_choice "required" on strict OpenAI-compatible backends
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a per-model capability, `supportsForcedToolChoice` (default `true`), that lets an OpenAI-compatible endpoint decline forced tool calls. When set to `false`, the Chat Completions wire no longer carries `tool_choice: "required"` for structured-output side queries, so endpoints that reject the field (Apple Foundation Models' `fm serve` is the reported case) stop returning 500 on session titles, follow-up suggestions, permission classification, memory selection and subagent generation. The value is declared in the provider's `generationConfig` (or `model.generationConfig` in settings) and flows through the existing model-resolution pipeline; the structured-output fallback that parses a JSON object out of ordinary prose already exists and becomes reachable for these endpoints. Qwen OAuth hot model switches also update the capability and its source on the existing live configuration, preventing the previous model's setting from leaking.

## Why it's needed

Before this change, structured side queries unconditionally send `tool_choice: "required"` on the Chat Completions wire. Endpoints that reject forced tool selection return an error for every such query, even when ordinary model responses work. The reported `fm serve` endpoint returns `500 An unsupported generation guide was used.` This change adds an explicit per-model capability setting, following the existing provider capability approach, and makes the existing JSON fallback available. Schema validation still checks the result. The restriction that sends `response_format: json_schema` only to the official OpenAI endpoint is unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Reproduce the failure before the change with any strict OpenAI-compatible backend that rejects `tool_choice: "required"` (the report used `fm serve` on macOS with `fastModel: openai:system\^@http://localhost:1976/v1`): with a trivial prompt, session-title or follow-up-suggestion calls fail with the 500 above. Declare `"generationConfig": { "supportsForcedToolChoice": false }` for that model and repeat: the requests no longer carry `tool_choice`, and structured side queries recover JSON objects from the response text. With the field absent or `true`, request bodies are unchanged; the DashScope thinking suppression and the `NONE` path keep their existing behavior.

When switching Qwen OAuth models, verify that an explicit opt-out is cleared when the selected model leaves it unspecified, and that switching to an opted-out model applies the flag immediately. The same live configuration object should reflect the selected model and its configuration source.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before the model-switch fix, all five new regressions failed: four value transitions and independent source attribution. After the fix, 1,416/1,416 tests pass across the five focused core files, plus 67/67 CLI settings tests. Removing the opt-out diagnostic fails both suppression cases; limiting the guard to DashScope fails the non-DashScope case while the DashScope case stays green. Restoring the exact production source passes both cases. Build, bundle, typecheck, targeted ESLint and formatting checks pass. The current follow-up also asserts that the schema tool remains in the final request: removing it makes both opt-out cases fail, and restoring the exact source passes both. After syncing with main, the previously missing CI budget helper runs successfully and its two tests pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux: build, typecheck, targeted suites. The `fm serve` live flow is macOS-only and was not run; the reporter is better placed to re-verify it.

### Environment (optional)

Node 24.20.0, package-level Vitest. The global `qwen` CLI is unavailable, so model-switch reproduction and verification use the documented test-script fallback. No live endpoint or full CLI E2E result is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: with the flag `false` on an endpoint that does support forced tool choice, the model may skip the tool call; side queries are schema-validated, so most consumers fail visibly (invalid results raise `Invalid side query response`) and the permission classifier fails closed to manual approval — the `{}` fallback only survives when the consumer schema accepts an empty object. Preferable to the current hard 500; pinned by tests.
- Not validated / out of scope: live `fm serve` verification (macOS-only); the Responses wire and the Anthropic wire still force tool use and are documented non-goals; no hostname auto-detection; no retry-on-500. The forked-query cache path retains its existing plain-JSON parser; aligning it with the structured JSON query fallback is deferred.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; default behavior is byte-identical for existing configurations.

Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-10-11-forced-tool-choice-capability.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-11-forced-tool-choice-capability.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13807

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

在修改前，用任何拒绝 `tool_choice: "required"` 的严格 OpenAI 兼容后端复现故障（报告使用 macOS 上的 `fm serve`，`fastModel: openai:system\^@http://localhost:1976/v1`）：一个简单提示词下，会话标题或追问建议调用会以上述 500 失败。为该模型声明 `"generationConfig": { "supportsForcedToolChoice": false }` 后重复：请求不再携带 `tool_choice`，且 结构化旁路查询能从响应文本中解析出 JSON 对象。字段缺省或为 `true` 时，请求体保持不变；DashScope 的 thinking 抑制与 `NONE` 路径保持原有行为。

切换 Qwen OAuth 模型时，验证选中未声明该能力的模型会清除原有退出设置，而切换到退出强制选择的模型会立即应用该值。现有活配置对象应反映选中模型的取值与来源。

### 证据（修复前后）

模型切换修复前，五个新增回归用例全部失败：四个取值转换与独立的来源归属用例。修复后，五个聚焦 core 文件的 1,416/1,416 个测试及 CLI settings 的 67/67 个测试全部通过。删除退出诊断会使两个抑制用例失败；把 guard 限制为仅 DashScope 生效会使非 DashScope 用例失败，而 DashScope 用例仍通过。恢复完全相同的生产源码后，两个用例均通过。构建、bundle、typecheck、针对性 ESLint 与格式检查均通过。当前跟进还断言最终请求保留 schema 工具：删除它会使两个退出用例失败，恢复完全相同的源码后两个用例均通过。同步 main 后，先前缺失的 CI 预算检查程序可正常运行，其两个测试也通过。

Linux：构建、typecheck、聚焦套件。`fm serve` 实机流程仅限 macOS，未运行；由报告者复验更合适。

### 环境（可选）

Node 24.20.0，包级 Vitest。全局 `qwen` CLI 不可用，因此模型切换复现和验证采用文档规定的测试脚本替代路径；不宣称已完成真实端点或完整 CLI E2E 验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：在支持强制工具选择的端点上把开关设为 `false` 时，模型可能跳过工具调用；旁路查询会做 schema 校验，无效结果会显式失败，权限分类器按失败关闭原则转为人工批准。只有使用方 schema 接受空对象时才会保留 `{}`。这一回退不保证一定得到可用对象。
- 未验证/超出范围：`fm serve` 实机验证（仅 macOS）；Responses wire 与 Anthropic wire 仍然强制工具调用，已作为明确的非目标记录；无主机名自动探测；无 500 重试。fork 查询缓存路径保留既有的纯 JSON 解析器，与结构化 JSON 查询回退统一解析暂缓处理。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无；现有配置的默认行为逐字节一致。
