prs.title: feat(cli): add semantic statusline colors and live footer preview
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Give built-in status-line items four consistent active-theme colors: project/Git, model/reasoning, context/tokens, and session metadata. Separators stay neutral, and disabling theme colors removes semantic coloring.

Keep the actual input and footer visible while `/statusline` is open, and preview every selection immediately through the saved status line's rendering path. Remove the separate in-dialog preview. The picker owns input while open, including mouse focus and paste; Enter saves once, and Esc discards the draft and restores the previous preset, command, or disabled configuration.

## Why it's needed

Using one accent color for every item makes unrelated information difficult to scan. The old in-dialog preview also hides the real input/footer and does not reflect the saved status line's available width or wrapping. In-place preview makes the result visible before saving without persisting intermediate changes, consistently in Ink and OpenTUI.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In both Ink and OpenTUI, open `/statusline` with a saved preset. Confirm the picker is above the still-visible input and footer, there is no internal Preview section, and toggling items or Use theme colors updates the real footer immediately. Check all four categories; same-category items should match and separators should remain neutral.
2. Press Enter after a change. Expect one save confirmation and the same footer content, wrapping, and colors as the preview. Reopen, change options, and cancel with Esc; expect the original configuration without a settings write. If search is active, the first Esc clears it and the next cancels. Repeat cancellation from custom-command and disabled status-line configurations, preserving custom ANSI colors and an explicit hide-context setting.
3. Resize to 80×24 and 40×20, select enough items to wrap, and navigate to the final item. Expect a usable compact picker, visible input/footer, and the existing two-row status-line limit without overlap. Switching between Qwen Dark and Qwen Light should repaint the category colors without restarting; NoColor should leave the preset footer uncolored.
4. While configuring, click the visible inactive input, type, and bracketed-paste text. The picker alone should receive typing, the input must remain unchanged, and no prompt should submit. After cancellation, ordinary typing and paste should work again.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Interactive tmux testing reproduced the issue with the global 0.26.5 CLI and verified the local bundle in both renderers. Nonessential picker rows are omitted in these layout excerpts.

Before: the picker contains its own preview, and the real input/footer disappears.

```text
Configure Status Line
...
Preview
➜ workspace · statusline-model · v0.26.5
```

After: there is no internal preview; the real input and footer remain beneath the picker. This excerpt is from the final OpenTUI mouse/paste verification, where the input remained empty.

```text
Configure Status Line
...
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
>   Type your message or @path/to/file
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ➜ workspace · statusline-model · Context 100% left · 0 total in · v0.26.5 · 1.0k window
  ⏸ Ask permissions (shift + tab to cycle)
```

ANSI captures confirmed that the previous uniform Qwen Dark accent `(203,166,247)` becomes project `(166,227,161)`, model `(203,166,247)`, context `(137,180,250)`, and session `(249,226,175)`. Theme switching, save/cancel, command/null restoration, narrow wrapping, and input ownership passed. An independent test engineer's E2E report is posted separately on this PR.

Local regression checks passed: full build and typecheck, reviewed CLI build and bundle, 1,236 unique affected unit tests with one existing skip, all 11 native status-line scenarios, native input focus checks at widths 40/80 with eight normal submissions, and two interactive integration tests per renderer. Changed-file lint/formatting, diff checks, and bilingual design-link validation also passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS terminal/tmux; the global 0.26.5 CLI for baseline reproduction, and the locally built bundle under Node for Ink and Bun for strict OpenTUI. Tests used isolated workspace/home/runtime settings, no sandbox and no model requests; user-global settings were not modified.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: keeping the composer mounted requires strict picker input ownership and a bounded height budget. Keyboard, mouse, paste, resize, and save/cancel paths were verified in both renderers, with additional native OpenTUI regression coverage.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux were not tested locally. Preserve current main's real status-line placement below the input and its two-row limit; this is not a global footer redesign. Unrelated OpenTUI NoColor UI chrome is outside this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no new persisted settings, dependency changes, or migration. Custom-command output semantics are unchanged after cancellation.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and scope.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8363

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次变更

为内置状态栏项提供四组一致的当前主题色：项目/Git、模型/推理、上下文/token，以及会话元数据。分隔符保持中性色，关闭主题色后移除语义着色。

打开 `/statusline` 时保留真实输入框和页脚，每次选择都立即通过已保存状态栏的渲染路径预览。移除对话框内部的独立预览。配置期间由选择器独占输入，包括鼠标聚焦和粘贴；Enter 只保存一次，Esc 丢弃草稿并恢复之前的 preset、command 或禁用配置。

## 为什么需要

所有项使用同一种强调色，让不同信息难以快速区分。旧的框内预览还会隐藏真实输入框/页脚，不能反映保存后状态栏的可用宽度或换行方式。原位预览让用户在保存前看到结果，不持久化中间变更，并保持 Ink 与 OpenTUI 行为一致。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 Ink 和 OpenTUI 中，从已保存的 preset 打开 `/statusline`。确认选择器位于仍然可见的输入框和页脚上方，没有内部 Preview 区域，切换条目或 Use theme colors 会立即更新真实页脚。检查四类信息：同类颜色应一致，分隔符应保持中性色。
2. 修改后按 Enter，应仅出现一次保存提示，保存后的页脚内容、换行和颜色与预览一致。重新打开、修改选项并按 Esc 取消，应恢复原配置而不写入设置。有搜索内容时，第一次 Esc 清空搜索，第二次取消。再从自定义 command 和禁用状态栏配置重复取消测试，确认恢复自定义 ANSI 色并保留显式隐藏上下文指示器的设置。
3. 调整为 80×24 和 40×20，选中足够多的条目使其换行，并导航至最后一个条目。紧凑选择器应可用，输入框/页脚保持可见，状态栏遵循现有两行上限且不重叠。切换 Qwen Dark 与 Qwen Light 应无需重启就刷新分类颜色；NoColor 下 preset 页脚应无颜色。
4. 配置期间点击可见但不活跃的输入框，键入并进行 bracketed paste。只有选择器应接收键入，输入框内容不变且不提交 prompt。取消后普通键入和粘贴应恢复正常。

### 证据（修改前后）

交互式 tmux 测试使用全局 0.26.5 CLI 复现问题，并在两种渲染器中验证本地 bundle。以下布局摘录省略了无关选择器行。

修改前：选择器包含自己的预览，真实输入框/页脚消失。

```text
Configure Status Line
...
Preview
➜ workspace · statusline-model · v0.26.5
```

修改后：没有内部预览，真实输入框和页脚保留在选择器下方。该摘录来自最终 OpenTUI 鼠标/粘贴验证，输入框始终为空。

```text
Configure Status Line
...
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
>   Type your message or @path/to/file
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ➜ workspace · statusline-model · Context 100% left · 0 total in · v0.26.5 · 1.0k window
  ⏸ Ask permissions (shift + tab to cycle)
```

ANSI 捕获确认：原先统一的 Qwen Dark 强调色 `(203,166,247)` 变为项目 `(166,227,161)`、模型 `(203,166,247)`、上下文 `(137,180,250)`、会话 `(249,226,175)`。主题切换、保存/取消、command/null 恢复、窄屏换行和输入归属检查全部通过。独立测试工程师的 E2E 报告将作为单独评论附在本 PR。

本地回归检查通过：完整 build 和 typecheck、审查后的 CLI build 和 bundle、1,236 个去重后的受影响单元测试（另有一个已有 skip）、全部 11 个原生状态栏场景、40/80 列原生输入聚焦检查及八次正常提交，以及每种渲染器各两个交互集成测试。变更文件 lint/格式、diff 检查和双语设计链接验证也通过。

### 已测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS 终端/tmux；用全局 0.26.5 CLI 复现基线，用本地构建的 bundle 在 Node 下验证 Ink、在 Bun 下验证严格 OpenTUI。测试隔离 workspace/home/runtime 设置，不使用 sandbox、不发送模型请求，也未修改用户全局设置。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：保留 composer 挂载要求选择器严格独占输入，并为其限制高度。两种渲染器的键盘、鼠标、粘贴、缩放及保存/取消路径均已验证，另补充了原生 OpenTUI 回归覆盖。
- 未验证或范围外：Windows/Linux 未在本地测试。保留当前 main 中真实状态栏位于输入框下方的位置及两行上限，不进行全局页脚重设计。无关的 OpenTUI NoColor UI chrome 不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无；不新增持久化设置、不修改依赖、不需要迁移。取消后自定义 command 的输出语义保持不变。

设计：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包括决策、约束、验收标准和范围。

## 关联 Issue

修复 #8363。

</details>

prs.title: feat(serve): allow configuring the Conversations working-directory root
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `--conversations-dir` to `qwen serve` and `qwen daemon start`, with `QWEN_CONVERSATIONS_DIR` for launch environments and user-level `.env` files. Embedded launchers can use `ServeOptions.conversationsDir`. The explicit CLI/API value wins over the environment; omission preserves `~/Documents/Qwen Code/Conversations`.

The selection is fixed at daemon startup. Project environment files, top-level `settings.json` `env` at every scope, reloads, and session requests cannot redirect it. Explicit values must be nonempty, fully qualified absolute paths without NUL; invalid syntax fails before listening without fallback. Directory creation and filesystem acceptance remain lazy for both configured and default roots.

Standalone and Live retain their shared Conversations runtime and deterministic private session children. Current discovery records retain the selected root across `daemon restart`, including when the restarting shell's environment changes; older records continue resolving from environment/default. Automatic update relaunch also receives the pinned selection. Intentional reconfiguration uses stop followed by start with the new value.

This PR requests maintainer review of naming and semantics; automated triage is not approval. Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/135847076ff06dce326a3d4e92fc89f3377f1672/docs/design/conversations-working-directory-root.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/135847076ff06dce326a3d4e92fc89f3377f1672/docs/design/conversations-working-directory-root.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

Containers can place working files on persistent volumes independently of OS home. Mounting the default path or changing home remain valid alternatives. `QWEN_HOME` selects global Qwen configuration, while `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` and `advanced.runtimeOutputDir` select runtime storage; neither selects this working root.

Working files and shared root configuration stay under the selected Conversations tree. Transcripts and sidecars remain in runtime-base storage keyed by canonical Conversations cwd. Deletion journals and stable Live discovery retain their home-based locations. Persisting only one storage category does not preserve the others.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start without an override and check health: the unused default root should remain absent. Select a custom root through the environment, then provide a different CLI root: the explicit option should win. Empty, relative, and unexpanded-tilde values should fail before listening.
2. Supply a user-level `.env` root and competing project `.env`/`settings.env` values. Create a standalone session and confirm its actual shell cwd and written file are in the selected private child. Registering that root or child should remain rejected; an unrelated workspace should still register.
3. Restart with the same home, runtime base, and canonical root; list/load the session and read the original file. Separately use `daemon start` and `daemon restart` with a changed ambient root and confirm the recorded selection wins.

Validation passed: **520 focused tests**, **107 CI-wiring metatests**, **8 Linux process E2E cases**, repository build, typecheck, bundle, startup bundle closure checks, and lint. The process suite is selected by the no-AK integration CI gate. **Full `npm run preflight` did not pass.** Clean installation, repository-wide formatting/lint, build, and typecheck completed. The unchanged Browser Use missing-runtime test failed because ambient `NODE_PATH` supplied a global `playwright-core` after the fixture deleted its staged dependency. The same isolated case passed with `NODE_PATH` unset, without changing source or assertions. After diagnosing that failure, the remaining workspace test run was stopped; this preflight invocation did not reach its subsequent script-test and final bundle-closure stages. The 107 CI-wiring tests and the earlier bundle-closure check passed separately.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the unmodified source launcher rejected the new flag; isolated helper checks confirmed that the environment variable was ignored and the existing default remained lazy. No installed global `qwen` was available, and the baseline did not exercise a usable daemon or recovery.

After: the fresh bundle passed all eight process cases: ACP shell cwd/files, same-root history restoration, project-injection rejection, and discovery-backed restart preservation. No real model request was made. Screenshots are N/A: this changes headless deployment configuration, with command/API evidence. Linux, Node.js 24.19.0, bundle, isolated temporary home/config/runtime/work directories, loopback synthetic credentials.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changing the canonical root changes history discovery/storage namespace and shared root configuration. Existing ownership, permissions, identity, direct-child, link/reparse, writer-lease, ordinary-workspace isolation, and recovery checks remain in force, with their existing platform limits.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows runtime behavior, Live voice, pending-deletion-journal recovery, and actual automatic-update relaunch were not exercised end to end. Update handoff has unit coverage; the prior focused verification did not run complete shared-runtime/recovery suites. No browser/per-session selector, global workspace policy, configurable locks, or migration is added.

Resolve pending recovery against the original root and stop all its writers before switching; changing roots does not repair recovery failures or guarantee old-history visibility.

prs.title: fix(cli): honor system settings env overrides only for administrator-controlled paths
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH` and `QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_DEFAULTS_PATH` were honored regardless of who owned the file they pointed at, so a user-owned file could stand in for the system layer. This adds a trust gate at the single place where both paths resolve: Unix, `lstatSync` (symlinks are not followed) — the override is honored only for a regular file with `uid === 0`; Windows, the normalized path (lowercased, `/` → `\`, `..` segments popped) must stay inside `C:\ProgramData\qwen-code\`; any doubt fails closed to the platform default — absent file, directory, symlink, non-root owner, stat error. A rejected override now also leaves a one-shot warning naming the variable, the configured path, and the reason, so the fallback is no longer silent. The variable still lets an administrator redirect the system layer, but only to a location the administrator controls — the defense-in-depth option from the maintainer call in #13513.

## Why it's needed

I ran into this while designing managed installs: an elevated setup writes the protected system path, the CLI runs unprivileged — and the "system" layer only means something if the user cannot forge it. A user who controls the environment variable could point it at a home-directory file and win the precedence over every managed setting. #13513 has a concrete v0.24.7 reproduction and an independently verified root-cause chain.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The whole behavior of this change is "fail closed on any doubt", so reproduce it on both sides. On macOS/Linux, from the repository root (Node ≥ 22, after `pnpm install`):

```
echo '{"layer":"user-owned-fixture"}' > /tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json
pnpm exec esbuild packages/cli/src/config/storage-paths-lite.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=/tmp/spl.cjs
node -e 'process.env.QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH="/tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json"; console.log(require("/tmp/spl.cjs").getSystemSettingsPath())'
```

On this branch the command prints the one-shot warning and resolves the platform default; on `origin/main` the same command honors the override (no warning). For the `main` side, swap the bundle input with `git show origin/main:packages/cli/src/config/storage-paths-lite.ts > /tmp/spl-main.ts` and bundle that file instead. The root-owned branch (skipped on non-root hosts) executes in a Linux container run as root — command and output under Evidence. Windows is covered by the 14-case path-normalizer table in `storage-paths-lite.test.ts` plus the live Windows run in Tested on below. Unit suite: `cd packages/cli && pnpm exec vitest run src/config/storage-paths-lite.test.ts` — 70 tests: the fixture cases (absent / directory / symlink / user-owned / root-owned when root), the normalizer table, and the one-shot warning behavior (second rejection stays quiet).

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Before — `origin/main` (macOS, user-owned fixture):**

```
$ git show origin/main:packages/cli/src/config/storage-paths-lite.ts > /tmp/spl-main.ts
$ pnpm exec esbuild /tmp/spl-main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=/tmp/spl-main.cjs
$ node -e 'process.env.QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH="/tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json"; console.log(require("/tmp/spl-main.cjs").getSystemSettingsPath())'
/tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json
```

The user-owned file is honored as the system layer, with no warning.

**After — this branch (macOS, same fixture):**

```
$ pnpm exec esbuild packages/cli/src/config/storage-paths-lite.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=/tmp/spl.cjs
$ node -e 'process.env.QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH="/tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json"; console.log(require("/tmp/spl.cjs").getSystemSettingsPath())'
QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH is set to "/tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json", which is not a regular root-owned file, so the platform default is used instead.
/Library/Application Support/QwenCode/settings.json
```

**Root-owned — Linux container as root (Node v22.23.3), where the `chown`-based branch executes instead of skipping:**

```
$ docker run --rm -v $PWD:/src:ro node:22-bookworm-slim bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p /work; tar -C /src --exclude=node_modules --exclude=.git -cf - . | tar -C /work -xf -; cd /work; corepack enable; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; cd packages/cli; CI=1 pnpm exec vitest run src/config/storage-paths-lite.test.ts --reporter=verbose --coverage.enabled=false'
 ✓ ... > warns once when a user-owned override is rejected, and stays quiet after 1ms
 ✓ ... > fails closed for an override that is not a root-owned regular file 0ms
 ✓ ... > honors an override only while the file it names is root-owned 0ms
 ⎯⎯⎯⎯
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  69 passed | 1 skipped (70)
```

The single skip is the Windows warning case, which only runs on a real Windows host — it ran (and passed) in the Windows verification below.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

macOS (darwin-arm64): user-owned / symlink / directory / absent fixtures, the 14-case Windows normalizer table, and the one-shot warning — all on the host. Linux: `node:22-bookworm-slim` container run **as root**, so the `chown`-based root-owned fixture branch that is skipped on ordinary hosts actually executes. Windows (UTM Win11 ARM VM, node 22.23.3): the 8 directly-affected cli spec files ran live — settings.test.ts and storage-paths-lite.test.ts (including the Windows-only warning case) fully green; the 6 config/serve files that assert on the system-settings layer fail 78 tests — their fixtures stub the Unix trust semantics (root-owned lstat), while the win32 gate is the documented fail-closed path check inside C:\ProgramData\qwen-code, so temp fixtures are rejected by design: a test-suite Windows-compatibility gap, not a runtime behavior change; tsc --noEmit at 0.

Re-validated at the current head `390684c30`, which is test-only (12 changed files: the 8 spec files below migrated from temp fixtures to the trust-gate pattern, plus 4 helper/e2e tweaks — no production change). I re-ran those suites on all three OSes and found **no new failures** in `settings-cache`, `fast-path`, `fast-path-open`, `workspace-models`, `run-qwen-serve`, `workspace-qualified-rest`, `hooks-command-reload`, or `write-with-backup`; every failure present is pre-existing and unrelated to this PR. macOS: no new failures — the few tests that initially appeared new under the 3-leg concurrent load passed in an isolated re-run, and some pre-existing failures now pass (e.g. `settings-cache`, `fast-path`, `workspace-qualified-rest`). Linux (`node:22-bookworm-slim`, node 22): no failures in the changed files. Windows (UTM Win11 ARM VM, node 22): the changed files show the identical 133-test pre-existing failure set as the pre-migration baseline (name-level, 0 new / 0 gone).

### Environment (optional)

macOS 26.6.2, darwin-arm64, Node v26.5.0, pnpm 11.24.0 (host); docker `node:22-bookworm-slim`, Linux, Node v22.23.3, process user `root` (container); UTM Win11 ARM VM, Windows 11 (WinOnArm x64), Node 22.23.3 from the CLI bundle (Windows focused run).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Unix honors only `uid === 0` — intentional: a managed install that writes the system file as a non-root administrator account falls back to the platform default; that is the accepted trust-model trade-off (fail-closed is preferred over honoring a file with unverifiable ownership). The Windows check is a normalized path-prefix test inside `C:\ProgramData\qwen-code\`, not an ACL/ownership check — chosen deliberately (the form #13513 allowed; `ProgramData` is ACL-protected on a stock install; ACL verification is separate scope).
- Not validated / out of scope: root-owned on host machines (container only). The Windows live run is done (see Tested on); its 78 failing system-layer tests are a test-suite Windows-compatibility gap (fixtures stub Unix trust semantics), not a runtime behavior change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: managed scenarios whose system settings file is not root-owned (Unix) or not inside `C:\ProgramData\qwen-code\` (Windows) stop applying — intentionally, with a one-shot warning added in this revision (commit 15f797613) so the fallback is no longer silent.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13513

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

`QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH` 和 `QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_DEFAULTS_PATH` 此前不论其指向的文件归谁所有都会被信任，因此用户自有的文件可以顶替系统层。本 PR 在两个路径共同经过的唯一解析点加了一道信任门：Unix 侧用 `lstatSync`（不跟随符号链接）——覆盖仅在文件为常规文件且 `uid === 0` 时生效；Windows 侧归一化后的路径（小写化、`/` → `\`、消除 `..` 段）必须位于 `C:\ProgramData\qwen-code\` 之内；任何存疑情况一律回落到平台默认路径——文件不存在、目录、符号链接、非 root 属主、stat 出错。被拒绝的覆盖现在还会留下一条一次性警告，指明是哪个变量、配置的路径以及拒绝原因，回落不再静默。该变量仍允许管理员把系统层重定向到管理员控制的位置——这是 #13513 维护者讨论中选择的纵深防御方案。

## 为什么需要

在设计托管安装（managed install）时遇到：提权的安装程序写入受保护的系统路径，CLI 以非特权运行——「系统」层只有在用户无法伪造它时才有意义。控制这个环境变量的用户可以把它指向主目录里的文件，从而压过所有托管设置。#13513 中有 v0.24.7 的具体复现和独立核对过的根因链路。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

这个改动的全部行为就是「存疑即拒绝」，所以要在改动前后各复现一遍。在 macOS/Linux 上，从仓库根目录执行（Node ≥ 22，`pnpm install` 之后）：

```
echo '{"layer":"user-owned-fixture"}' > /tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json

node -e 'process.env.QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH="/tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json"; console.log(require("/tmp/spl.cjs").getSystemSettingsPath())'
```

在本分支上，该命令打印一次性警告并解析为平台默认路径；在 `origin/main` 上执行相同命令会信任覆盖（无警告）。`main` 一侧把 bundle 输入换成 `git show origin/main:packages/cli/src/config/storage-paths-lite.ts > /tmp/spl-main.ts`，bundle 这个文件即可。root 属主分支（非 root 宿主上跳过）在 root 身份的 Linux 容器中执行——命令与输出见 Evidence。Windows 由 `storage-paths-lite.test.ts` 中 14 条用例的路径归一化表覆盖，外加下方测试平台中的真实 Windows 运行。单元测试套件：`cd packages/cli && pnpm exec vitest run src/config/storage-paths-lite.test.ts` — 70 个用例：fixture 用例（不存在 / 目录 / 符号链接 / 用户自有 / root 属主（root 运行时））、归一化表，以及一次性警告行为（第二次拒绝不再重复）。

### 证据（改动前后）

**改动前 — `origin/main`（macOS，用户自有 fixture）：** 用户自有的文件被信任为系统层，无警告，输出 `/tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json`。

**改动后 — 本分支（macOS，同一 fixture）：**

```
$ node -e 'process.env.QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH="/tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json"; console.log(require("/tmp/spl.cjs").getSystemSettingsPath())'
QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH is set to "/tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json", which is not a regular root-owned file, so the platform default is used instead.
/Library/Application Support/QwenCode/settings.json
```

**root 属主 — Linux 容器以 root 身份运行（Node v22.23.3），`chown` 分支在此真正执行（非 root 宿主上跳过）：**

```
$ docker run --rm -v $PWD:/src:ro node:22-bookworm-slim bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p /work; tar -C /src --exclude=node_modules --exclude=.git -cf - . | tar -C /work -xf -; cd /work; corepack enable; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; cd packages/cli; CI=1 pnpm exec vitest run src/config/storage-paths-lite.test.ts --reporter=verbose --coverage.enabled=false'
 ✓ ... > warns once when a user-owned override is rejected, and stays quiet after 1ms
 ✓ ... > fails closed for an override that is not a root-owned regular file 0ms
 ✓ ... > honors an override only while the file it names is root-owned 0ms
 ⎯⎯⎯⎯
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  69 passed | 1 skipped (70)
```

唯一的 skip 是 Windows 警告用例（只在真实 Windows 宿主上运行——下方 Windows 验证中已运行并通过）。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

macOS（darwin-arm64）：用户自有 / 符号链接 / 目录 / 不存在的 fixture、14 条用例的 Windows 归一化表、一次性警告——全部在宿主上执行。Linux：`node:22-bookworm-slim` 容器以 **root** 身份运行，因此普通宿主上被跳过的、基于 `chown` 的 root 属主 fixture 分支真正执行了。Windows（UTM Win11 ARM 虚拟机，node 22.23.3）：8 个直接受影响的 cli spec 文件真实运行——settings.test.ts 与 storage-paths-lite.test.ts（含 Windows 专属警告用例）全绿；6 个断言系统设置层的 config/serve 文件共 78 个用例失败：其 fixture 按 Unix 信任语义打桩（root-owned lstat），而 win32 门是文档化的 fail-closed 路径检查（必须位于 C:\ProgramData\qwen-code 内），对临时 fixture 按设计拒绝——测试套件的 Windows 兼容缺口，非运行时行为变化；tsc --noEmit 0 错。

已在当前 head `390684c30` 重新验证——该提交仅涉及测试（改动 12 个文件：上述 8 个 spec 文件从临时 fixture 迁移到信任门模式，外加 4 处 helper/e2e 微调，无生产代码改动）。我在三台系统上重跑了这些套件，`settings-cache`、`fast-path`、`fast-path-open`、`workspace-models`、`run-qwen-serve`、`workspace-qualified-rest`、`hooks-command-reload`、`write-with-backup` **无新增失败**；现存的失败全部是既有、与本 PR 无关的。macOS：无新增失败——在三条腿并行负载下最初看似新增的少数几个，在隔离重跑中已通过，部分既有失败现已通过（如 `settings-cache`、`fast-path`、`workspace-qualified-rest`）。Linux（`node:22-bookworm-slim`，node 22）：改动文件无失败。Windows（UTM Win11 ARM 虚拟机，node 22）：改动文件与迁移前基线呈现完全相同的 133 个既有失败集合（按测试名比对，0 新增 / 0 消失）。

### 环境（可选）

macOS 26.6.2，darwin-arm64，Node v26.5.0，pnpm 11.24.0（宿主）；docker `node:22-bookworm-slim`，Linux，Node v22.23.3，进程用户 `root`（容器）；UTM Win11 ARM 虚拟机，Windows 11（WinOnArm x64），Node 22.23.3（CLI bundle，Windows focused 运行）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：Unix 侧只认 `uid === 0`——有意为之：以非 root 管理员账号写入系统文件的托管安装会回落到平台默认路径；这是信任模型上被接受的取舍（fail-closed 优于信任一个属主无法核实的文件）。Windows 侧是归一化后的路径前缀判断（位于 `C:\ProgramData\qwen-code\` 内），不是 ACL/属主校验——有意选择（#13513 允许的形式；标准安装下 `ProgramData` 已受 ACL 保护；ACL 校验属单独范围）。
- 未验证/范围之外：宿主机器上的 root 属主场景（仅容器）。Windows 真实运行已完成（见测试平台）；其中 78 个失败的系统层用例是测试套件的 Windows 兼容缺口（fixture 按 Unix 信任语义打桩），非运行时行为变化。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：系统设置文件非 root 属主（Unix）或不在 `C:\ProgramData\qwen-code\` 内（Windows）的托管场景将不再生效——有意为之，且本次修订（commit 15f797613）加入一次性警告，回落不再静默。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13513

prs.title: feat(autofix-pr): give helper refusals a code and a next step
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`/autofix-pr`'s helpers now report *why* they refuse and *what the skill does next* as fields, not only as English text. A helper that refuses still exits 1, and now prints one JSON line last on stderr:

```
{"refused":"busy","next":"retry","message":"another autofix-pr helper is working on PR #7; run one at a time (…)"}
```

- **`refused`** is one of 15 codes: `busy`, `partial`, `pr_closed`, `not_prepared`, `watch_stopped`, `task_replaced`, `watched_elsewhere`, `fix_in_flight`, `worktree_dirty`, `no_failed_job`, `no_background_fix`, `rerun_failed`, `push_failed`, `plan_invalid`, and `failed` for anything else (git or `gh` failing, an unreadable file).
- **`next`** is one of 10 steps, each defined once in a new "Refusals" section of the skill: `retry`, `stop`, `end_task`, `take_over`, `discard`, `foreground`, `rerun`, `needs_human`, `fix_plan`, `report`. The step depends on the helper as well as on the code, so the same code can mean what the calling step needs:
  - `watched_elsewhere` is `take_over` from `prepare` and `end_task` from a round's `sync`.
  - `worktree_dirty` is `discard` from `sync` and `needs_human` from `push`.
  - A `reply` that `failed` is `retry`: the failed post is still owed, and the second run skips what the first one posted.
- **No stack trace.** A refusal used to be a thrown error. It reached the CLI's "An unexpected critical error occurred" handler, which printed its stack, and the stack is what the model read, through the shell or the `autofix_pr` tool. Each helper's handler now catches the error and prints the line instead, as `review extract-step` already does. The exit code stays 1. The message drops escape sequences whole and the daemon log's unsafe class (C0 and C1 controls, `\r`, bidi overrides, invisible formatters), keeping tabs and newlines. It is cut to 8,000 characters as JSON (its head and its tail kept), so the line fits in the 16 KiB of stderr the tool keeps. A defect (an error that is not a refusal) prints its stack frames before the line, so where it happened is kept and the line stays last.
- **The `autofix_pr` tool:**
  - It returns a coded refusal with that line first, verbatim (`autofix-pr sync refused: {…}`), then the rest of what the helper printed (git's or `gh`'s output).
  - It reads the line only from a helper that exited 1, and takes the last coded line with nothing after it but Node's warnings (with the frames `--trace-warnings` adds). A line a hook printed before the helper crashed is not the helper's refusal.
  - It no longer digs the `Error:` line out of a stack.
  - A refusal without the line (one of the tool's own, arguments yargs refused, or a CLI older than the codes) keeps the old form.
  - Its description tells the model to act on `next`.
- **The skill** acts on `next` instead of matching wording such as "one refused with "another autofix-pr helper is working"", "if it fails saying it kept the answers", "a refusal saying the PR is merged or closed", "an error saying…".
  - The seven-bullet refusal list of Round step 1 becomes the shared "Refusals" table.
  - These places point at the table: Start step 3 (`take_over`), the CI logs (`rerun`), the background fix (`foreground`), re-runs and the push (`needs_human`), the reply (`fix_plan`, `retry`, `stop`), after-fix step 1, Stop, and In-place.
  - The Resume step keys on the code `pr_closed`, because a start has no watch to stop and `prepare` gives that code the step `report`.
  - `retry` holds wherever a step says a refusal ends it.
  - `discard` distinguishes Round step 1, where it clears what an earlier round left, from the push of step 6, where the round's own fix left the worktree unclean. In step 6 nothing is pushed and the items are `needs_human`.
- **Three refusals got the code their caller needs:**
  - A clone whose watch files are gone used to fail `sync` with `ENOENT` on the lock file. It now gets `not_prepared` (`end_task`).
  - A reply plan that cannot be read, is not JSON, or is not shaped as a plan now gets `plan_invalid` (`fix_plan`). Otherwise a plan naming a comment twice would have been retried unchanged.
  - When `sync --discard` cannot switch the worktree back (the branch is checked out elsewhere, or a lock git left), it now answers `synced: false`, the same as a worktree still dirty after discarding, so the round stops. As `worktree_dirty` it would have answered `discard`, which only asks for the same thing again. When another worktree holds the branch, the reason names it and how to free it, since `cleanup` cannot delete the branch either until then.
- **The design document** gains Section 6.16 (the codes, who raises them, and the step each gives), in both languages.

This is the first of the two steps the improvement plan gives the skill's control flow. The second is a `round`/`finish` driver that takes the branching out of the prose, and it will act on the same codes.

## Why it's needed

The skill drove its control flow off the wording of helper errors. Round step 1 listed seven refusals by what their messages said, and other places matched phrases. A model following 60 KB of prose had to recognise each message among the stack frames, and rewording a message would silently change which branch the model took. A code that tests pin, and a step the skill defines once, remove both problems.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/autofix-pr/
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/tools/autofix-pr.test.ts src/skills/bundled/autofix-pr/
```

Expected: 19 files and 629 tests in packages/cli, and 143 tool tests plus 12 skill tests in packages/core.

These refusals ran through the real CLI (`npm run build && npm run bundle`), in a clone whose remote serves a fake `gh` with PR #7 merged and no watch prepared:

```
$ qwen autofix-pr prepare 7 --repo o/r --host ghe.example.com   # exit 1
{"refused":"pr_closed","next":"report","message":"PR #7 is merged; autofix needs an open PR."}
$ qwen autofix-pr sync 7   # exit 1
{"refused":"not_prepared","next":"end_task","message":"PR #7 is not prepared here; run `qwen autofix-pr prepare 7 --repo <owner>/<repo>` first."}
$ qwen autofix-pr snapshot 7   # exit 1
{"refused":"not_prepared","next":"end_task","message":"PR #7 is not prepared here; run `qwen autofix-pr prepare 7 --repo <owner>/<repo>` first."}
```

Before this change, that `sync` failed with `ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '…/.qwen/tmp/autofix-pr-7.lock.<uuid>'` under a stack. No refusal the skill handles matched that message.

The codes are checked against mutants. Each mutant was applied alone and run against the tests that should catch it:

All 91 are caught:

| Mutants | What each does | Caught by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 34 | One coded throw site raises `failed` instead. This covers every site; `prepare`'s two eligibility sites count as one mutant. | That site's helper test, pinned with `refused(code, /message/)` |
| 1 | `sync` no longer answers a refused switch back with `synced: false` | `sync.test.ts` |
| 8 | One rule of `nextStep` changes: `busy` → `report`; `prepare` + `pr_closed` → `stop`; `prepare` + `watched_elsewhere` → `end_task`; `push` drops out of the round's helpers; `sync` + `worktree_dirty` → `report`; `reply` + `failed` → `report`; `push` + `failed` → `report`; `fix_in_flight` → `needs_human` from `push` | `refusal.test.ts`, the chain test |
| 7 | The wrapper exits 0; prints only the message; names the command by its usage string; leaves `sync` unwrapped; keeps a long message whole; keeps terminal controls; measures the message as text, not as JSON | `refusal.test.ts` (which also runs every helper through `autofixPrCommand` in an empty clone), the chain test |
| 6 | The tool ignores the coded line in `helperRefusal`, or in the execute path; accepts a line with no `next`; reads only the last stderr line; accepts any line after the coded one; reads a coded line from any exit code | `autofix-pr.test.ts` |
| 3 | The skill drops `take_over`; matches `busy` by its wording again; keys Resume on `next: stop` again | `SKILL.test.ts` |
| 16 | The fixes for the bot review: the holder of the branch not named; escape sequences dropped byte by byte, bidi overrides or C1 controls kept; `--trace-warnings` frames not accepted; a defect's frames not printed, or a refusal's printed too; an unlisted pair of the step matrix changed; `cleanup` or `status` unwrapped; `prepare`'s eligibility always `pr_closed`; `fix-start`'s terse in-flight message; the watch checks reordered (two ways); the skill's `discard` and `foreground` bodies traded; a new step the skill does not answer | the matrix specification, the every-helper test (now with `cleanup` and `status`), the crossing watch-check cases, `sync.test.ts`, `prepare.test.ts`, `fix.test.ts`, `autofix-pr.test.ts`, `SKILL.test.ts` (which reads the steps from `refusal.ts`) |
| 6 | The fixes for the second review: a holder never stale, or never locked; the unlock step dropped; the prune advice dropped; the stale wording dropped; the every-helper `prepare` row put back onto gh | `sync.test.ts` (five holders, each freed by running the commands its reason gives), the every-helper test's guard against any gh call |
| 3 | The fixes for the third review: the bare path in `remove`; the bare path in `unlock`; a plain `'…'` wrap that does not escape an apostrophe | `sync.test.ts`, each holder also at a path with spaces and both quotes, the printed commands run through `sh -c` |
| 7 | The fixes for the bot's second review: Node's warnings left on for helpers; no `-z`; the holder never taken as the main worktree; the main worktree offered `remove`; the commands without `-C`; `--force` dropped from the no-holder advice; only a `locked` with a reason recognised | `autofix-pr.test.ts` (a helper raising a two-line warning as it refuses), `sync.test.ts` (a newline path, commands run outside the clone, the main checkout holding the branch, an `index.lock` stopping the switch) |

The first run (48 mutants) left 8 alive: two `sync` sites, three `reply` sites, the `fix_in_flight` rule, the unwrapped `sync`, and two tool mutants. Tests were added for them: the pins in `sync.test.ts` and `reply.test.ts`, the `push`/`rerun` + `fix_in_flight` rows, the every-helper test, and the direct `codedRefusal` test. The review fixes added the other 11 mutants; one of them (text vs JSON length) survived at first and got its own test.

Two read-only review rounds checked the branch:
- The first found one P1, two P2s and six P3s: plan errors retried unchanged, a Resume step that waited for a step `prepare` never gives, a `sync --discard` loop, and wording, the tool's description, and the cap and scan-back.
- The second confirmed those fixed and found four P3s in the fixes themselves: the switch back reported forever instead of stopping, an unreadable plan, the cap measured before escaping, and a hook's line taken for the refusal.
- The bot's review of `f588ce29b1` raised 15 more (one Critical): the `cleanup --force` advice could not succeed while another worktree held the branch; a narrower control class than the repository's; Node's `--trace-warnings` frames; a defect's lost stack; several tests that could not fail or did not reach their site; the doc's undefined fallback; `partial` described by a count instead of its deadline; `fix-start`'s terse in-flight message; the tool description's first line. All 15 are fixed and their threads answered. Its `createDebugLogger` suggestion became frames on stderr before the line, as a helper process has no debug session to write to.
- A second review, of `83164fe499`, found two edge cases. The holder advice could not free a branch held by a worktree whose `.git` was deleted or by a locked one: the reason now gives `git worktree prune` for a stale holder, and `git worktree unlock` first for a locked one. And the every-helper test joined its fake `gh` to `PATH` with `:`: it now uses `delimiter`, and no row calls gh at all, which on Windows `execFile` could not route to a script. Both are fixed.
- A third review, of `46c4224075`, found the holder path bare in the `remove` and `unlock` commands: a path with a space or a quote broke the command as printed. Both commands now quote it with `shellQuotePath`, and the tests run the printed commands through a shell.
- The bot's second review, of `d7c0dc1fb4`, raised four more (one Critical). A Node warning flushed after the coded line, over several lines, hid the line from the tool: the tool now runs its helpers with `NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1`, closing the class at the source rather than with a sentinel, which would bring back the crash-after-a-hook's-line case. The recovery commands now carry `-C` and run from any directory, and a branch held by the clone's own checkout gets only a switch. The holder is read with `-z`, so a path with a newline is not cut short. The no-holder arm got its test. It deferred three smaller items, left for now.
- All are fixed. Two notes are left as they are. An in-place watch's `watch_stopped` hint omits `--in-place`, but an in-place `stop` removes the watch, so the code cannot come from one. And no general test cross-checks each step's `next:` against its helper: a hand check of every such step found them all reachable, and only the Resume step got a pinned assertion.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, a refused `prepare` of a merged PR printed:

```
An unexpected critical error occurred:
Error: PR #7 is merged; autofix needs an open PR.
    at runPrepare (file:///…/dist/chunks/autofix-pr-IZYZLAQQ.js:4:12390)
    …
```

After, the same call prints the single line shown above and exits 1. Through the `autofix_pr` tool, as `autofix-pr.test.ts` pins it with a fake helper:

```
autofix-pr sync refused: {"refused":"busy","next":"retry","message":"another autofix-pr helper is working on PR #12"}
Error: gh said something first
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the skill's wording changed in a dozen places, and no real-model run has measured the change yet. The plan's real-model scenario eval exists but has not been run on either side of this change. Every message keeps its wording, so a model that still reads the message finds what it found before.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - The `round`/`finish` driver.
  - The `autofix_pr` tool's own refusals (a fix running in the worktree, a plan in the wrong place, plan mode, "this fix no longer runs without asking"). They are not a helper's, they keep their wording, and the skill handles them as the calling step says.
  - `prepare`'s many start-time refusals, which are all `report`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: a helper's refusal on stderr is now one JSON line instead of a stack. Exit codes and stdout are unchanged. A cron gate's failure notice, which shows the last 20 lines of stderr, now shows the coded line instead of stack frames.

Design document: [English](docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.zh-CN.md), Section 6.16.

## Linked Issues

Part of the `/autofix-pr` improvement plan. Follows #15985, #16017 and #16138.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`/autofix-pr` 的辅助命令拒绝时，现在会用字段说明两件事：*为什么*拒绝，以及 skill *下一步做什么*，不再只给一段英文。拒绝时仍以 1 退出，并在 stderr 的最后一行输出一行 JSON：

```
{"refused":"busy","next":"retry","message":"another autofix-pr helper is working on PR #7; run one at a time (…)"}
```

- **`refused`** 是 15 个码之一：`busy`、`partial`、`pr_closed`、`not_prepared`、`watch_stopped`、`task_replaced`、`watched_elsewhere`、`fix_in_flight`、`worktree_dirty`、`no_failed_job`、`no_background_fix`、`rerun_failed`、`push_failed`、`plan_invalid`，其余情况（git 或 `gh` 出错、文件读不了）都是 `failed`。
- **`next`** 是 10 个步骤之一，每个都在 skill 新增的 "Refusals" 一节里定义一次：`retry`、`stop`、`end_task`、`take_over`、`discard`、`foreground`、`rerun`、`needs_human`、`fix_plan`、`report`。步骤既取决于码，也取决于是哪个辅助命令，所以同一个码可以对应调用它的那一步所需的做法：
  - `watched_elsewhere` 来自 `prepare` 时是 `take_over`，来自一轮的 `sync` 时是 `end_task`。
  - `worktree_dirty` 来自 `sync` 时是 `discard`，来自 `push` 时是 `needs_human`。
  - `reply` 的 `failed` 是 `retry`：没发出去的帖子仍然欠着，第二次运行会跳过第一次已经发出的。
- **不再有堆栈。** 以前拒绝就是抛出一个错误，错误走到 CLI 的 "An unexpected critical error occurred" 处理入口，打印出整段堆栈；模型无论经 shell 还是经 `autofix_pr` 工具，读到的都是这段堆栈。现在每个辅助命令的 handler 自己捕获错误，改为输出这一行，做法和 `review extract-step` 已有的一样。退出码仍是 1。消息会整段去掉转义序列，再去掉 daemon 日志的不安全字符类（C0 和 C1 控制字符、`\r`、双向覆盖字符、不可见格式字符），保留制表符和换行；然后按 JSON 计截到 8,000 个字符以内（保留开头和结尾），保证这一行能完整落在工具保留的 16 KiB stderr 里。辅助命令自身的缺陷（不是拒绝的错误）会在这一行之前打印堆栈帧，既保留出错位置，这一行也仍是最后一行。
- **`autofix_pr` 工具：**
  - 带码的拒绝原样放在结果最前面（`autofix-pr sync refused: {…}`），后面是辅助命令输出的其余内容（git 或 `gh` 的输出）。
  - 只从以 1 退出的辅助命令读取这一行，取的是最后一行带码的内容，而且它之后只能跟着 Node 的警告（包括 `--trace-warnings` 加上的堆栈帧）。hook 在辅助命令崩溃前打印出来的一行，不算它的拒绝。
  - 不再从堆栈里抠 `Error:` 那一行。
  - 没有这一行的拒绝（工具自己的拒绝、yargs 拒绝了参数，或者早于拒绝码的 CLI）保持原来的格式。
  - 工具描述改为让模型按 `next` 行事。
- **skill** 按 `next` 行事，不再匹配 "one refused with "another autofix-pr helper is working""、"if it fails saying it kept the answers"、"a refusal saying the PR is merged or closed"、"an error saying…" 这类措辞。
  - Round 第 1 步那份七条的拒绝清单，改成共用的 "Refusals" 表。
  - 以下各处都指向这张表：Start 第 3 步（`take_over`）、CI 日志（`rerun`）、后台修复（`foreground`）、重跑和推送（`needs_human`）、回复（`fix_plan`、`retry`、`stop`）、after-fix 第 1 步、Stop 和 In-place。
  - Resume 那一步按码 `pr_closed` 判断，因为启动时还没有可停止的监视，`prepare` 给这个码的步骤是 `report`。
  - 凡是某一步说"拒绝就结束"的地方，`retry` 都优先。
  - `discard` 区分两种情况：在 Round 第 1 步，它清掉上一轮留下的东西；在第 6 步推送前，它表示本轮自己的修复没留下干净的 worktree，这时什么都不推送，相关事项交给人。
- **有三处拒绝改成了调用方需要的码：**
  - watch 的文件已经不在的 clone 里，`sync` 以前因锁文件 `ENOENT` 失败，现在是 `not_prepared`（`end_task`）。
  - 回复计划读不到、不是 JSON，或者结构不对，现在是 `plan_invalid`（`fix_plan`）。否则一个把同一条评论列了两次的计划会被原样重试。
  - `sync --discard` 无法把 worktree 切回原分支时（该分支在别处检出，或 git 留下了锁），现在回答 `synced: false`，和丢弃之后仍不干净的 worktree 一样，这一轮会停下来。如果给的是 `worktree_dirty`，就会回答 `discard`，而那只会再要求同样的事。另一个 worktree 占着这个分支时，原因里会点名它并说明怎样释放，因为在那之前 `cleanup` 也删不掉这个分支。
- **设计文档**新增第 6.16 节，列出各个码、由谁给出、对应什么步骤，中英文都有。

这是改进计划里整理 skill 流程控制的两步中的第一步。第二步是一个 `round`/`finish` 驱动器，把分支逻辑从文字说明里挪出来，它会沿用同一套码。

## 为什么需要

skill 的流程控制原来靠辅助命令报错的措辞来驱动。Round 第 1 步按消息内容列了七种拒绝，其他地方也在匹配短语。照着 60 KB 文字说明执行的模型，得在堆栈帧中间认出每条消息；只要改一下某条消息的措辞，模型走哪个分支就会悄悄改变。用测试固定住的码，加上 skill 里只定义一次的步骤，两个问题都解决了。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

```
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/autofix-pr/
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/tools/autofix-pr.test.ts src/skills/bundled/autofix-pr/
```

预期：packages/cli 19 个文件、629 个测试通过；packages/core 工具测试 143 个、skill 测试 12 个通过。

下面这几次拒绝是经真实 CLI 跑的（`npm run build && npm run bundle`）。环境是一个 clone，它的远端由假 `gh` 应答，其中 PR #7 已合入，也没有准备过任何监视：

```
$ qwen autofix-pr prepare 7 --repo o/r --host ghe.example.com   # exit 1
{"refused":"pr_closed","next":"report","message":"PR #7 is merged; autofix needs an open PR."}
$ qwen autofix-pr sync 7   # exit 1
{"refused":"not_prepared","next":"end_task","message":"PR #7 is not prepared here; run `qwen autofix-pr prepare 7 --repo <owner>/<repo>` first."}
$ qwen autofix-pr snapshot 7   # exit 1
{"refused":"not_prepared","next":"end_task","message":"PR #7 is not prepared here; run `qwen autofix-pr prepare 7 --repo <owner>/<repo>` first."}
```

改动之前，这次 `sync` 以 `ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '…/.qwen/tmp/autofix-pr-7.lock.<uuid>'` 失败，后面跟着堆栈。skill 处理的任何一种拒绝都对不上这条消息。

这些码用变异检验过。每个变异单独施加，再运行应该抓到它的测试：

91 个变异全部被抓到：

| 变异数 | 每个变异做了什么 | 由谁抓到 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 34 | 某一处带码的抛出点改成抛 `failed`。每一处都覆盖了；`prepare` 的两处资格检查算一个变异。 | 该处所属辅助命令的测试，用 `refused(code, /message/)` 固定 |
| 1 | git 拒绝切回分支时，`sync` 不再回答 `synced: false` | `sync.test.ts` |
| 8 | `nextStep` 的某条规则被改掉：`busy` → `report`；`prepare` + `pr_closed` → `stop`；`prepare` + `watched_elsewhere` → `end_task`；`push` 不再算一轮的辅助命令；`sync` + `worktree_dirty` → `report`；`reply` + `failed` → `report`；`push` + `failed` → `report`；`push` 发出的 `fix_in_flight` → `needs_human` | `refusal.test.ts`、链路测试 |
| 7 | 包装层退出码为 0；只输出消息；按 usage 字符串取命令名；`sync` 没有包装；超长消息不截断；保留终端控制字符；按文本而不是 JSON 计长度 | `refusal.test.ts`（它还会在空 clone 里经 `autofixPrCommand` 把每个辅助命令都跑一遍）、链路测试 |
| 6 | 工具在 `helperRefusal` 或执行路径里忽略带码的那一行；接受没有 `next` 的行；只读 stderr 的最后一行；带码的行之后跟什么都接受；不论退出码多少都读带码的行 | `autofix-pr.test.ts` |
| 3 | skill 去掉了 `take_over`；又按措辞匹配 `busy`；Resume 又改回按 `next: stop` 判断 | `SKILL.test.ts` |
| 16 | 针对 bot 评审的修复：不点名占着分支的 worktree；逐字节而不是整段去掉转义序列，保留双向覆盖或 C1 控制字符；不接受 `--trace-warnings` 的堆栈帧；缺陷不打印堆栈帧，或拒绝也打印；改掉步骤矩阵里一个未列出的组合；`cleanup` 或 `status` 没有包装；`prepare` 的资格检查一律给 `pr_closed`；`fix-start` 进行中时又给简短消息；监视检查的顺序被调换（两种）；skill 里 `discard` 和 `foreground` 的说明互换；新增一个 skill 没有说明的步骤 | 矩阵规格、逐个辅助命令的测试（现在包括 `cleanup` 和 `status`）、交叉的监视检查用例、`sync.test.ts`、`prepare.test.ts`、`fix.test.ts`、`autofix-pr.test.ts`、`SKILL.test.ts`（从 `refusal.ts` 读取步骤） |
| 6 | 针对第二轮评审的修复：占用者从不算陈旧，或从不算已锁定；去掉先解锁那一步；去掉 prune 的建议；去掉"已不是检出"的描述；把逐个辅助命令测试里的 `prepare` 那一行改回去调 gh | `sync.test.ts`（五种占用者，每种都照拒绝原因给出的命令执行后再同步）、逐个辅助命令测试里"不许调用 gh"的断言 |
| 3 | 针对第三轮评审的修复：`remove` 里的路径不加引用；`unlock` 里的路径不加引用；只用简单的 `'…'` 包裹、不处理撇号 | `sync.test.ts`：每种占用者再放到含空格和两种引号的路径下，提示里的命令经 `sh -c` 原样执行 |
| 7 | 针对 bot 第 2 轮评审的修复：工具不再关掉 helper 的 Node 警告；不用 `-z` 读取；从不把占用者当成主 worktree；主 worktree 也给 remove 的建议；命令不带 `-C`；没有占用者时的建议去掉 `--force`；只认带原因的 `locked` | `autofix-pr.test.ts`（helper 在拒绝时发出两行警告）、`sync.test.ts`（换行路径、在 clone 外执行命令、主 worktree 占用、`index.lock` 挡住切换） |

第一轮跑的是 48 个变异，有 8 个没被抓到：`sync` 的两处、`reply` 的三处、`fix_in_flight` 那条规则、没包装的 `sync`，以及两个工具变异。为它们补了以下测试：`sync.test.ts` 和 `reply.test.ts` 里的码断言、`push`/`rerun` + `fix_in_flight` 两行、逐个辅助命令的测试，以及直接测 `codedRefusal` 的用例。按评审意见修复时又加了其余 11 个变异；其中"按文本还是按 JSON 计长度"那个一开始没被抓到，为它单独补了测试。

这个分支做过两轮只读评审：
- 第一轮发现了 1 个 P1、2 个 P2、6 个 P3：计划解析错误会被原样重试；Resume 那一步在等一个 `prepare` 永远不会给的步骤；`sync --discard` 会循环；以及措辞、工具描述、截断和往回找带码的行这几处。
- 第二轮确认这些都已修好，又在修复本身里发现了 4 个 P3：切回分支失败会永远报告而不停下；计划文件读不到的情况；截断是按转义前的长度算的；hook 打印的行被当成了拒绝。
- bot 对 `f588ce29b1` 的评审又提出 15 条（1 条 Critical）：另一个 worktree 占着分支时，`cleanup --force` 的建议不可能成功；清理的字符类比仓库统一的窄；Node `--trace-warnings` 的堆栈帧；缺陷丢了堆栈；几条测试不可能失败或者没走到它要测的位置；文档里兜底格式没有定义；`partial` 按数量而不是时限描述；`fix-start` 进行中的消息太简短；工具描述的第一行。15 条全部修好，线程都已回复。其中 `createDebugLogger` 的建议改成了在带码行之前把堆栈帧写到 stderr，因为辅助命令进程里没有可写的调试会话。
- 第二轮评审（针对 `83164fe499`）发现两个边界问题。一是占着分支的 worktree 如果 `.git` 被删、或者被锁定，原来的指引释放不了分支：现在对陈旧的条目给出 `git worktree prune`，对锁定的条目先给 `git worktree unlock`。二是逐个辅助命令的测试用字面量 `:` 把假 `gh` 拼进 `PATH`：现在改用 `delimiter`，而且没有任何一行会调用 gh——在 Windows 上 `execFile` 本来也不会执行名为 `gh` 的脚本。两条都已修复。
- 第三轮评审（针对 `46c4224075`）发现 `remove` 和 `unlock` 两条命令里的路径没有加引用：路径含空格或引号时，照抄执行就会失败。现在两条命令都用 `shellQuotePath` 引用路径，测试也改为经 shell 执行提示里的命令。
- bot 第 2 轮评审（针对 `d7c0dc1fb4`）又提出 4 条（1 条 Critical）。Node 在带码行之后刷出的多行警告会把这一行挡住，工具读不到：现在工具运行辅助命令时设 `NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1`，从源头关掉这一类，没有改用前缀——前缀的做法会让"hook 打印一行后辅助命令崩溃"的情况重新出现。恢复命令现在都带 `-C`，在任何目录都能执行；分支被 clone 自己的检出占着时只建议切换分支。占用者改用 `-z` 读取，路径里带换行也不会被截断。没有占用者的那个分支补了测试。它延后的 3 条小问题暂不处理。
- 以上全部修好。有两点保持原样。一是 in-place 监视的 `watch_stopped` 提示没带 `--in-place`，但 in-place 的 `stop` 会直接删掉监视，所以这个码不可能来自 in-place 监视。二是没有写一个通用测试，去核对每一步写的 `next:` 能否由它调用的辅助命令给出：手工逐一核对过，每一处都可能出现，只给 Resume 那一步加了固定断言。

### 证据（前后对比）

改动之前，对已合入的 PR 运行 `prepare`，被拒绝时输出：

```
An unexpected critical error occurred:
Error: PR #7 is merged; autofix needs an open PR.
    at runPrepare (file:///…/dist/chunks/autofix-pr-IZYZLAQQ.js:4:12390)
    …
```

改动之后，同样的调用只输出上面那一行，并以 1 退出。经 `autofix_pr` 工具调用时的结果如下，由 `autofix-pr.test.ts` 用假辅助命令固定：

```
autofix-pr sync refused: {"refused":"busy","next":"retry","message":"another autofix-pr helper is working on PR #12"}
Error: gh said something first
```

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

不适用

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：skill 的措辞改了十来处，还没有用真实模型测过这次改动。改进计划里的真实模型场景评测已经准备好，但改动前后都还没跑过。所有消息的措辞都没变，所以仍然去读消息的模型，读到的内容和以前一样。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：
  - `round`/`finish` 驱动器。
  - `autofix_pr` 工具自己的拒绝（worktree 里有修复在跑、回复计划放错了位置、plan mode、"this fix no longer runs without asking"）。它们不是辅助命令的拒绝，措辞不变，skill 按调用它的那一步的说法处理。
  - `prepare` 在启动时的众多拒绝，都是 `report`。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：辅助命令拒绝时，stderr 上现在是一行 JSON，不再是堆栈。退出码和 stdout 都不变。定时 gate 失败时的通知会显示 stderr 的最后 20 行，现在显示的是带码的那一行，不再是堆栈帧。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.zh-CN.md)，第 6.16 节。

## 关联 Issue

属于 `/autofix-pr` 改进计划，接在 #15985、#16017 和 #16138 之后。

</details>

prs.title: perf(managed-agent): take ordinary publication lanes off the placement guard
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Ordinary tool publication lanes (non-CSI, non-Resident original) no longer take the tenant `runtime_placement` guard. With #16335 they then take no tenant-wide row at all.

1. **Session root first.** Each lane (reserve, renew, dispatch, upload, verify, finish, admission, receipt) locks its Session root where it took placement (`ToolPublicationPlacement`).
2. **Original binding, by isolation class.**
   - `session` class (the default configuration), whose isolation key is this Session: read without a lock, on the repository's own connection. Every move of such a binding out of `READY` holds this root, so the read is current under any lane isolation level.
   - `workspace` class: `FOR SHARE` after the root. Its writers take no root.
3. **Placement stays** for CSI and Resident Workspace originals, a session-class binding of another Session, and lifecycle-authority receipts. `lockPublicationWriter` takes placement only when the lane took it first.
4. **Two adjustments keep the invariants.**
   - Receipts refuse hosted cleanup records, whose commit would take placement after the root; a receipt carries exactly one `tool.receipt` event.
   - Operator recovery, the one path that moved a `READY` binding without the root, now locks a session-class binding's Session root before its storage rows and the binding.

Why not simply a binding lock instead of placement (the earlier C3 sketch)? Placement owners lock the binding and the Session root in both orders.
- Binding, then root: `lockBindingControl`.
- Root, then binding: lifecycle verification and hosted cleanup commits.

A lane without placement deadlocks with one of the two families wherever it puts a binding lock. The design records the full writer inventory.

Design ([English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/publication-placement-binding/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-publication-placement.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/publication-placement-binding/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-publication-placement.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

After #16335 every ordinary publication step of a tenant still queued on one placement row, behind every other publication and every placement owner: binding transitions, provisioning, runtime retention, migration, storage fences, lifecycle.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Convoy audit (`ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT.heldTenantGuardsBoundPublicationLaneEntries`): with placement and the publication guard both held on another connection, reserve, dispatch, finish, admission and receipt complete within the bound, for a Workspace-shared and a Session-isolated original.
2. MySQL (`ToolPublicationPlacementMySqlIT`, new): a binding owner holds placement and the binding row, then (Session-isolated) the Session root, as `lockBindingControl` does.
   - A Session-isolated renew completes while the owner holds the binding.
   - A Workspace-shared renew waits on the binding and completes after the owner.
   - Neither shape deadlocks.
3. MySQL (`ToolPublicationLockOrderMySqlIT.ordinaryPublicationDoesNotWaitForAPlacementOwner`): receipt, admission and renew, standalone and ambient, complete while a placement owner holds placement, and never request it.
4. Contract (`JournalLockContractTest.guardFreePublicationWriterTakesNoTenantGuard`): the eight-argument writer without guards takes no tenant row; with placement only, it takes placement and not the publication guard. The lock-contract entry now names this suite, which exercises the guard-free route.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: ordinary lanes waited on a held placement row (`publicationTakesPlacementBeforeRetention`) and answered `tenant_guard_contended` in the convoy audit. After, run locally (macOS, JDK 21, Maven 3.9.16, MySQL 8.0.35; CI uses MySQL 8.4) with `-Pmysql-integration`:

- MySQL: `ToolPublicationPlacementMySqlIT`, `ToolPublicationLockOrderMySqlIT`, `ToolPublicationRecoveryMySqlIT`, `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT`, `ManagedLockScopeConcurrencyMySqlIT`, `ManagedAgentCsiMutationMySqlIT`, `WorkspaceSessionRetentionMySqlIT`: 82 tests, 0 failures.
- H2: `ToolPublication*Test`, `ManagedSchemaPublicationStoreTest`, `SurfaceAdmissionAcceptanceTest`, `WorkspaceLifecycleStoreTest`, `JournalLockContractTest`, `SessionRowLockOrderTest`, `ManagedNativeJournalSnapshotsTest`, `ManagedSessionStoreCredentialTest`, `ManagedSessionPhysicalFenceTest`, `Artifact*Test`, `ManagedStoreDecompositionTest`, `ClassSizeRatchetTest`: 801 tests.
  - The one failure is `ClassSizeRatchetTest` on the existing `RuntimeBrokerService` baseline (4284 > 4270), unchanged by this PR.
  - Three `ToolPublicationStoreTest` cases that asserted placement on ordinary lanes now assert its absence.
- Checkstyle: 0 violations. Spotbugs skipped locally.
- `ToolPublicationStore` drops from 978 to 975 lines (pin lowered). No ceiling was raised; the new logic lives in `ToolPublicationPlacement`.
- Tests that load `packages/core/dist` JS (e.g. `WorkspaceCsiNativeActivationGateTest`) fail locally with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` and were left to CI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ targeted H2 + MySQL 8.0.35 suites |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested (CI) |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 13, JDK 21.0.13, Maven 3.9.16, MySQL 8.0.35 (local).

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff.** A writer that moves a session-class binding out of `READY` without its Session root would let a lane publish against a binding that just stopped. The design lists every binding writer and why each is covered; operator recovery was the only gap and is fixed here.
- **Not covered by a dedicated concurrency test.** Lifecycle verification, operator recovery and Runtime retention running against a lane. The full MySQL pipeline and Node-dependent suites run in CI.
- **Out of scope.** CSI and Resident Workspace lanes, and the native snapshot writer.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes.** No schema, API or configuration changes. A tool receipt carrying a `hosted.cleanup` record is now refused (none is produced).

## Linked Issues

Related to #13800. Follows #16335 (C1/C2).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 的改动

普通工具发布车道（原始记录非 CSI、非常驻工作区）不再获取租户 `runtime_placement` guard。加上 #16335，它们不再获取任何租户级行。

1. **先锁 Session root。** 每条车道（reserve、renew、派发、上传、校验、finish、准入、回执）在原来获取 placement 的位置锁 Session root（`ToolPublicationPlacement`）。
2. **原始 binding 按隔离级别区分。**
   - `session` 类（默认配置），且 isolation key 是本 Session：不加锁读取，使用 repository 自己的连接。这类 binding 每次离开 `READY` 都持有这个 root，因此无论车道事务的隔离级别如何，读取都是最新的。
   - `workspace` 类：在 root 之后加 `FOR SHARE`。它的写入方不获取 root。
3. **保留 placement 的情况**：CSI 与常驻工作区原始记录、属于其他 Session 的 session 类 binding、带生命周期授权的回执。`lockPublicationWriter` 只在车道先获取了 placement 时才获取它。
4. **两处配套调整，保证不变式成立。**
   - 回执拒绝 hosted cleanup 记录：这类 commit 会在 root 之后获取 placement；而回执只携带一个 `tool.receipt` 事件。
   - 运维恢复原本是唯一不持有 root 就让 `READY` binding 离开 `READY` 的路径；现在它会在存储行和 binding 之前，锁 session 类 binding 对应的 Session root。

为什么不直接用 binding 锁替代 placement（之前的 C3 草案）？placement 持有者以两种顺序锁 binding 和 Session root：
- 先 binding 后 root：`lockBindingControl`。
- 先 root 后 binding：生命周期校验和 hosted cleanup commit。

不拿 placement 的车道，无论把 binding 锁放在哪里，都会与其中一类死锁。完整的写入方清单见设计文档。

设计文档（[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/publication-placement-binding/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-publication-placement.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/publication-placement-binding/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-publication-placement.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

#16335 之后，租户内每个普通发布步骤仍在同一个 placement 行上排队，排在其他发布和所有 placement 持有者之后：binding 状态转换、provisioning、Runtime retention、迁移、存储 fence、生命周期操作。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. convoy 审计（`ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT.heldTenantGuardsBoundPublicationLaneEntries`）：另一连接同时持有 placement 和 publication guard 时，对 Workspace 共享与 Session 隔离两种原始记录，reserve、派发、finish、准入和回执都在上限内完成。
2. MySQL（新增 `ToolPublicationPlacementMySqlIT`）：binding 持有者先持有 placement 和 binding 行，然后（Session 隔离时）像 `lockBindingControl` 一样获取 Session root。
   - Session 隔离的 renew 在持有者持有 binding 时即可完成。
   - Workspace 共享的 renew 在 binding 上等待，持有者结束后完成。
   - 两种情况都不死锁。
3. MySQL（`ToolPublicationLockOrderMySqlIT.ordinaryPublicationDoesNotWaitForAPlacementOwner`）：回执、准入和 renew（独立事务与外部事务两种形式）在 placement 被持有时完成，并且从不请求它。
4. 契约（`JournalLockContractTest.guardFreePublicationWriterTakesNoTenantGuard`）：不带 guard 的八参数写入方不获取任何租户行；只带 placement 时获取 placement、不获取 publication guard。锁契约条目改为登记这个确实会走无 guard 路径的测试。

### 证据（改前与改后）

改前：持有 placement 时，普通车道会等待（`publicationTakesPlacementBeforeRetention`），在 convoy 审计中返回 `tenant_guard_contended`。改后，在本地（macOS、JDK 21、Maven 3.9.16、MySQL 8.0.35；CI 使用 MySQL 8.4）以 `-Pmysql-integration` 运行：

- MySQL：上述 7 个 IT，共 82 个测试，0 失败。
- H2：801 个测试。
  - 唯一失败是 `ClassSizeRatchetTest` 中 `RuntimeBrokerService` 的既有基线超限（4284 > 4270），与本 PR 无关。
  - 3 个原本断言普通车道获取 placement 的 `ToolPublicationStoreTest` 用例，改为断言不获取。
- checkstyle 0 违规；本地跳过 spotbugs。
- `ToolPublicationStore` 从 978 行降到 975 行（已下调 pin），没有上调任何上限；新逻辑放在 `ToolPublicationPlacement` 中。
- 依赖 `packages/core/dist` JS 的测试（如 `WorkspaceCsiNativeActivationGateTest`）在本地因 `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` 失败，留给 CI。

### 测试平台

| macOS | 已运行相关 H2 与 MySQL 8.0.35 测试 |

macOS 13、JDK 21.0.13、Maven 3.9.16、本地 MySQL 8.0.35。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍。** 如果有写入方不持有 Session root 就让 session 类 binding 离开 `READY`，车道可能对刚停止的 binding 发布。设计文档列出了所有 binding 写入方以及各自为何被覆盖；运维恢复是唯一的缺口，本 PR 已修复。

auto_merge.commit_title: perf(managed-agent): take ordinary publication lanes off the placement guard (#16354)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* docs(managed-agent): design publication lanes without the placement guard

Placement owners lock the original binding and the Session root in both
orders (lockBindingControl: binding then root; lifecycle verification and
hosted cleanup: root then binding), so a lane cannot replace placement with
a binding lock in one fixed position. Ordinary lanes instead lock the Session
root first, read a session-class binding without a lock (its transitions out
of READY hold that root) and share-lock a workspace-class binding.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* perf(managed-agent): take ordinary publication lanes off the placement guard

An ordinary (non-CSI, non-Resident) publication lane now locks its Session
root where it took tenant placement. It reads a session-class original
binding without a lock, on the repository's own connection: every move of
such a binding out of READY holds that root. It share-locks a
workspace-class binding, whose writers take no root. Placement owners lock
the binding and the root in both orders, so neither fixed binding position
would be safe without placement.

Placement stays for CSI and Resident Workspace originals, a session-class
binding of another Session, and lifecycle-authority receipts. The writer
takes placement only when the lane took it first. Receipts refuse hosted
cleanup records, whose commit would take placement after the root.
Operator recovery locks a session-class binding's Session root before its
storage rows and the binding.

prs.title: fix(core): tell the model the date once, from the history
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The client now decides whether to tell the model today's date from the conversation history instead of from in-memory state. Before each user turn and each cron turn it finds the last date the history gives the model, in the startup context or an earlier date reminder, and compares it with today:

| Last date in the history | What the turn gets |
| --- | --- |
| today | nothing |
| an earlier day | `The date has changed since earlier in this conversation. Today's date is now <date>. Use this date from here on; there is no need to mention the change to the user.` |
| none (startup context skipped) | `Today's date is <date>.` |

Only text the client generates is read: the startup context at the head of the history (including the legacy prelude), and `<system-reminder>` blocks that hold nothing but a date reminder, in the new wording or the one recorded before this change. A date the user typed, or one inside another reminder, is never read. The `lastInjectedDate` field and its reset in `startChat` are gone.

## Why it's needed

`lastInjectedDate` was reset in `startChat` and never knew about the date the startup context already carries, and it was not kept in step with the history. That caused three problems (#16359):

- **The first turn of every session repeated the date.** This happened for every new session, resume, `/clear` and manual `/compress`. The repeat came with a note that the two dates "may differ" when they did not.
- **A rewind could leave the model with a stale date.** After a session crossed midnight and got the new date, rewinding to before that turn dropped the reminder but kept the field, so no reminder followed.
- **Cron turns never refreshed the date.** A headless session whose cron prompts ran past midnight kept the previous day's date.

Reading the history covers rewind, resume, compaction and `/clear` without any state to keep in step.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/environmentContext.test.ts src/core/client.test.ts`.
   - The `findLastAnnouncedDate` tests read the startup context that `buildStartupContextReminder` really builds, so a change to its wording fails here. They also cover the legacy prelude, all three reminder wordings, a reminder concatenated into prompt text, the latest of several reminders, and dates that must be ignored (user text, a reminder with other content, model text, a startup-like entry that is not at the head).
   - The client tests cover no date in the history, today already carried by the startup context or by an earlier reminder, a startup context from an earlier day (midnight or rewind), a kept older reminder after a fresh startup context (compressed record), a user-typed date, a cron turn past midnight, and a tool-result turn.
2. Capture the first request of `qwen -p "hi"` against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with `--openai-logging`. Before: the date appears in the startup context and again in a reminder ahead of the prompt. After: it appears only in the startup context.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no UI change). The request capture is described in step 2; results below.

First request of `qwen -p "hi"` against a local fake OpenAI-compatible server, isolated HOME, on Thursday, November 5, 2026. Every place the date appears:

| Build | Where the date appears |
| --- | --- |
| Before | startup context: `Today's date is Thursday, November 5, 2026.`; a reminder ahead of the prompt: `The current date is: Thursday, November 5, 2026. Note: This is the authoritative current date — it may differ from the "Today's date" mentioned earlier…` |
| After | startup context only: `Today's date is Thursday, November 5, 2026.` |

Local checks:

- core `tsc --noEmit` passes.
- `packages/core/src/core` passes: 99 files, 6,145 tests.
- The ACP agent-loop parity suite passes (25 tests), and so does the Ink agent-loop parity suite (14 tests).
- prettier and eslint pass on the changed files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 24. The capture used the bundled `dist/cli.js` from this branch, and for "before" a `main` build from 2026-10-27, whose date logic is the same as at the merge base.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff:
  - The detection matches fixed wordings. If the startup context's opening lines change without updating the pattern, the first turn would get a `Today's date is` reminder again. That fallback is harmless, and the unit test against `buildStartupContextReminder` catches the drift.
  - The ACP parity case now expects no date reminder on a first prompt on both paths (it expected one on the shared path), so it no longer shows the shared path adding the client's date reminder. The client unit tests cover that path.
- Not validated / out of scope: the date the memory extraction agent carries; subagents; moving the date out of the startup context.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Sessions recorded before this change are read correctly, since the old reminder wording is still recognized.

## Linked Issues

Closes #16359

- **rewind 可能让模型只剩旧日期。** 会话跨过午夜并拿到新日期后，rewind 到那一轮之前会删掉提醒，但字段保留，之后不会再补上提醒。

   - client 测试覆盖：history 中没有日期；启动上下文或更早的提醒已经是今天；启动上下文是更早的日期（跨午夜或 rewind）；新启动上下文之后保留着更早的提醒（压缩记录）；用户输入的日期；跨午夜的 cron 轮；工具结果轮。
2. 用 `--openai-logging` 对任一 OpenAI 兼容端点抓取 `qwen -p "hi"` 的第一个请求。改动前：日期出现在启动上下文中，又在 prompt 前的提醒中出现一次。改动后：只出现在启动上下文中。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A（没有 UI 变化）。请求抓取方法见第 2 步，结果如下。

在本地假 OpenAI 兼容服务上抓取 `qwen -p "hi"` 的第一个请求，使用隔离的 HOME，日期为 2026 年 11 月 5 日（周四）。日期出现的所有位置：

| 构建 | 日期出现的位置 |

| 改动前 | 启动上下文：`Today's date is Thursday, November 5, 2026.`；prompt 前的提醒：`The current date is: Thursday, November 5, 2026. Note: This is the authoritative current date — it may differ from the "Today's date" mentioned earlier…` |
| 改动后 | 只在启动上下文中：`Today's date is Thursday, November 5, 2026.` |

本地检查：

- core `tsc --noEmit` 通过。
- `packages/core/src/core` 全部通过：99 个文件，6,145 个测试。
- ACP agent-loop 对拍套件通过（25 个测试），Ink agent-loop 对拍套件也通过（14 个测试）。
- 改动文件的 prettier 和 eslint 检查通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Linux，Node 24。抓取时，改动后使用本分支打包的 `dist/cli.js`；改动前使用 2026-10-27 的 `main` 构建，其日期逻辑与 merge base 相同。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：
  - 检测依赖固定措辞。如果启动上下文开头几行改了而没有同步更新匹配规则，第一轮会重新收到一条 `Today's date is` 提醒。这种回退无害，而且针对 `buildStartupContextReminder` 的单元测试会发现这种偏差。
  - ACP 对拍用例现在期望两条路径的第一个 prompt 都不带日期提醒（之前期望共享路径带一条），因此它不再能证明共享路径会添加 client 的日期提醒。这条路径由 client 单元测试覆盖。

prs.title: fix(core): name the model and setting in media refusals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a model cannot accept an image, audio, or video file, Qwen Code refuses it with a message the model then reads. That message named neither the model nor the setting behind the refusal, and it read identically whether the input modalities were guessed from the model name or declared by the user. In both cases it ended by pointing at skills, which is the wrong direction when the real cause is a configuration value.

The refusal now leads with the model id and states how the modalities were resolved. A value inferred from the model name tells the caller to declare `generationConfig.modalities` on the provider entry. A value the user declared points at where it was declared instead. The rest of the guidance — that `read_file` cannot process the file either, and the skills fallback — is unchanged, as is the separate PDF wording that suggests installing the document-skills extension.

## Why it's needed

Reported in #16178. A provider-backed model with image input configured was refused, and the message sent the reporter down a resize-image path; the setting had been right all along and the resolved route genuinely had no image modality. The message was accurate about the state but not actionable, because the one fact that would have separated "you configured this wrong" from "we guessed wrong from the name" was already computed and then discarded.

The resolved configuration already tracks where each field came from, so the distinction costs no new resolution logic. The source kind is carried on the request context for the API-time path; the read_file path reads it directly. It is deliberately withheld when the generator is serving a model other than the configuration's primary one, so a sub-agent or side query cannot inherit the primary model's attribution and report a setting the user never set for it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Configure an OpenAI-compatible provider entry whose model id matches no known family pattern, without `generationConfig.modalities`, then ask the agent to read a PNG. The refusal should name that model id and say the modalities were inferred from the model name, with the exact JSON key to add.

Then add `"modalities": { "image": true }` to that entry and repeat: the image is read instead of refused, which confirms the advice points at the field that actually decides the outcome.

A model whose id does match a known vision pattern, with image modality left on, should still read images normally — the new text only replaces a refusal.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before and after are the text the model receives. Captured from the real read_file path and the real request-building pipeline, with a 1x1 PNG on disk and modalities resolving empty:

Before (both cases identical):

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". This model does not support image input. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

After, modalities guessed from the model name:

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". Model 'my-custom-openai-id' does not support image input: its input modalities were inferred from the model name. Declare "generationConfig": { "modalities": { "image": true } } on this provider entry to enable it. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

After, modalities declared on the provider entry without image:

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". Model 'my-custom-openai-id' does not support image input: this provider entry's "generationConfig.modalities" is set without image. Check it and re-select the model with /model. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Unit tests, type checking, lint, and formatting were all run inside a `node:22-bookworm` Linux container against the merged base. The macOS column is ⚠️ rather than ✅: the same suite also passes there, but the bundle build needed for the full CLI integration harness does not complete on this machine's container filesystem, so the end-to-end evidence above was produced from the source-level pipeline rather than a bundled CLI run. Nothing in this change is platform-specific.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests and type checking in a Linux container; no sandbox, no live model endpoint.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the refusal text is what the model reads, so changed wording can shift model behaviour around file handling. The leading clause keeps the substring previous assertions and any model familiarity rely on, and the advice is additive.
- Not validated / out of scope: the reporter's original observation that the setting appeared to need a restart is not addressed here. The modalities are re-resolved on auth refresh and on `/model`, so the hint says "re-select the model with /model" rather than claiming a restart is required; whether their hot-reload path was misbehaving is a separate question left open on the issue.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new request-context field is optional and nothing else reads the message text.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16178

prs.title: fix(web-shell): scope sidebarless polling to the connected workspace
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the Web Shell is embedded with `sidebar={false}`, the live-state poller uses the same workspace owner as the connected session’s activity indicator. A welcome view with no connected session has no workspace poll target. The selected owner must be a trusted workspace with an absolute path.

## Why it's needed

The sidebarless view currently polls every trusted workspace even when no conversation is open. Each embedded tab keeps sending these requests at the configured interval, so an idle view creates traffic proportional to the number of trusted workspaces.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open a sidebarless embed against a daemon advertising live-state support and three trusted workspaces. Observe the workspace live-state GETs on the welcome view, then open a session in one workspace and wait for three poll rounds. The welcome view should issue zero live-state GETs, and the connected view should poll only the session’s owner.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| View | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Welcome view, 1.25 seconds | 3 requests across 3 workspaces | 0 requests |
| Connected session | 3 distinct workspace targets | 1 target, the session owner |

Captured in headless Chromium against a local mock daemon. The cancel control stayed visible through running and waiting-for-permission snapshots, then disappeared on idle. All live-state GETs during those transitions went to the owner after the fix. Regression tests also cover a Live session with a uniquely resolved owner and a connected workspace that loses trust.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ |

### Environment

Node.js 22, headless Chromium, local mock daemon. Both regression cases failed on the original selection logic. The changed files pass Prettier and ESLint, and the Web Shell passes TypeScript checking. The App test selection passed 1,392 tests across three files.

Repository-wide format, lint, build and typecheck passed. The sandboxed preflight was blocked in `npm run test:ci`. The ACP and CLI process-tree tests failed when the sandbox denied `ps`; all four targeted process-tree cases passed on an isolated rerun. Core tests also hit `EPERM` while changing permissions on the default extension store.

## Risk & Scope

- The sidebarless poller now depends on the workspace owner resolved by the activity indicator. A Live session with ambiguous workspace ownership has no poll target.
- Cross-client task discovery and a production daemon load test are outside this change.
- No migration is required.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16355

AI assistance: OpenAI Codex investigated, implemented, and verified the change.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动

Web Shell 以 `sidebar={false}` 嵌入时，live-state 轮询使用与会话状态指示器相同的工作区归属。欢迎页没有已连接会话时，不会产生工作区轮询目标。被选中的工作区必须已受信任且路径为绝对路径。

## 原因

当前无侧栏视图会轮询所有受信任的工作区，即使没有打开会话。每个嵌入标签页都按配置间隔发出请求，空闲视图的流量会随受信任工作区的数量增长。

## 验证方法

用三个受信任的工作区和支持 live-state 的 daemon 打开无侧栏嵌入页。先观察欢迎页的工作区 live-state GET 请求，再打开其中一个工作区的会话，等待三轮轮询。欢迎页应没有 live-state GET，会话页应只轮询该会话所属的工作区。

| 场景 | 修复前 | 修复后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 欢迎页，观察 1.25 秒 | 3 个请求，覆盖 3 个工作区 | 0 个请求 |
| 已连接会话 | 轮询 3 个不同工作区 | 只轮询会话所属的 1 个工作区 |

请求记录来自连接本地模拟 daemon 的无头 Chromium。运行中和等待权限时，取消按钮保持可见，会话回到空闲时按钮消失。修复后，这些状态切换期间的所有 live-state GET 都发往会话所属工作区。回归测试还覆盖了能唯一确定归属的 Live 会话，以及会话所属工作区失去信任的情况。

macOS 上已验证，环境为 Node.js 22、无头 Chromium 和本地模拟 daemon。Windows 和 Linux 尚未本地验证。两项回归用例在原逻辑下均失败。改动文件通过 Prettier 和 ESLint，Web Shell 通过 TypeScript 类型检查。App 测试命中三个文件，1,392 项全部通过。

全仓格式检查、Lint、构建和类型检查通过。沙盒内的预检在 `npm run test:ci` 遇到权限限制。ACP 和 CLI 的进程树测试因为无法调用 `ps` 而失败，四项相关测试单独重跑全部通过。Core 测试在修改默认扩展目录的权限时也遇到 `EPERM`。

## 风险与范围

- 无侧栏轮询依赖会话状态指示器确定的工作区归属。无法唯一确定归属的 Live 会话不会产生轮询目标。
- 跨客户端任务发现与生产 daemon 负载测试超出本次改动范围。
- 无需迁移。

关联 #16355。使用 OpenAI Codex 调查、修改和验证。

</details>
