prs.title: fix(web-shell): keep the report final when a background shell ack follows
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The collapsed Web Shell view of a turn shows only the turn's "final answer" plus non-hideable rows, and `findFinalAnswerIndex` picked the last non-empty assistant message with no later work step. A background shell completion notification is a system message, not a turn boundary, so when a background shell command finished mid-turn the model's bookkeeping ack to the notification became the "final answer" and the real report was hidden behind the chevron.

This PR teaches `findFinalAnswerIndex` to skip a shell-completion ack: an assistant reply is no longer treated as the final answer when it (1) follows a background-turn marker, (2) is preceded only by thinking blocks after that marker (no further work, no user steering), (3) the marker is a shell completion, and (4) the turn already produced a candidate answer before the marker. Agent/peer completions — whose summaries the parent synthesizes into its reply — and genuine post-marker continuations are never reclassified.

A second bot-review round asked for the fold decision to be one testable rule instead of a set of ad-hoc guards. The rule now lives in `utils/shellCompletionAck.ts` as a single `spanClear` scan shared by the collapse path and `/copy`: a reply folds only when the nearest preceding marker is a shell completion, the turn already produced an assistant main answer before that marker (a raw machine notification never licenses a fold), and only thoughts, markers, daemon bookkeeping rows, and turn chrome sit in the spans around the reply. Turn chrome (a new `isTurnChrome` row class) makes a `turn_outputs` card spliced into the turn transparent instead of a veto. The `turnAwaitsBackgroundSummary` gate passes the rule with ack-skipping off, so a completed shell turn still collapses, and `/copy` bounds its span at the turn's own end. The now-redundant `includeBackgroundNotifications` parameter was deleted rather than reconciled across call sites.

Round 3 addresses a second hijack of the same heuristic reported in #13998: a
turn that ends with a one-line completion note (a Todo Stop Guard or similar
closer) after a substantial answer folds the report and shows the note. A new
resolution step in the collapse path (`resolveDeliverableAnswerIdx` in
`MessageList.tsx`) now stands the final candidate only if it is a deliverable
— an ordinary assistant reply (never an agent reply) of at least 1000
characters carrying a Markdown heading. Otherwise the nearest preceding
deliverable in the same turn stands instead, and with none the original
candidate stands (fail-toward-showing-more, so nothing is hidden). The step
applies in the collapse path only, composes with the shell-ack fold (a
well-formed ack never carries report text), and leaves the shared
`findFinalAnswerIndex` and the `/copy` span untouched. The round also repairs
the integration typecheck: `shellCompletionAck.ts` imported
`../adapters/types` without the `.js` extension required by the
integration-tests nodenext module resolution.

Round 4 relaxes the deliverable predicate after a live report against the
patched build: a final report that opens with a plain summary line or a pipe
table (no Markdown heading) was folded in favor of an earlier headed plan,
hiding the actual result. `isDeliverableAnswer` no longer requires a heading
— a deliverable is an ordinary assistant reply (never an agent reply) of at
least 1000 characters. The 1000-character floor alone keeps short closers and
guard lines out of the rule; the heading requirement was the only
over-restrictive part of the predicate.

## Why it's needed

When a long-running background shell command (e.g. a scheduled/cron job) completes, the user's turn ends with a short model ack ("Done.") while the actual multi-paragraph report written moments earlier disappears from the collapsed view. The user sees only the ack and must expand the chevron to find the deliverable; in practice the report was effectively invisible. Reported in #13998 with a deterministic repro.

A second report with the same root cause followed: a long-running session
whose final answer was a multi-paragraph report (3,360 characters) closed
with a short Todo Stop Guard line. The guard line — a plain assistant message
with no later work step — won the final-answer scan, and the collapsed turn
showed only the closer. The deliverable rule keeps the report visible in this
shape: the short final line stands only when no deliverable precedes it.

A third report with the same root cause followed, observed on a live patched
build: a session whose final answer was a heading-less report (1,332
characters, a pipe table) collapsed to an earlier 3,291-character headed plan
line — the turn showed the plan, not the result. The heading requirement in
the deliverable predicate was over-restrictive for this shape; round 4
removes it, leaving the length floor as the only gate.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The behavior lives in `findFinalAnswerIndex` (packages/web-shell/client/components/MessageList.tsx) and is exercised at the `applyTurnCollapse` level. Five new tests in `components/MessageList.test.ts`:

- `retains the main reply when a background task ack follows the notification marker` — the production shape (report → shell marker → ack); **fails on main, passes with this PR**
- `keeps the last ordinary reply final when no background marker is present` — regression guard for the no-marker path
- `keeps the post-marker summary final for an agent completion` — agent summaries stay final even with a thinking-only gap
- `keeps the reply final when further work follows the shell marker` — work after the marker makes the reply a real continuation
- `keeps the reply final when the user steers after the shell marker` — steering after the marker makes the reply a real continuation

Round 2 added the unified rule's test surface: 10 new tests in `components/MessageList.test.ts` (a `turn_outputs` card no longer vetoes the fold; the gate collapses a completed shell turn; the raw notification is neither the final answer nor a fold license; two consecutive background completions fold both acks; no answer before the marker keeps the ack final; a `completed` marker status still folds; work or a parallel-agent group after the main answer keeps the ack final; the timeline detail is the ack, not the notification), 4 in `utils/copyCommand.test.ts` (the copy span is bounded at the turn's end), and 2 in `components/MessageList.dom.test.tsx` (the footer lands on the main reply with a `turn_outputs` card present). Every mutant named in the round-2 review is pinned red by one of these tests and green on the fixed code.

Round 3 adds the `turn-collapse deliverable final answer` block: 8 new tests
in `components/MessageList.test.ts` (the report stands over a short closer;
long text without a heading does not stand; a plain interim note before the
report keeps the report final; the last of several deliverables stands; a
headed reply below the length floor does not stand; the tagged shell ack
still folds next to a report; an agent reply is never a deliverable; a reply
at exactly the length floor stands). Each named mutant is pinned red:
candidate-check, heading-check, length-floor, backward-scan.

Round 4 reworks one of the eight (long text without a heading now stands over
the short closer — the v2 expectation was the bug) and adds the live-repro
regression: a heading-less long final keeps standing even when a headed plan
precedes it. The deliverable block now has 9 tests; every mutant is still
pinned red — candidate-check, length-floor, backward-scan (the heading-check
mutant is retired with the heading requirement).

Run:

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts components/MessageList.test.ts
```

Expected: all green, including the five round-1 tests, the 16 new round-2 tests, and the pre-existing turn-collapse suite.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Unit-level (the collapsed rows are exactly the user-visible rows). Before — on main, the new repro test is RED:

```
 FAIL  components/MessageList.test.ts > retains the main reply when a background task ack follows the notification marker
AssertionError: expected false to be true
```

After — with the PR, the targeted suites are green:

```
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  398 passed (398)
```

(`MessageList.test.ts` 194 + `MessageList.dom.test.tsx` 186 + `copyCommand.test.ts` 18.) Full web-shell `client` on this head: 11 545/11 546 tests across 429/430 files — the single failure is the bundle-ceiling assertion in `build-artifact.test.ts`, documented in Risk & Scope below.

Round 3 — with the deliverable rule, the targeted suites are green on the
round-3 head (Docker, node:22-bookworm, head bbe794f839):

```
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  438 passed (438)
```

(`MessageList.test.ts` 202, including the 8 new deliverable tests, +
`transcriptToMessages.test.ts` 236.) Each of the four named mutants
(candidate-check, heading-check, length-floor, backward-scan) goes red
against the fixed test and green on the pristine code; the integration
typecheck this round repairs is at 0.

Round 4 — with the heading requirement dropped, the deliverable suite is
green on the round-4 head c6d852fa9cb2b4207d0cbd6d6c3649be080a1f84 (Docker, node:22-bookworm):

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  203 passed (203)
```

(`MessageList.test.ts` 203, including the 9 deliverable tests; the new
regression is red on the round-3 code and green on the round-4 head.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Docker `node:22-bookworm` container running the web-shell vitest suites (tests cannot run on the host). The full web-shell suite ran on head 5ae80d84 on all three platforms: macOS (host, node 22.23.1, darwin-arm64) 430/430 files, 11 514/11 514 tests; Linux (Docker, node:22-bookworm, aarch64) full 11 483/11 514 (31 failures across 4 files: build-artifact 28 = dist not built without prepare, browser-turn-notifications/BranchPickerPopover/vite-config 1 each = full-suite load artifacts; all 4 green in isolation with dist: 28/28, 42/42, 145/145, 21/21) with tsc and eslint at 0; Windows (UTM Win11 ARM VM, node 22.23.3) full 11 512/11 514 — the 2 failures are 5s vite-startup timeouts under WinOnArm emulation, reproduced in isolation (build-artifact 27/28, vite-config 20/21 — the documented platform-timing class), tsc at 0. The round-2 head 049f77a802 was re-verified in Docker (node:22-bookworm): full `client` 11 545/11 546 (the single failure is the bundle-ceiling assertion below), the three targeted suites 398/398, and eslint/prettier clean on the changed files. The original bug was observed live in the Web Shell on macOS (Desktop 0.25.0) with a cron-scheduled background shell task. The round-3 head bbe794f839 was re-verified in Docker (node:22-bookworm): the targeted suites 438/438, integration and web-shell tsc at 0, eslint and prettier clean, and the four named mutants pinned red. The round-4 head c6d852fa9cb2b4207d0cbd6d6c3649be080a1f84 was re-verified in Docker (node:22-bookworm): `MessageList.test.ts` 203/203, integration and web-shell tsc at 0, eslint and prettier clean on the changed files.

## Risk & Scope

- Deliverable threshold: a genuine final line of under 1000 characters that
  follows a substantial report now yields to the report (the note remains
  visible on expand). This is the intended tradeoff of the rule; turns with
  no deliverable are untouched (fail-toward-showing-more). The 1000-character
  floor keeps ordinary short answers ("Done.", guard lines) out of the rule.
  Round 4 dropped the heading requirement: heading-less reports (pipe tables,
  plain summary lines) count as deliverables, fixing the live repro where a
  1,332-character pipe-table report lost to a headed plan line.
- Bundle size: the round-2 finding (the transcript entry measuring 1,330,262 bytes stylesheet-stripped, 762 bytes over the then-1,329,500-byte ceiling) is superseded upstream: main removed the fixed ceiling itself (`test(web-shell): remove fixed transcript bundle size ceiling`, #14703), which this head carries — `build-artifact.test.ts` is fully green (40/40) on the round-3 head and no further bundle change is required. The round-2 module compaction (−326 bytes) remains in the diff.
- Main risk or tradeoff: a genuine reply to a shell completion could be misclassified as an ack and hidden. Mitigated: the reclassification requires all four conditions simultaneously (shell-kind marker, thinking-only gap, prior main candidate, no later work/steering); agent/peer completions and any real continuation keep their reply final. All four boundaries are pinned by the new tests.
- Not validated / out of scope: visual e2e (visuals harness); the change is covered at the `collapseItems` unit level, which decides exactly which rows render.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #13998

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

Web Shell 的折叠视图只展示一轮对话的"最终回答"加上不可隐藏的行，而 `findFinalAnswerIndex` 选取的是最后一个"其后没有工作步骤"的非空 assistant 消息。后台 shell 命令完成时的通知是 system 消息，不构成回合边界，因此当后台 shell 命令在回合中完成时，模型对通知的事务性应答（ack）会被当作"最终回答"，真正的报告就被藏在折叠箭头后面。

本 PR 让 `findFinalAnswerIndex` 学会跳过 shell 完成应答：当一条 assistant 回复 (1) 紧跟后台回合标记（background-turn marker）之后，(2) 标记之后到该回复之间只有思考块（没有进一步的工作、没有用户介入），(3) 该标记是 shell 完成，且 (4) 回合在标记之前已经产生了候选回答时，它不再被当作最终回答。agent/peer 完成（其摘要会被父级综合进回复）以及标记后的真实续写永远不会被重新归类。

第二轮 bot 评审要求把折叠判定从一组临时守卫变成一条可测试的规则。规则现在位于 `utils/shellCompletionAck.ts`，作为折叠路径与 `/copy` 共享的一次 `spanClear` 扫描：只有当最近的前置标记是 shell 完成、该标记之前回合已产生 assistant 主回答（原始机器通知永远不构成折叠许可）、且回复两侧的区间内只有思考块、标记、daemon 记账行与回合 chrome 时，回复才被折叠。回合 chrome（新增 `isTurnChrome` 行类）使插入回合中的 `turn_outputs` 卡片透明而非一票否决。`turnAwaitsBackgroundSummary` 门以关闭 ack 跳过的方式调用规则，因此完成的 shell 回合仍能折叠；`/copy` 的区间现在以回合自身结尾为界。冗余的 `includeBackgroundNotifications` 参数被删除，而不是在各调用点间协调。

第三轮处理 #13998 中同一启发式被劫持的第二个形态：回合在实质性回答之后以简短的
完成注记（Todo Stop Guard 或类似收尾行）结束时，折叠视图会把报告折掉、只显示收尾行。
折叠路径中新增的解析步骤（`MessageList.tsx` 中的 `resolveDeliverableAnswerIdx`）
现在只有在最终候选本身是"交付物"时才让它站住——交付物定义为普通 assistant 回复
（agent 回复永远不算）、至少 1000 字符且带 Markdown 标题。否则，同一回合中最近的
先前交付物代替站住；若没有任何交付物，原候选站住（fail-toward-showing-more，
即不额外隐藏任何内容）。该步骤只作用于折叠路径，与 shell-ack 折叠规则组合
（规范的 ack 从不携带报告文本），共享的 `findFinalAnswerIndex` 与 `/copy`
区间不受影响。同一提交还修复了集成类型检查：`shellCompletionAck.ts` 导入
`../adapters/types` 时缺少 integration-tests 的 nodenext 模块解析所要求的 `.js` 扩展名。

第四轮针对打在打过补丁的构建上的现场报告放宽了交付物谓词：以普通总结行或
管道表格开头（无 Markdown 标题）的最终报告，会被折叠成一个更早的带标题计划，
实际结果被隐藏。`isDeliverableAnswer` 不再要求标题——交付物即普通 assistant
回复（agent 回复永远不算）、至少 1000 字符。仅靠 1000 字符下限就能把短收尾
行和 guard 行排除在规则之外；标题要求是谓词中唯一过严的部分。

## 为什么需要

当一个长时间运行的后台 shell 命令（例如定时/cron 任务）完成时，用户回合以一个简短的模型应答（"Done."）结束，而此前刚写出的多段落实际报告从折叠视图中消失。用户只能看到应答，必须展开箭头才能找到真正的交付内容——实际上报告基本不可见。已在 #13998 中报告并附可复现步骤。

随后出现同一根因的第二例报告：一个长会话的最终回答是多段落报告（3,360 字符），
末尾以简短的 Todo Stop Guard 行收尾。该 Guard 行——一条其后没有工作步骤的普通
assistant 消息——赢得了最终回答扫描，折叠回合只显示收尾行。交付物规则在这种形态下
保留报告可见：只有当收尾行之前没有交付物时，这条简短的最终行才站住。

第三例同源报告出现在打过补丁的构建上：一个会话的最终回答是无标题报告
（1,332 字符，管道表格），折叠后展示的却是更早的一条 3,291 字符带标题计划行
——回合显示的是计划，而不是结果。交付物谓词中的标题要求对这种形态过严；
第四轮将其移除，长度下限成为唯一的门。

该行为位于 `findFinalAnswerIndex`（packages/web-shell/client/components/MessageList.tsx），在 `applyTurnCollapse` 层面测试。`components/MessageList.test.ts` 中新增 5 个测试：

- `retains the main reply when a background task ack follows the notification marker`——生产环境形态（报告 → shell 标记 → 应答）；**在 main 上失败，本 PR 通过**
- `keeps the last ordinary reply final when no background marker is present`——无标记路径的回归保护
- `keeps the post-marker summary final for an agent completion`——即使只有思考块间隔，agent 摘要仍保持最终
- `keeps the reply final when further work follows the shell marker`——标记后还有工作时，回复是真实续写
- `keeps the reply final when the user steers after the shell marker`——标记后用户介入时，回复是真实续写

第二轮新增了统一规则的测试面：`components/MessageList.test.ts` 10 个新测试（`turn_outputs` 卡片不再一票否决折叠；门使完成的 shell 回合折叠；原始通知既不是最终回答也不构成折叠许可；两个连续后台完成折叠两条 ack；标记前无回答时 ack 保持最终；标记带 `completed` 状态仍折叠；主回答后的工作或并行 agent 组使 ack 保持最终；时间线详情是 ack 而非通知）、`utils/copyCommand.test.ts` 4 个（复制区间以回合结尾为界）、`components/MessageList.dom.test.tsx` 2 个（存在 `turn_outputs` 卡片时 footer 落在主回答上）。第二轮评审点名的每个突变体都被其中一个测试固定为红、在修复代码上为绿。

第三轮新增 `turn-collapse deliverable final answer` 测试块：
`components/MessageList.test.ts` 中 8 个新测试（报告胜过其后的短收尾行；无标题的
长文本不站住；报告前的普通中间注记保持报告为最终；多个交付物中最后一个站住；
低于长度下限的带标题回复不站住；报告旁边的带标记 shell ack 仍折叠；agent 回复
永远不算交付物；恰好达到长度下限的回复站住）。每个被点名的突变体都被固定为红：
候选检查、标题检查、长度下限、回扫。

本身就是 bug），并加入现场复现的回归测试：无标题的长最终回答即使前面有带标题
计划也保持站住。交付物块现为 9 个测试；所有突变体仍被固定为红——候选检查、
长度下限、回扫（标题检查突变体随标题要求一起退役）。

prs.title: fix(ci): clear the pinned corepack cache before every install
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Clears the shard-owned corepack cache at the start of the shared dependency-install step, so a Linux shard starts from an empty package-manager cache instead of trusting whatever state an earlier job left on the host. The deletion is scoped to the exact pinned path: it fires only when the cache variable equals the shard's own disposable directory, never against a runner-exported shared cache or the lint lane's already-warmed run-unique home. Adds workflow meta-test pins plus an execution test that runs the shipped guard fragment under a scrubbed environment, and bumps the workflow size baseline for the added lines.

## Why it's needed

Since #16328 pinned the corepack cache to a runner-temp path, main has been failing repeatedly in the Linux unit-test shards. Runs 41876940141, 41889761157 and 41927887452 each had shards die within a second of entering the install step with `Error: Cannot find module '…/qwen-ci-corepack/v1/pnpm/11.24.0/bin/pnpm.mjs'` (`MODULE_NOT_FOUND`), on six different self-hosted hosts (ecs-qwen-hk3-24, hk4-10, hk5-5, hk3-9, hk5-25, hk5-11); the aggregate gate then reddens the required Linux check. The failing jobs never attempt a download — they die instantly on a cache hit.

What is observed: the pinned cache entry existed with its pnpm binary missing; corepack (0.34.6, bundled with the fleet's Node 22.23.2) treats an existing entry as valid by reading its marker file, without re-verifying that the binaries are present; and the runner's temp directory survives across jobs on self-hosted runners — the lint lane's isolated-HOME step already documents this fact. **What left the entry incomplete is undetermined** (a killed install, host-level cleanup, or an older corepack's non-atomic extraction are all candidates); the fix is deliberately neutral to the cause. Because the directory persists, any such state keeps failing every later job on that host until it is removed, which is why the failures spread across the fleet and persisted across runs.

The reset starts the shard-owned cache empty on every install. The test step still reuses the cache the install step warms within the same job, preserving #16328's fix for the cold-download timeout flake. Already-affected hosts self-heal on their next job — no manual fleet cleanup is needed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the workflow meta-tests: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js` — expect 311 passed, 1 skipped (the skip is the pre-existing Bash-version gate). The pins turn red if the scoped guard is dropped from any of the three shared install copies, moved after the install command, widened back to a nonempty check, or if the test step's cache path drifts from the install step's.
2. The new execution test runs the guard fragment sliced from the real install body (not a copy) under a from-scratch environment across five cache shapes: the shard-owned path is cleared; a runner-exported shared cache, lint's run-unique warmed home, the default cache (variable unset), and an empty variable all survive, with a bystander sentinel in every cell. Mutation witnesses at this head: a dead-guard mutant that keeps every pinned literal but never executes the reset is killed by the shard-owned cell; a widened guard (equality OR nonempty, reproducing both review findings) is killed by the shared-cache survival cell; reverting to the old nonempty guard is killed by the extraction and spelling pins.
3. Local reproduction of the incident and the fix: a cache entry with a valid marker but a missing pnpm binary reproduces the CI signature (`Cannot find module …/bin/pnpm.mjs`, `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`) with no download attempt; after the reset fragment, corepack downloads the pinned pnpm fresh and prints `11.24.0`.
4. After merge, watch the next main run: shards landing on previously-affected hosts should install cleanly instead of dying in under a second.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before — run 41927887452, shard 2/8, host ecs-qwen-hk3-9, ~0.4 s into the install step:

```
Error: Cannot find module '/home/github-runner/actions-runner-hk3-9/_work/_temp/qwen-ci-corepack/v1/pnpm/11.24.0/bin/pnpm.mjs'
    at Function._resolveFilename (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1430:15)
    ...
  code: 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND',
  requireStack: []
Node.js v22.23.2
##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
```

After — local poisoned-cache reproduction, same command before and after the reset fragment:

```
# poisoned cache (marker present, binary missing):
Error: Cannot find module '/tmp/corepack-poison-demo2/home/v1/pnpm/11.24.0/bin/pnpm.mjs'
# after the scoped reset fragment:
11.24.0
```

Fleet-level confirmation requires the next main run on the previously-affected hosts.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

The change only touches the three Linux install bodies; the macOS and Windows lanes have separate install steps that are unchanged. The execution test skips on Windows (POSIX shell fragment), matching the existing platform gates in the scripts suite.

### Environment (optional)

Meta-tests via the repository's scripts vitest config; corepack reproduction with Node v24.22.1 / corepack 0.36.0 against a throwaway cache directory (cache-hit mechanism identical to the fleet's 0.34.6, verified from both sources); `bash -n` syntax check on all three extracted install bodies; mutation witnesses restored byte-exactly (sha256-verified).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: on self-hosted shards this is a **new per-job download** of the pinned pnpm (the verification round measured a ~21 MB cache entry, 4.8–7.5 s cold vs 126–160 ms warm hit). Before this change a later shard on the same host reused the persisted cache — which is exactly how an incomplete entry kept killing jobs. The trade is one download per job against immunity to persisted cache state. Hosted shards are unaffected: their pinned home was already cold, because the pnpm-store step warms the default home, not the pinned one.
- The scoped guard keeps the reset a no-op in the build job (no step-level cache variable; a runner-exported shared cache is never a deletion target) and in lint (its run-unique home is cleared at job start and may already be warmed by the hosted pnpm-store step).
- Not validated / out of scope: which historical event left the first incomplete entry on each host — the reset is robust to all candidates and self-heals the fleet. The build lane's default persistent corepack cache is deliberately unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #16328. Fixes the main-branch failures in runs 41876940141, 41889761157 and 41927887452 (no tracking issue filed).

自 #16328 把 corepack 缓存 pin 到 runner 临时目录后，main 的 Linux 单测分片持续失败。Run 41876940141、41889761157、41927887452 都有分片在进入安装步骤后一秒内死于 `Error: Cannot find module '…/qwen-ci-corepack/v1/pnpm/11.24.0/bin/pnpm.mjs'`（`MODULE_NOT_FOUND`），涉及六台不同的自建 runner（ecs-qwen-hk3-24、hk4-10、hk5-5、hk3-9、hk5-25、hk5-11）；聚合门禁随之把必需的 Linux 检查打红。失败的 job 根本没有尝试下载——它们在缓存命中后瞬间死亡。

### 如何验证

1. 运行工作流 meta-test：`npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js` —— 预期 311 通过、1 跳过（跳过的是既有的 Bash 版本门槛）。若三份共享安装步骤体中任何一份丢掉限定守卫、把清空挪到安装命令之后、放宽回非空判断、或测试步骤的缓存路径与安装步骤漂移，钉子都会变红。

3. 本地复现故障与修复：标记有效但二进制缺失的缓存条目可复现 CI 签名（`Cannot find module …/bin/pnpm.mjs`，`MODULE_NOT_FOUND`），且无下载尝试；执行清空片段后 corepack 重新下载 pin 的 pnpm 并输出 `11.24.0`。
4. 合并后观察下一次 main run：落到此前受影响机器上的分片应能正常安装，而不是一秒内死亡。

### 证据（前后对比）

prs.title: fix(ci): purge stale corepack cache before Linux shard install
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Gives each Linux unit-test shard its own corepack home: the job mints a fresh directory with `mktemp`, exports it through `GITHUB_ENV`, the install and test steps read it, and a cleanup step removes it. The old fixed path under `RUNNER_TEMP` is no longer read, written, or deleted.

## Why it's needed

Main has been red since the #16328 merge: the first main run after it, and four more since, lost one or two Linux shards in `Install dependencies` within a second, before pnpm ran, with `Error: Cannot find module '.../_work/_temp/qwen-ci-corepack/v1/pnpm/11.24.0/bin/pnpm.mjs'`.

The shard job pinned `COREPACK_HOME` to `${{ runner.temp }}/qwen-ci-corepack`. On this self-hosted fleet `RUNNER_TEMP` survives across jobs (the lint job says so and builds a run-unique `HOME` for that reason), so the pinned home was shared state: one host kept failing after an entry appeared under `v1/pnpm/11.24.0` with `package.json` present and `bin/pnpm.mjs` missing. Corepack, on a cache hit, resolves the bin from the cached metadata and runs it without checking the tree, so every later job on that host died at the same line. How the entry was damaged is not established; this PR does not depend on knowing.

A first revision deleted the fixed path before installing. That is not safe: `rm -rf` fails when a nonempty subtree is owned by another UID (or is otherwise unwritable), and that failure would gate the install on a cache the job does not need. Minting a directory leaves the old state untouched and makes a per-job home the only state read.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The creation step is gated exactly like the install and sits immediately before it; both consumers inherit `COREPACK_HOME` from `GITHUB_ENV` and carry no step-level value. The cleanup step runs with `always()` and deletes only `QWEN_CI_COREPACK_HOME`, a private marker the creation step exports, so a `COREPACK_HOME` inherited from the runner is never removed.

The added regression test executes both steps against a temporary `RUNNER_TEMP` that already contains a broken `qwen-ci-corepack/v1/pnpm/11.24.0` entry: it asserts the minted home is a different, empty directory, that a second job gets a different one, that cleanup removes only the minted homes, that the broken entry is left untouched, and (when the suite runs inside the shard job) that the live home survives. Mutation checks run locally: reverting to the fixed path, switching cleanup to `COREPACK_HOME`, dropping the private marker, or drifting the creation gate all turn the suite red.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (CI, run 41927887452 / shard 2): `Error: Cannot find module '/home/github-runner/actions-runner-hk3-9/_work/_temp/qwen-ci-corepack/v1/pnpm/11.24.0/bin/pnpm.mjs'` after 0.36 s in `Install dependencies`.
Before (local): with only `package.json` in a cache entry, `corepack pnpm --version` throws the same `Cannot find module .../bin/pnpm.mjs`; with an unwritable `bin/` containing a file, `rm -rf` of that subtree fails, which is why the purge design was dropped.
After (local, running the workflow steps): a fresh home is minted per job, corepack installs the pinned pnpm into it, cleanup removes it, and both the broken shared entry and an inherited `COREPACK_HOME` are untouched.

Local checks:

- `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts ci-platform-lanes.test.js workflow-size.test.js ci-build-cache.test.js no-ak-integration-ci.test.js main-ci-failure-issue-workflow.test.js` -> 495 passed, 1 skipped.
- `node --test .github/scripts/check-ci-budget.test.mjs` -> 2 passed.
- `npx prettier --check` and `npx eslint` on the changed test file -> clean.
- The suite run with COREPACK_HOME and QWEN_CI_COREPACK_HOME pointing at a sentinel directory leaves the sentinel intact (the test sanitizes the inherited environment).

CI on this head (run 41941385724): all eight Linux shards passed, with `Create isolated corepack home`, `Install dependencies`, and `Remove isolated corepack home` succeeding on each; `Lint & Static`, the aggregate `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)` gate, and the integration/web-shell lanes are green. The updated scripts suite ran on shard 7 (`ci-platform-lanes.test.js`, 73 tests), so the new regression test executed on the fleet.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 24.22.1 with corepack 0.36.0 against the repository's pinned pnpm 11.24.0; the failing job runs the self-hosted Node 22.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: each shard job now always downloads the pinned pnpm (about 21 MB) instead of reusing whatever a previous job left. That is the price of not trusting shared state; the cleanup step bounds the footprint on normal completion, and a hard kill can leave one uniquely named directory behind.
- Not validated / out of scope: this run did not necessarily land on a host that still holds the broken fixed-path entry. The code no longer reads that path at all, and the local regression test plants the exact shape.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

References #16328.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

给每个 Linux 单元测试 shard 一个独立的 corepack home：job 用 `mktemp` 新建目录，通过 `GITHUB_ENV` 导出，安装步骤与 test 步骤共用它，最后由清理步骤删除。`RUNNER_TEMP` 下原先的固定路径不再被读取、写入或删除。

## 为什么需要

#16328 合入之后 main 一直红：合入后的第一次 main run 以及其后四次，每次都有 1–2 个 Linux shard 在 `Install dependencies` 里不到一秒失败，pnpm 还没启动就报 `Error: Cannot find module '.../_work/_temp/qwen-ci-corepack/v1/pnpm/11.24.0/bin/pnpm.mjs'`。

shard job 把 `COREPACK_HOME` pin 到 `${{ runner.temp }}/qwen-ci-corepack`。在这套 self-hosted fleet 上 `RUNNER_TEMP` 跨 job 存活（lint job 的注释明确写了这一点，并因此使用 run-unique 的 `HOME`），所以这个被 pin 的 home 是共享状态：某台主机上出现了 `v1/pnpm/11.24.0` 下存在 `package.json`、却缺少 `bin/pnpm.mjs` 的条目之后，该主机的每个后续 job 都在同一行失败。corepack 命中缓存时按缓存里的元数据解析 bin 并直接运行，不会校验目录内容。该条目是如何损坏的尚无定论，本 PR 也不依赖这个结论。

最初的一版是在安装前删除固定路径。这不安全：当非空子树属于其他 UID（或不可写）时 `rm -rf` 会失败，而这个失败会把安装卡在一个 job 根本不需要的缓存上。新建目录则完全不碰旧状态，让 per-job home 成为唯一被读取的状态。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

创建步骤与安装步骤的门禁完全一致，并紧挨在它前面；两个消费方都从 `GITHUB_ENV` 继承 `COREPACK_HOME`，自身不再带 step-level 值。清理步骤用 `always()` 运行，只删除创建步骤导出的私有标记 `QWEN_CI_COREPACK_HOME`，因此从 runner 继承来的 `COREPACK_HOME` 不会被删。

新增的回归测试会在一个临时 `RUNNER_TEMP` 里执行这两个步骤，且该目录里已预置损坏的 `qwen-ci-corepack/v1/pnpm/11.24.0` 条目：断言新生成的 home 是另一个空目录、第二个 job 得到不同的目录、清理只删除本 job 生成的目录、损坏条目保持不动，并且在套件运行于 shard job 内时当前 job 的活 home 仍然存在。本地做过变异验证：退回固定路径、清理改用 `COREPACK_HOME`、去掉私有标记、让创建步骤门禁漂移，都会让套件变红。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

修改前（CI，run 41927887452 / shard 2）：`Install dependencies` 在 0.36 秒后报 `Error: Cannot find module '/home/github-runner/actions-runner-hk3-9/_work/_temp/qwen-ci-corepack/v1/pnpm/11.24.0/bin/pnpm.mjs'`。
修改前（本机）：缓存条目里只保留 `package.json` 时，`corepack pnpm --version` 抛出同样的 `Cannot find module .../bin/pnpm.mjs`；`bin/` 不可写且含有文件时，`rm -rf` 该子树失败——这正是放弃 purge 方案的原因。
修改后（本机执行 workflow 步骤）：每个 job 生成新的 home，corepack 把 pinned pnpm 安装进去，清理步骤删除它；损坏的共享条目与从环境继承的 `COREPACK_HOME` 都不受影响。

本地检查：

- `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts ci-platform-lanes.test.js workflow-size.test.js ci-build-cache.test.js no-ak-integration-ci.test.js main-ci-failure-issue-workflow.test.js` -> 495 通过，1 跳过。
- `node --test .github/scripts/check-ci-budget.test.mjs` -> 2 通过。
- `npx prettier --check` 与 `npx eslint`（改动过的测试文件）-> 干净。
- 把 COREPACK_HOME 与 QWEN_CI_COREPACK_HOME 指向一个哨兵目录再跑套件，哨兵目录仍在（测试会清理继承的环境）。

本 head 的 CI（run 41941385724）：8 个 Linux shard 全部通过，每个 shard 的 `Create isolated corepack home`、`Install dependencies`、`Remove isolated corepack home` 均成功；`Lint & Static`、聚合 gate `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)` 以及集成/web-shell 各 lane 均绿。更新后的 scripts 套件在 shard 7 执行（`ci-platform-lanes.test.js`，73 个测试），说明新回归测试已在 fleet 上真实运行。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  | N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

本机 Node 24.22.1 / corepack 0.36.0，使用仓库 pinned 的 pnpm 11.24.0；失败的 job 使用 self-hosted 的 Node 22。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：每个 shard job 现在都会重新下载 pinned pnpm（约 21 MB），不再复用上一个 job 留下的内容。这是不信任共享状态的代价；清理步骤在正常结束时限制占用，硬杀可能留下一个唯一命名的目录。
- 未验证 / 范围外：本次 run 不一定落在仍持有损坏固定路径条目的主机上。代码已完全不读取该路径，本地回归测试构造了完全相同的条目形态。
- 破坏性改动 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

引用 #16328。

</details>

prs.title: perf(managed-agent): take ordinary tool publication and read leases off the tenant lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Ordinary non-CSI tool publication uses the Session root and head before its publication rows, without acquiring the tenant `output_publication` guard. This applies to reservation, renewal, fencing, producer work, admission, receipts and tool-result projection. Projection completion reuses the locks acquired by admission within the same transaction and rechecks private-Session refusal without reacquiring the tenant guard. CSI originals and receipts carrying lifecycle authority retain their existing guard acquisition.

Read-lease creation and renewal also avoid the tenant publication guard while preserving Session-root exclusion, retirement-generation checks and expiry checks. Quarantining a corrupt publication object locks its Session root, head and publication row, so a read transaction cannot reacquire the tenant guard after its root.

Tenant byte and active-capture limits remain protective caps: overlapping reservations of different Sessions may briefly exceed them; later reservations see committed totals and are refused until capacity is freed. The Session byte limit remains exact through root serialization. Tenant-wide expired-reservation fencing now has the existing five-second hot-path statement timeout and `tenant_guard_contended` mapping. Capacity accounting is extracted to keep the existing publication stores below their size ceilings, and the facade inventory includes the intentional writer overload.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/publication-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-publication-tenant-guards.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/publication-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-publication-tenant-guards.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

Publication steps and resource reads from unrelated Sessions queued on one tenant row behind retention, collection and one another. Removing that serialization also requires closing every path that reacquires the guard after the Session root, and bounding expired-row contention while the lane holds placement.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Hold the tenant publication guard on a separate connection. Ordinary reservation, dispatch, finish, admission and receipt should complete; holding placement should still produce the existing bounded refusal. CSI and lifecycle-authority lanes should retain their existing fencing semantics.
2. Force an unexpired read lease into its renewal window inside a transaction that holds its Session root. Renewal should extend expiry while the tenant guard remains held elsewhere. Quarantine under that root should also complete and mark the publication and resource as quarantined.
3. Hold another Session's expired OPEN capture row. A fresh reservation should return `tenant_guard_contended` within the hot-path bound, rather than wait for the database default. After release, retry should succeed and fence the expired capture. The regression sets the worker's database timeout to twenty seconds, above the fifteen-second assertion ceiling.
4. Verify publication/quota behavior, read-lease fences, lock contracts, the exact facade method inventory and the complete class-size assertion. Full concurrent publication/collection/quota qualification across different Sessions remains outstanding; the new expired-row witness covers one independent-connection contention case.
5. With the tenant guard held independently, complete a valid claimed ordinary projection and expect true, READY, rebuilt artifact rows and one result event within fifteen seconds. A Session pinned after claim must instead return false, remain LEASED and write no artifact rows or result event. Dedicated CSI and non-null lifecycle-authority receipt guard witnesses remain missing acceptance cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI evidence. At the preceding head, two real MySQL probes reproduced an unnamed expired-row lock timeout and quarantine waiting for the tenant guard after its Session root. Both pass after the fixes. The quarantine probe exercises the internal locking boundary; it does not claim a public-API corruption test or an observed MySQL 1213 deadlock.

At `5ebbce9`, focused verification selected 170 tests: 169 passed, one failed, zero errors and zero skips. Publication/quota tests (128), retention tests (21), lock-contract tests (13), facade tests (5) and the two MySQL probes passed. After strengthening the database timeout and registering the newly threshold-sized retention class, only the expired-row probe and complete class-size assertion were rerun. The probe passed; the assertion reports only the unchanged `RuntimeBrokerService` baseline at 4284 lines against its 4270-line pin/global ceiling, byte-identical to the target branch. The whole gate remains failed. The later full MySQL CI job [126866878103](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41913376408/job/126866878103) also stopped at that assertion (6261 tests, 1 failure, 0 errors, 17 skipped) before Failsafe, so it did not complete MySQL integration acceptance.

The new full-completion MySQL regression has ordinary and claim-then-private arms. Its baseline attempt compiled and started the target class, but reached its thirty-five-second process limit during fixture-time JDBC reverse DNS, without a completed parameter result; this is neither a successful reproduction nor a passing test. The original shared local Java budget is exhausted and the temporary instance was shut down. Final-source projection checks and Checkstyle remain pending CI. Prior reactor Checkstyle and unchanged forced-renewal MySQL/39-case evidence remain recorded for the earlier revision; they do not establish new completion coverage. Current bilingual document formatting/link checks pass. Full CI acceptance remains pending.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ prior focused H2 and MySQL 8.4.11 checks; new completion case incomplete |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally; CI pending |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Oracle JDK 21.0.8, Maven 3.9.14, task-owned MySQL 8.4.11 with binary logging and native AIO disabled and `max_allowed_packet=134217728`. The matching sibling SDK and isolated Maven repository were reused. The temporary MySQL instance was shut down after verification.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: concurrent Sessions can briefly exceed tenant byte and active-capture caps. Session byte accounting remains exact. Any remaining post-root tenant-guard acquisition could invert retention's lock order.
- Not validated / out of scope: final-source completion regression, affected projection checks and Checkstyle, full Java/SpotBugs, full MySQL and Hosted/fault/platform gates are pending CI. The complete cross-Session publication/collection/quota matrix and dedicated CSI/non-null lifecycle-authority receipt guard-contention witnesses remain qualification gaps. The runtime-broker size failure is an unchanged target-branch blocker. The placement guard and native journal snapshot writer are outside this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no schema, public API or configuration migration.

## Linked Issues

Related to #13800.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 的改动

普通非 CSI 工具发布先锁 Session root 和 head，再锁 publication 行，不获取租户 `output_publication` guard。此规则覆盖预留、续期、fence、生产端操作、准入、回执与工具结果投影。投影完成操作复用准入在同一事务中已持有的锁，并在不重新获取租户 guard 的情况下复查私有 Session 拒绝条件。CSI original 与携带生命周期授权的回执保留现有 guard 获取方式。

读租约创建与续期也避开租户 publication guard，同时保留 Session root 互斥、退役世代检查与过期检查。隔离损坏的发布对象时锁定其 Session root、head 与 publication 行，使读取事务不会在 root 之后重新获取租户 guard。

租户字节与活跃捕获数上限仍是保护性上限：不同 Session 的重叠预留可能短暂超额；后续预留会看到已提交总量，在容量释放前被拒绝。Session 字节上限通过 root 串行保持精确。租户级过期预留 fencing 现在使用现有的五秒热路径语句超时与 `tenant_guard_contended` 映射。抽取容量核算使现有发布 store 低于类大小上限，门面清单也登记了有意新增的 writer 重载。

设计文档：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/publication-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-publication-tenant-guards.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/publication-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-publication-tenant-guards.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

无关 Session 的发布步骤和资源读取会在同一租户行上排队，等待 retention、回收以及彼此完成。移除这种串行还需要封闭所有在 Session root 之后重新获取 guard 的路径，并限制车道持有 placement 期间对过期行的等待。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在独立连接上持有租户 publication guard。普通预留、派发、finish、准入与回执应能完成；持有 placement 时仍应返回现有的有界拒绝。CSI 与生命周期授权车道应保留现有 fencing 语义。
2. 在持有 Session root 的事务中，将尚未过期的读租约推进到续期窗口。另一连接继续持有租户 guard 时，续期应延长过期时间。在该 root 下执行隔离也应完成，并把 publication 与资源标记为已隔离。
3. 持有另一个 Session 的过期 OPEN capture 行。新预留应在热路径上限内返回 `tenant_guard_contended`，无需等到数据库默认超时。释放后重试应成功，并 fence 过期 capture。回归用例把 worker 的数据库超时设为二十秒，高于十五秒的断言上限。
4. 验证发布/配额行为、读租约 fence、锁契约、精确门面方法清单与完整类大小断言。不同 Session 并发发布/回收/配额的完整验收仍未完成；新增过期行用例只覆盖一个独立连接争用场景。
5. 在独立连接持有租户 guard 时，完成有效且已 claim 的普通投影，应在十五秒内返回 true、进入 READY、重建 Artifact 行并发布一条结果事件。claim 后被固定为私有状态的 Session 则必须返回 false、保持 LEASED，且不写入 Artifact 行或结果事件。专门的 CSI 与非 null 生命周期授权回执 guard 观测仍是缺失的验收用例。

### 证据（改前与改后）

UI 证据为 N/A。在前一个 head 上，两个真实 MySQL 探针分别复现了过期行等待抛出未命名锁超时，以及隔离在持有 Session root 后等待租户 guard。修复后两者通过。隔离探针验证内部加锁边界，不代表已执行公共 API 损坏测试，也不声称观测到了 MySQL 1213 死锁。

在 `5ebbce9` 上，定向验证选择了 170 项测试：169 通过、1 失败、0 错误、0 跳过。发布/配额测试（128）、retention 测试（21）、锁契约测试（13）、门面测试（5）及两个 MySQL 探针通过。加强数据库超时并登记新达到阈值的 retention 类之后，只重跑了过期行探针与完整类大小断言。探针通过；断言只报告未改动的 `RuntimeBrokerService` 基线问题：4284 行超过 4270 行 pin/全局上限，该文件与目标分支字节完全一致。整项门禁仍失败。稍后的完整 MySQL CI job [126866878103](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41913376408/job/126866878103) 同样在该断言处停止（6261 项、1 失败、0 错误、17 跳过），未进入 Failsafe，因此没有完成 MySQL 集成验收。

新增完整完成路径的 MySQL 回归包含普通与 claim 后转私有两个参数。其 baseline 尝试完成编译并启动目标类，但在 fixture 的 JDBC 反向 DNS 期间达到三十五秒进程上限，没有任何已完成的参数结果；这既不构成成功复现，也不是通过的测试。原共享本地 Java 预算已经耗尽，临时实例已关闭。最终源码的投影相关检查与 Checkstyle 待 CI 执行。此前 reactor Checkstyle 与未改变的强制续期 MySQL/39 项证据保留为旧版本记录，不能证明新的完成路径覆盖。当前双语文档格式/链接检查通过。完整 CI 验收仍待完成。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| macOS | 已运行此前定向 H2 与 MySQL 8.4.11 检查；新增完成用例未完成 |
| Windows | 未在本地测试 |
| Linux | 未在本地测试；CI 待完成 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Oracle JDK 21.0.8、Maven 3.9.14、任务专用 MySQL 8.4.11；关闭 binary logging 与 native AIO，`max_allowed_packet=134217728`。复用了匹配的 sibling SDK 与隔离 Maven 仓库。验证后已关闭临时 MySQL 实例。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：并发 Session 可能短暂超出租户字节与活跃捕获数上限。Session 字节核算保持精确。任何残留的 root 后租户 guard 获取都可能与 retention 的锁序相反。
- 未验证或不在范围内：最终源码的完成路径回归、受影响的投影检查与 Checkstyle，以及完整 Java/SpotBugs、MySQL、Hosted/fault/平台门禁待 CI 验收。完整跨 Session 发布/回收/配额矩阵与专门的 CSI/非 null 生命周期授权回执 guard 争用观测仍是验收缺口。runtime-broker 类大小失败是目标分支已有的阻塞。placement guard 与 native journal 快照写入方不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：无；无需 schema、公共 API 或配置迁移。

## 关联问题

与 #13800 相关。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_title: perf(managed-agent): take ordinary tool publication and read leases off the tenant lock (#16335)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* docs(managed-agent): design publication lanes without tenant-wide guards

Publication lanes take the placement and output_publication tenant rows
on every call. The design separates their three roles: tenant byte quota
on a dedicated guard domain for reserve only, a per-Session lock order
shared by lanes and collection, and a shared lock on the original
Runtime binding in place of placement.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* perf(managed-agent): take publication reserve and renew off the tenant lock

The ordinary apply lane (reserve, renew, fence, no-start release) took
the tenant output_publication guard for every call, mostly so that a
reservation's tenant byte and active-capture sums were exact. Those
limits are protective caps, so a bounded, self-correcting overshoot by
concurrent reservations of different Sessions is accepted. The lane
runs at READ COMMITTED and its Session root keeps the Session limit
exact.

The lane already locks the Session root and head before the
publication row, as collection does. Its evidence reads took a read
lease through the tenant guard after the root, which inverts
retention's order; they now take the lease under the Session locks the
writer already holds. CSI publications keep the guard.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(managed-agent): correct the publication lane order in the guard design

Ordinary publication lanes already lock the Session root and head before
publication rows, as collection does; only CSI lanes lock the publication
row first. C2 therefore needs the post-root guard audit, not a reorder.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* perf(managed-agent): take ordinary publication lanes and read leases off the tenant lock

Ordinary producer, admission and receipt lanes and the tool-result
projection worker no longer take the output_publication guard. Below
the guard they already lock the Session root and head before
publication rows, as collection does, so no lane changes its order.
CSI originals keep the guard, as does a receipt whose commit carries
lifecycle authority.

Read leases take only the Session root and head: every collector that
checks them holds the same root and head, and retirement updates the
root. This replaces the Session-locked read variant added for the
apply lane and removes the guard from Artifact and resource reads.

The convoy test now runs every ordinary lane while the guard is held,
so a lane that takes it after its root stalls there.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(managed-agent): avoid tenant guard during read lease renewal

Keep renewal serialized by the Session root and preserve retirement generation and expiry checks. Add a MySQL regression that forces renewal while another connection holds the tenant guard, and synchronize the bilingual design.

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* fix(managed-agent): bound publication cleanup and preserve lock order

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* fix(managed-agent): keep projection completion off tenant guard

Reuse the root and head held by projection admission while retaining private Session mutation refusal. Add a full-completion contention regression and align the lock registry, dead helper pin and bilingual design.

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

prs.title: fix(core): keep a writer grant an in-flight renewal refreshed
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the HTTP Managed Session store client re-acquires a writer whose lease it saw lapse, it first waits for any renewal already in flight. If that renewal moved the lease past the lapsed one and the new lease is still live, the client now keeps the renewed grant and skips the acquire, instead of discarding the grant and acquiring anyway.

Five unit tests in `http-managed-session-store.test.ts` hold the answer of a scheduled renewal and drive `renewActivation` into that window:
- the renewal answers with a live lease: the grant is kept and no acquire is sent;
- the answer's own lease has already lapsed: the writer is still re-acquired;
- the renewal was refused and the wall clock stepped back: the lapsed lease is not mistaken for a live one, and the writer is still re-acquired;
- the renewal was refused, and after the clock stepped back a journal read copied the lapsed lease into a new grant object: the copy is not mistaken for a renewed grant, and the writer is still re-acquired;
- the grant is kept and the activation renewal that follows meets the lifecycle claim fence: the ordinary renewal timer stays armed, as it does for a grant whose lease never lapsed.

## Why it's needed

`HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT.publicDeletionRecoversOriginalResources[spring-kill]` has failed in 17 of the 239 CI runs that executed it and still have a `hosted-harness-mysql-reports` artifact (10-27 to 11-03). All 17 failed from 10-29 on, on 15 pull-request branches and the 11-02 `main` nightly. Each time, the test replays the killed Spring's stale `prepare_resources` request to the Harness and expects `503 workspace_lifecycle_claim_fenced`, but gets `workspace_lifecycle_resources_unsettled`.

The retained logs separate the two outcomes cleanly:

| | failing runs (17) | runs where the replay was fenced (221) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Harness: `Hosted lifecycle requires recovery:` | `ManagedSessionRecordError: the HTTP Managed Session writer is not active.` | `ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: Workspace lifecycle recovery is blocked.` |
| second Spring's first writer calls | `writers:renew` → 200, then `writers:acquire`, never answered | renewals and `lifecycle:authorize`, no unanswered acquire |

The one remaining run passed without logging a `Hosted lifecycle requires recovery:` line.

All 17 failing runs contain #15813, and none of the 80 runs older than it failed. #15813 added the step in `renewActivation` that calls `reacquireWriter()` when the grant's lease has lapsed. `reacquireWriter()` stops the timer and awaits the in-flight renewal, then always sets `this.grant = undefined` and posts an acquire. When the awaited renewal succeeded, the fresh grant is thrown away. The Store answers a same-credential acquire on a live lease by replaying the same generation, but here it held that request: the second Spring had the Session's lifecycle claim in flight. Until the acquire answers, `authorizeLifecycle`, and any caller that reads the grant without first waiting in `ensureWriter`, find no grant and refuse locally. The Harness maps that local error to `workspace_lifecycle_resources_unsettled` (`hosted-harness-session.ts`), so the Store never gets to answer with the claim fence.

In production the same window makes a Harness refuse lifecycle phases while the control plane recovers a Session. It lasts for as long as the Store holds that acquire.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts`: 202/202.
- The forward case fails on `main` with `promise rejected "ManagedSessionRecordError: the HTTP Managed Session writer is not active."`, the same error the Harness logged in CI.
- Each lease comparison in the new condition, and the timer the kept grant relies on, is pinned by its own case. Each of these ten mutants turns red the cases listed:
  - removing the early return (forward and claim-fence cases);
  - dropping the "still live" check (reverse case);
  - dropping the "moved past the lapsed lease" check (clock-step and journal-read cases);
  - replacing that check with `this.grant !== expired` (journal-read case only);
  - always returning (reverse, clock-step and journal-read cases, plus five existing tests);
  - `>=` instead of `>` in the live check (reverse case, which ends the renewed lease exactly now);
  - reading the clock for the live check before the wait instead of after it (reverse case only);
  - removing the `scheduleRenewal()` call after a successful ordinary renewal in `renewWriter()` (claim-fence case, plus one existing test);
  - moving `stopRenewal()` in `reacquireWriter` below the wait (claim-fence case only);
  - dropping the clamp that brings a renewal forward when the lease is about to end, in `scheduleRenewal` (claim-fence case only).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (`main`): the forward case rejects with the error above, and the client sends an acquire after the renewal answered 200.

After: the concurrent `authorizeLifecycle()` resolves, no acquire is sent, and the activation renewal completes with `renewalSeq` 1. The reverse, clock-step and journal-read cases still re-acquire. In the claim-fence case the client still sends the next ordinary renewal.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux x86_64, Node 22:
- this test file: 202/202;
- `npx vitest run src/managed-runtime` from `packages/core`: 3818/3818, exit 0. An earlier run on this branch hit the pre-existing flake in `local-managed-journal-snapshot.test.ts`, which mocks the next global `fs.readSync` call once; it passes alone 5/5 and the file is untouched here.
- `tsc --noEmit`, eslint `--max-warnings 0` and prettier are clean.

### Environment (optional)

N/A, unit tests only. The Hosted IT runs on the full SDK Java tier, not on this PR's fast tier.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the early return keeps the journal position the grant already had, where the old acquire would have replayed the head's position. That is the position the client already works from when its lease has not lapsed:
  - `settleAppend` checks the head with `requireHeadMatchesGrant`, which accepts an equal or newer head, and then adopts it;
  - `renewActivation` requires the Store's answer to match the grant's position exactly. If the head had drifted from the grant, the old acquire absorbed that drift on a lapsed lease. Now the renewal fails with `corrupt('activation renewal changed the journal head.')`, as it already does when the lease has not lapsed. A Session has one writer, so its head should not drift.
  - The kept grant relies on the renewal that refreshed it having re-armed the renewal timer that `reacquireWriter` stopped before waiting. The claim-fence case pins this.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - If the in-flight renewal is refused because the lease already lapsed at the Store, the acquire is still sent, and a held acquire still opens the same window. That shape did not appear in CI.
  - Making `authorizeLifecycle` wait for the acquire instead risks a self-deadlock, because both take the Store's placement lock.
  - A pre-existing catch in `reacquireWriter` restores the expired grant over a fresh one when `sealGrant()` throws after a successful acquire.
  - The Hosted IT itself was not re-run on a rig for this PR. It failed in about 11% of the runs that contain #15813 (17 of 159), so it needs many runs to show a difference; the nightlies after merge will show it.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Addresses the `HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT[spring-kill]` failures that the main-CI bot posts on #14104 (an issue that also collects other failures, so it is not closed here). Regression from #15813. Related to #15011, the lapsed-lease variant of the lifecycle claim fence.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

HTTP Managed Session store 客户端在发现 writer 租约已过期、准备重新获取 writer 时，会先等待正在进行中的那次续约。如果这次续约把租约推到了已过期那份之后，并且新租约仍然有效，客户端现在会保留续约后的 grant，跳过 acquire；以前的做法是丢掉这个 grant，照样去 acquire。

`http-managed-session-store.test.ts` 新增五个单测。它们扣住一次定时续约的应答，让 `renewActivation` 进入这个窗口：
- 续约返回有效租约：保留 grant，不发 acquire；
- 应答里的租约本身已经过期：仍然重新获取 writer；
- 续约被拒且墙钟回拨：不会把过期的租约误当成有效的，仍然重新获取 writer；
- 续约被拒，墙钟回拨后一次 journal 读取把过期租约拷进了新的 grant 对象：不会把这份拷贝误当成续约后的 grant，仍然重新获取 writer；
- 保留 grant 后，紧接着的 activation 续约遇到 lifecycle claim fence：普通续约定时器仍然在运行，与租约从未过期的 grant 相同。

## 为什么需要

`HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT.publicDeletionRecoversOriginalResources[spring-kill]` 在 10-27 至 11-03 间运行过这个用例、且仍保留 `hosted-harness-mysql-reports` 产物的 239 次 CI 运行中失败了 17 次。17 次失败都发生在 10-29 及以后，分布在 15 个 PR 分支，也包括 11-02 的 `main` 夜跑。每次都是测试把被杀掉的 Spring 留下的旧 `prepare_resources` 请求重放给 Harness，期望得到 `503 workspace_lifecycle_claim_fenced`，实际却得到 `workspace_lifecycle_resources_unsettled`。

保留下来的日志能把两种结果清楚地区分开（见英文部分的表格）：
- 失败的 17 次：Harness 记录的是 `ManagedSessionRecordError: the HTTP Managed Session writer is not active.`；第二个 Spring 的首批 writer 调用是 `writers:renew` 返回 200，紧接着一个始终没有应答的 `writers:acquire`；
- 重放被 fence 的 221 次：Harness 记录的是 `ManagedSessionStoreHttpError: Workspace lifecycle recovery is blocked.`；第二个 Spring 的首批 writer 调用是续约和 `lifecycle:authorize`，没有挂起的 acquire。

剩下的 1 次运行通过了，但日志里没有 `Hosted lifecycle requires recovery:` 这一行。

17 次失败的运行都包含 #15813，比它早的 80 次运行没有一次失败。#15813 在 `renewActivation` 里加了一步：发现租约过期就调用 `reacquireWriter()`。`reacquireWriter()` 会先停掉定时器、等待进行中的续约，然后无条件把 grant 置空并发出 acquire。如果等到的那次续约已经成功，刚续好的 grant 就被丢掉了。Store 对租约仍有效的同凭据 acquire 本来会回放同一个 generation，但这次第二个 Spring 对这个 Session 的 lifecycle claim 正在进行中，Store 就把这个 acquire 挂住了。在它返回之前，`authorizeLifecycle` 以及其他不先在 `ensureWriter` 里等待、直接读取 grant 的调用方都拿不到 grant，只能在本地拒绝。Harness 把这个本地错误映射成 `workspace_lifecycle_resources_unsettled`（`hosted-harness-session.ts`），于是 Store 根本没有机会回 claim fence。

在生产环境中，这个窗口会让控制面恢复 Session 期间 Harness 拒绝 lifecycle 阶段，持续时间等于 Store 挂住那次 acquire 的时间。

## 评审验证方式

### 如何验证

- 运行 `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts`：202/202 通过。
- 在 `main` 上，正向用例会以 `ManagedSessionRecordError: the HTTP Managed Session writer is not active.` 失败，和 Harness 在 CI 里记录的错误相同。
- 新条件里的每个租约比较，以及保留下来的 grant 所依赖的定时器，都由独立用例钉住。下面 10 个变异各自让括号里的用例变红：
  - 删掉提前返回（正向和 claim fence 用例）；
  - 去掉“仍然有效”判断（反向用例）；
  - 去掉“租约已推到过期那份之后”判断（时钟回拨和 journal 读取用例）；
  - 把这个判断换成 `this.grant !== expired`（只有 journal 读取用例）；
  - 总是提前返回（反向、时钟回拨和 journal 读取用例，另有 5 个原有用例）；
  - 有效性判断里把 `>` 改成 `>=`（反向用例，续约后的租约恰好此刻到期）；
  - 有效性判断改用等待之前读到的时间，而不是等待之后的（只有反向用例）；
  - 删掉 `renewWriter()` 里普通续约成功后的 `scheduleRenewal()` 调用（claim fence 用例，另有 1 个原有用例）；
  - 把 `reacquireWriter` 里的 `stopRenewal()` 挪到等待之后（只有 claim fence 用例）；
  - 去掉 `scheduleRenewal` 里在租约快到期时把续约提前的那段限制（只有 claim fence 用例）。

### 证据（前后对比）

修复前（`main`）：正向用例以上面那个错误失败，客户端在续约返回 200 之后仍然发出 acquire。

修复后：并发的 `authorizeLifecycle()` 正常完成，不发 acquire，activation 续约完成且 `renewalSeq` 为 1。反向、时钟回拨和 journal 读取用例仍然重新获取 writer。claim fence 用例里，客户端仍会发出下一次普通续约。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Linux x86_64，Node 22：
- 本测试文件 202/202 通过；
- 在 `packages/core` 下运行 `npx vitest run src/managed-runtime`：3818/3818 通过，退出码 0。本分支更早的一次运行遇到过 `local-managed-journal-snapshot.test.ts` 里原有的 flake：它对下一次全局 `fs.readSync` 调用做一次性 mock，单独运行 5/5 通过，本 PR 也没有改动这个文件。
- `tsc --noEmit`、eslint（`--max-warnings 0`）和 prettier 均无问题。

### 环境

不适用，只有单测。这个 Hosted IT 在完整的 SDK Java 档位上运行，不在本 PR 的 fast 档位上。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或权衡**：提前返回后，grant 保留它原有的 journal 位置，而旧的 acquire 会回放到 head 的位置。租约没有过期时，客户端本来就从这个位置继续工作：
  - `settleAppend` 用 `requireHeadMatchesGrant` 校验 head，接受相同或更新的 head，然后采纳它；
  - `renewActivation` 要求 Store 的应答与 grant 的位置完全一致。如果 head 与 grant 有偏差，以前租约过期时旧的 acquire 会把偏差吸收掉；现在续约会以 `corrupt('activation renewal changed the journal head.')` 失败，和租约未过期时的行为相同。一个 Session 只有一个 writer，head 不应出现偏差。
  - 保留下来的 grant 依赖刷新它的那次续约重新设置了续约定时器（`reacquireWriter` 在等待之前把它停掉了）。claim fence 用例钉住了这一点。
- **未覆盖或不在范围内**：
  - 如果进行中的续约因为 Store 端租约已过期而被拒，仍会发出 acquire；这个 acquire 被挂住时同样会出现这个窗口。CI 里没有出现过这种情况。
  - 让 `authorizeLifecycle` 等待 acquire 也不可取，两者都要拿 Store 的 placement 锁，可能自锁。
  - `reacquireWriter` 里原有一个 catch：acquire 成功后如果 `sealGrant()` 抛错，会用过期的 grant 覆盖新的 grant。
  - 本 PR 没有在 rig 上重跑这个 Hosted IT。在包含 #15813 的运行中它的失败率约 11%（159 次中 17 次），要跑很多次才能看出差别，合入后的夜跑会给出结果。
- **破坏性变更**：无。

## 关联 Issue

处理 main CI 机器人在 #14104 中汇报的 `HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT[spring-kill]` 失败。#14104 还汇总了其他失败，所以本 PR 不关闭它。回归由 #15813 引入。与 #15011 相关，那是 lifecycle claim fence 的租约过期变体。

</details>

prs.title: fix(extension): persist CDP reconnect backoff across service worker restarts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persists the CDP reconnect ladder in session storage so it survives MV3 service-worker restarts, and applies the same 1 second to 5 minute exponential backoff to live timers, keepalive wakeups, and cold starts. A successful initialization reply does not clear the ladder because an immediate close can still leave the tunnel unstable. An old episode expires after a quiet window, and a connection that stays healthy for 30 seconds also resets the ladder when it eventually drops.

The current worker also keeps a local fallback when the daemon address is unknown or session storage rejects a write. These failures still escalate instead of pinning reconnects at 1 second, and an unknown address never overwrites the real daemon's saved ladder.

## Why it's needed

The previous in-memory ladder disappeared with each idle service worker, so keepalive wakeups could retry immediately against a daemon that rejected the WebSocket upgrade. Persisting the ladder reduces that rejection loop to at most one attempt per 5 minutes across worker restarts.

This is a reduction in client-side log spam, not complete removal. At the cap, a continuously rejecting daemon can still see about 288 attempts per day. Server-side rejection-log throttling and a separate autoconnect opt-out remain outside this PR, and #13966 stays open to track them.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Point the extension at a daemon that rejects the upgrade. Reconnects should escalate from 1 second to a 5 minute cap and retain that cadence across service-worker restarts.
2. Close the tunnel before initialization, after an initialization error, and immediately after a successful reply. Every case should preserve the ladder. After more than 5 minutes without a failed attempt, the next episode should start again at 1 second.
3. Keep a successfully initialized tunnel open for at least 30 seconds before dropping it. The next reconnect must start at 1 second instead of continuing an older maxed ladder.
4. Reject session-storage writes and repeat failures in the same worker. The delays should still double, while the saved state for a known daemon remains intact when failures have no known address.
5. Check the live reconnect timer directly. It must use the delay returned by the ladder rather than a fixed 1 second timeout.

### Local verification

- The complete extension package passes 12 test files and 163 tests on macOS.
- Full extension build, typecheck, and ESLint with zero warnings pass on the merged head. Prettier and `git diff --check` also pass.
- The new stable-connection regression and the real maxed-backoff state case both failed before the reset implementation and now pass. Immediate ack-then-close still continues the old episode.
- The unknown-address and rejected-write regressions both fail on the old implementation at the second attempt, returning 1 second instead of 2 seconds. They pass with the local fallback.
- The CI Vite settings timeout did not reproduce locally: the same focused test passes in 857 ms. The new head will refresh the hosted result.
- I did not run the real-Chrome acceptance pass against a live daemon. The evidence above is from unit tests, mutation checks, typecheck, lint, and production builds.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| macOS | Local tests and builds pass |
| Windows | Not run locally |
| Linux | Not run locally |

The change uses cross-platform extension APIs and adds no permission.

## Risk & Scope

A tunnel that becomes unstable shortly after an earlier episode can inherit that episode's remaining ladder for up to one 5 minute decay window. This avoids resetting the delay on an acknowledgment followed immediately by a close. Once a connection has stayed healthy for 30 seconds, a later drop starts a fresh ladder at the floor instead of leaving the tunnel dark for another 5 minutes.

Session storage clears on browser restart. The worker-local fallback does not survive a worker restart and is only used when no daemon address is known or the latest session write failed.

The server-side rejection-log throttle and autoconnect setting are not implemented here. No live daemon or real-Chrome result is claimed.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13966

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): refuse every URL fetch refuses and say why a health probe failed
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to #16051, from the review notes that arrived around its merge.

- **Every URL `fetch` refuses is refused up front.** `start` and `verify` used to refuse a listener URL only when `URL.canParse` rejected it. A `--server-url` without a scheme (`proxy.test:8443`, which parses as an opaque `proxy.test:` URL), with a user name or password, or on a port the Fetch standard blocks (6000, 10080 and 80 others) passed that check and then failed every probe until `--timeout`. The new `fetchRefusal()` refuses all four shapes before any unit starts, for the resolver's URLs and for `--server-url` alike, and says which one it is (`--server-url "proxy.test:8443" is not an http or https URL.`).
- **A probe that is sent and still fails says what it got.** `start`'s timeout used to say only "did not report UP … within Ns", and `verify`'s health row only "is not UP". Now the timeout names the endpoint's last answer and the row names its own: `HTTP 503, status DOWN`, `HTTP 502` (a proxy's error page), `self-signed certificate`, `ECONNREFUSED`, or `The operation was aborted due to timeout`. `fetch` itself words every failure as "fetch failed", so the answer comes from its `cause`.
- **Endpoint text cannot steer the terminal, and a refused URL keeps its password out.** Control characters in the probe answer and in `verify`'s session and turn rows (from the API's error reasons, Session IDs and event types) show as `U+FFFD`. A refused `--server-url` prints its password as `***`. `verify`'s API reads name the `fetch` cause as the health probe does.
- **The Harness verdict comes from the server.** The configuration resolver (`ResolvedConfiguration`) now prints `harnessOrigin`, the server's own verdict on the Harness URL: `skip` for a disabled Harness, which nothing reads, and otherwise whether the Harness connector, single or pooled, takes the value. It prints that URL untrimmed, as the server parses it. `start` refuses on the verdict before it restarts the Harness, so the script keeps no copy of `java.net.URI`'s rules.
- **`verify` checks the type of what the API answers before it uses it.** A page without a data list, a Session id that is no string or names no route segment, an event type that is no string, or a sequence that is no whole number fails its row with what came back, instead of throwing inside a coercion.
- The `listeners()` comment now names the `reachesHarness: false` option `verify` passes.
- The design doc and the deployment guide (English and Chinese) list the refused shapes. The guide also says to point `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` at the CA when the certificate is not one this host trusts.

## Why it's needed

The verify-pr round 2 report on #16051 measured `URL.canParse('proxy.test:8443')` as true and `fetch` rejecting it immediately, so `start --server-url proxy.test:8443` waits out `--timeout` and then reports a server that is in fact UP. Checking the same path showed two more shapes with the same result: credentials in the URL (`Request cannot be constructed from a URL that includes credentials`) and the Fetch standard's blocked ports (`bad port`). A blocked port can come from the resolver's own output, for example `server.port=6000`. In every case the old `health()` swallowed the error, so the operator saw only a timeout. A certificate the host does not trust (`self-signed certificate`) failed the same silent way.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `node --test scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs` → 67/67.
- `refuses only the URLs fetch refuses` pins each refusal and its wording, and keeps the list honest: every URL `fetchRefusal()` refuses (the 82 blocked ports out of 1–65535, two schemes, two credential forms) must be rejected by the runtime's real `fetch` with `bad port`, `unknown scheme` or the credentials `TypeError`. All of those rejections happen before any connection is made.
- `start refuses listeners it cannot reach before it starts anything` adds the resolver at port 6000 and `--server-url` values `proxy.test:8443`, `http://admin:secret@…` and `http://…:10080/`. All of them are refused with both units still inactive.
- `verify says what the health endpoint answered instead of UP` covers `HTTP 404`, `HTTP 503, status UP`, `HTTP 502` with an HTML body, `HTTP 200, terminated`, `self-signed certificate`, and an `AggregateError` that carries only `ECONNREFUSED`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

How `fetch` treats each shape, measured on Node 22.22.2 (`/actuator/health` appended):

| URL | `URL.canParse` (old check) | `fetch` rejects with | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `proxy.test:8443` | true | `unknown scheme` | waits `--timeout`, "did not report UP" | refused: `is not an http or https URL` |
| `http://u:p@127.0.0.1:…` | true | `Request cannot be constructed from a URL that includes credentials` | waits `--timeout` | refused: `carries a user name or password, so fetch refuses it` |
| `http://127.0.0.1:6000` | true | `bad port` | waits `--timeout` | refused: `is on port 6000, so fetch refuses to dial it` |
| `https://…` (self-signed) | true | `self-signed certificate` | "did not report UP" | `… (the last answer: self-signed certificate)` |
| `http://localhost:39999` (closed) | true | `AggregateError`, code `ECONNREFUSED`, empty message | "is not UP" | `is not UP: ECONNREFUSED` |

The 82 blocked ports were read from the `badPorts` list in the Node 22 binary's bundled undici and match the Fetch standard. `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=<the CA>` turned the self-signed failure into `200 {"status":"UP"}` in the same probe.

Mutation matrix (17 single-point mutants, `scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs`): **17/17 killed**. The mutants drop or alter, one at a time:

- the scheme check, the credentials check, and the password-only half of it;
- the port check, its numeric lookup, and an added or removed port in the list;
- the zone note;
- each half of the `cause` fallback;
- the `status` detail, the JSON-failure branches for success and non-success, and the success-status guard on UP (unpinned until now);
- the answer in `start`'s timeout and in `verify`'s row;
- a same-file positive control.

**Review round 1 (`13157b7c96`).**
- **Harness URL (triage note 2).** `start` checked `qwen.managed-agent.harness.base-url` with `new URL()` alone, so an opaque value such as `proxy.test:8443` parsed with an empty host and port, and `start` waited out `--timeout` for the Harness to listen on port 80 of an empty host. `start` now refuses a Harness URL that is not `http` or `https` before it starts a unit, as the server's preflight `harness` row would fail it later anyway. `fetchRefusal()` does not apply here: the Harness is reached by a TCP connect, where a port `fetch` blocks connects fine.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the blocked-port list is copied from the Fetch standard. If a later Node blocks a port the list lacks, the test still passes, and that port falls back to the probe answer (`bad port`) at the timeout instead of an up-front refusal. If a port were dropped from the standard, the agreement test would fail.
- **The PR now touches Java.** `ResolvedConfiguration` prints one more key and the Harness URL untrimmed, and `ManagedAgentPreflight` gains the package-private `harnessUrlVerdict` and `harnessOrigin`. The verdict leans on two server facts that tests now pin: the connector's URL rule (`ResolvedConfigurationTest`) and the pool building each member from the single `base-url` (`HarnessConfigurationTest`). PR CI runs no Java tests, so the three Java test classes above ran locally. Main's `ClassSizeRatchetTest` failure on `JournalCommit` (886 lines over its 880 ceiling) is fixed by #16323, merged here; it passes on this head.
- Validated on a real systemd host (rounds 4 to 7). Not validated: macOS or Windows. Two review notes on #16051 are deliberately left as they are. The `port != 0` clause the mutation report calls dead mirrors Spring Boot's `ManagementPortType` condition word for word, so it stays for the reader. `serverBaseUrl()` is still the `server.env` fallback inside `listeners()` and has its own tests, so it is not unused. The `--check` gap stays in #16057.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. A URL refused now would have failed every probe before.

## 这个 PR 做了什么

#16051 合入前后收到几条评审意见，本 PR 是它们的 follow-up。

- **`fetch` 会拒绝的 URL，一律在开始前拒绝。** 以前 `start` 和 `verify` 只在 `URL.canParse` 不通过时拒绝监听 URL。下面几种 `--server-url` 都能通过这项检查，随后每次探测都失败，直到 `--timeout`：没有 scheme 的（`proxy.test:8443` 会被解析成 scheme 为 `proxy.test:` 的不透明 URL）、带用户名或密码的、端口在 Fetch 标准屏蔽列表里的（6000、10080 等共 82 个）。新增的 `fetchRefusal()` 在启动任何 unit 之前拒绝这四种情况，对解析器给出的 URL 和 `--server-url` 一视同仁，并说明属于哪种（`--server-url "proxy.test:8443" is not an http or https URL.`）。
- **探测发出后仍然失败时，说明收到了什么。** 以前 `start` 超时只说 "did not report UP … within Ns"，`verify` 的 health 行只说 "is not UP"。现在超时提示给出端点最后一次的应答，health 行给出本次探测的结果，例如 `HTTP 503, status DOWN`、`HTTP 502`（代理的错误页）、`self-signed certificate`、`ECONNREFUSED`、`The operation was aborted due to timeout`。`fetch` 自己对所有失败都只报 "fetch failed"，所以原因取自它的 `cause`。
- **端点返回的文本无法操纵终端，被拒绝的 URL 不会带出密码。** 探测应答，以及 `verify` 的 session 和 turn 行（来自 API 的错误原因、Session ID 和事件类型）中的控制字符显示为 `U+FFFD`。被拒绝的 `--server-url` 把密码显示为 `***`。`verify` 读取 API 失败时，与健康探测一样给出 `fetch` 的 cause。
- **Harness 的判定来自服务端。** 配置解析器（`ResolvedConfiguration`）现在输出 `harnessOrigin`，即服务端自己对 Harness URL 的判定：Harness 被禁用时为 `skip`（没有任何地方读取它），否则为 Harness 连接器（单实例或 pool）是否接受该取值；并且按服务端的解析方式输出未经 trim 的 URL。`start` 在重启 Harness 之前依据该判定拒绝执行，因此脚本不再保留一份 `java.net.URI` 规则的副本。
- **`verify` 先检查 API 返回值的类型再使用。** 页面没有 data 列表、Session id 不是字符串或不能作为路由中的一段、事件类型不是字符串、序号不是整数时，该行判失败并写出实际返回的值，而不是在隐式转换中抛错。
- `listeners()` 的注释写明了 `verify` 传入的 `reachesHarness: false` 选项。
- 设计文档和部署指南（中英文）列出了会被拒绝的几种情况。部署指南还说明：证书不受本机信任时，用 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 指向其 CA。

## 为什么需要

#16051 的 verify-pr 第 2 轮报告实测：`URL.canParse('proxy.test:8443')` 返回 true，而 `fetch` 会立即拒绝这个 URL。结果 `start --server-url proxy.test:8443` 会等满 `--timeout`，然后报告一个实际已经 UP 的服务没有起来。顺着同一条路径排查，又发现两种结果相同的情况：URL 带凭据（`Request cannot be constructed from a URL that includes credentials`），以及 Fetch 标准屏蔽的端口（`bad port`）。屏蔽端口也可能来自解析器本身的输出，例如 `server.port=6000`。这几种情况下旧的 `health()` 都把错误吞掉了，运维只能看到超时。证书不受本机信任（`self-signed certificate`）时，同样是这样无声地失败。
